/* asi_vm.c -- see asi_vm.h.  The Unicorn set-up (flat GDT, a data segment
 * for fs, a sentinel return address on an unmapped page, guest pages mapped
 * on demand straight from the host buffer) follows feat/drift's
 * runtime/oracle.c. */
#include "asi_vm.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define PG        0x4000u               /* mapping granule: the port's commit block */
#define GDT_VA    0xFFFF0000u
#define SENTINEL  0xFFFE0000u
#define STUB_BASE 0xFFC00000u           /* import i: STUB_BASE + 16 i */
#define MAXSTUB   64
enum { ST_NONE, ST_RET, ST_IMPORT, ST_FOREIGN, ST_FAULT };

struct xvm {
    xvm_cfg   cfg;
    uc_engine *uc;
    uint8_t   mapped[1u << 15];         /* 16 KB blocks mapped into Unicorn */
    uint8_t   gdt[0x1000];
    int       stop; uint32_t stop_addr; int stop_write;
    char      why[160];
    const xpe *pe;                       /* imports */
    struct { uint32_t addr; xvm_stub_fn fn; } stub[MAXSTUB]; int nstub;
    struct { uint32_t flo, fhi, tlo, thi; xvm_trace_fn fn; } tr; uint32_t prev_block;
    int       counting; uint64_t insns;
};

uc_engine *xvm_uc(xvm *vm){ return vm->uc; }
const char *xvm_why(xvm *vm){ return vm->why; }
static const int RID[XR__N] = { UC_X86_REG_EAX, UC_X86_REG_ECX, UC_X86_REG_EDX, UC_X86_REG_EBX, UC_X86_REG_ESP,
                                UC_X86_REG_EBP, UC_X86_REG_ESI, UC_X86_REG_EDI, UC_X86_REG_EIP, UC_X86_REG_EFLAGS };
void xvm_get(xvm *vm, uint32_t *r){ for (int i = 0; i < XR__N; i++) uc_reg_read(vm->uc, RID[i], &r[i]); }
void xvm_set(xvm *vm, const uint32_t *r){ for (int i = 0; i < XR__N; i++) uc_reg_write(vm->uc, RID[i], &r[i]); }

static int in_foreign(xvm *vm, uint32_t a){ return a >= vm->cfg.foreign_lo && a < vm->cfg.foreign_hi; }
static int map_block(xvm *vm, uint32_t a){
    uint32_t b = a >> 14;
    if (vm->mapped[b >> 3] & (1u << (b & 7))) return 1;
    if (!vm->cfg.committed(vm->cfg.user, a)) return 0;
    uint32_t lo = b << 14;
    int prot = UC_PROT_ALL;
    /* foreign code: no execute right, so every transfer into it stops */
    if (vm->cfg.foreign && lo + PG > vm->cfg.foreign_lo && lo < vm->cfg.foreign_hi) prot = UC_PROT_READ | UC_PROT_WRITE;
    if (uc_mem_map_ptr(vm->uc, lo, PG, (uint32_t)prot, vm->cfg.mem + lo)) return 0;
    vm->mapped[b >> 3] |= (uint8_t)(1u << (b & 7));
    return 1;
}
static bool on_unmapped(uc_engine *uc, uc_mem_type type, uint64_t addr, int size, int64_t value, void *ud){
    (void)uc; (void)size; (void)value;
    xvm *vm = ud; uint32_t a = (uint32_t)addr;
    if (type == UC_MEM_FETCH_UNMAPPED && a == SENTINEL){ vm->stop = ST_RET; return false; }
    if (type == UC_MEM_FETCH_UNMAPPED && vm->pe && a >= STUB_BASE && a < STUB_BASE + 16u * (uint32_t)vm->pe->nimp){
        vm->stop = ST_IMPORT; vm->stop_addr = a; return false; }
    if (map_block(vm, a)) return true;
    vm->stop = ST_FAULT; vm->stop_addr = a; vm->stop_write = type == UC_MEM_WRITE_UNMAPPED ? 1 : type == UC_MEM_FETCH_UNMAPPED ? 8 : 0;
    return false;
}
static bool on_prot(uc_engine *uc, uc_mem_type type, uint64_t addr, int size, int64_t value, void *ud){
    (void)uc; (void)size; (void)value;
    xvm *vm = ud; uint32_t a = (uint32_t)addr;
    if (type == UC_MEM_FETCH_PROT && in_foreign(vm, a)){ vm->stop = ST_FOREIGN; vm->stop_addr = a; return false; }
    vm->stop = ST_FAULT; vm->stop_addr = a; vm->stop_write = type == UC_MEM_WRITE_PROT ? 1 : type == UC_MEM_FETCH_PROT ? 8 : 0;
    return false;
}
static void on_stub(uc_engine *uc, uint64_t addr, uint32_t size, void *ud){
    (void)uc; (void)size;
    xvm *vm = ud;
    for (int i = 0; i < vm->nstub; i++){
        if (vm->stub[i].addr != (uint32_t)addr) continue;
        uint32_t r[XR__N]; xvm_get(vm, r);
        uint32_t ret = xvm_rd32(vm, r[XR_ESP]);
        int pop = vm->stub[i].fn(vm->cfg.user, vm, (uint32_t)addr, r);
        r[XR_ESP] += 4u + (uint32_t)pop; r[XR_EIP] = ret;
        xvm_set(vm, r);
        return;
    }
}
static void on_block(uc_engine *uc, uint64_t addr, uint32_t size, void *ud){
    (void)uc; (void)size;
    xvm *vm = ud; uint32_t a = (uint32_t)addr;
    if (vm->tr.fn && vm->prev_block >= vm->tr.flo && vm->prev_block < vm->tr.fhi && a >= vm->tr.tlo && a < vm->tr.thi)
        vm->tr.fn(vm->cfg.user, vm, vm->prev_block, a);
    vm->prev_block = a;
}
static void on_insn(uc_engine *uc, uint64_t addr, uint32_t size, void *ud){ (void)uc; (void)addr; (void)size; ((xvm *)ud)->insns++; }
void xvm_count(xvm *vm, int on){
    if (on && !vm->counting){ uc_hook h; uc_hook_add(vm->uc, &h, UC_HOOK_CODE, (void *)on_insn, vm, 1, 0); }
    vm->counting = on;
}
uint64_t xvm_insns(xvm *vm){ return vm->insns; }

static void gdt_entry(xvm *vm, int i, uint32_t base, uint32_t limit, int code, int dpl){
    uint8_t *d = vm->gdt + 8 * i;
    limit >>= 12;
    d[0] = limit & 0xFF; d[1] = (limit >> 8) & 0xFF;
    d[2] = base & 0xFF; d[3] = (base >> 8) & 0xFF; d[4] = (base >> 16) & 0xFF;
    d[5] = (uint8_t)(0x80 | (dpl << 5) | 0x10 | (code ? 0x0A : 0x02));
    d[6] = (uint8_t)(0xC0 | ((limit >> 16) & 0x0F));
    d[7] = (base >> 24) & 0xFF;
}
xvm *xvm_new(const xvm_cfg *cfg){
    xvm *vm = calloc(1, sizeof *vm);
    vm->cfg = *cfg;
    if (uc_open(UC_ARCH_X86, UC_MODE_32, &vm->uc)){ free(vm); return 0; }
    uc_hook h;
    uc_hook_add(vm->uc, &h, UC_HOOK_MEM_UNMAPPED, (void *)on_unmapped, vm, 1, 0);
    uc_hook_add(vm->uc, &h, UC_HOOK_MEM_PROT, (void *)on_prot, vm, 1, 0);
    uc_mem_map_ptr(vm->uc, GDT_VA, 0x1000, UC_PROT_READ | UC_PROT_WRITE, vm->gdt);
    gdt_entry(vm, 1, 0, 0xFFFFF000u, 1, 3);
    gdt_entry(vm, 2, 0, 0xFFFFF000u, 0, 3);
    gdt_entry(vm, 3, 0, 0xFFFFF000u, 0, 0);
    gdt_entry(vm, 4, cfg->fs_base, 0xFFFFF000u, 0, 3);
    gdt_entry(vm, 5, 0, 0xFFFFF000u, 1, 0);
    uc_x86_mmr gdtr = { 0, GDT_VA, 8 * 6 - 1, 0 };
    uc_reg_write(vm->uc, UC_X86_REG_GDTR, &gdtr);
    uint32_t sel = (3 << 3) | 0; uc_reg_write(vm->uc, UC_X86_REG_SS, &sel);
    sel = (2 << 3) | 3; uc_reg_write(vm->uc, UC_X86_REG_DS, &sel); uc_reg_write(vm->uc, UC_X86_REG_ES, &sel);
    uc_reg_write(vm->uc, UC_X86_REG_GS, &sel);
    sel = (4 << 3) | 3; uc_reg_write(vm->uc, UC_X86_REG_FS, &sel);
    uint32_t cr0 = 0x00000033u, cr4 = 0x00000600u;   /* PE MP ET NE; OSFXSR OSXMMEXCPT: SSE on */
    uc_reg_write(vm->uc, UC_X86_REG_CR0, &cr0); uc_reg_write(vm->uc, UC_X86_REG_CR4, &cr4);
    uint32_t mx = 0x1F80; uc_reg_write(vm->uc, UC_X86_REG_MXCSR, &mx);
    uint16_t cw = cfg->fcw; uc_reg_write(vm->uc, UC_X86_REG_FPCW, &cw);
    uc_hook_add(vm->uc, &h, UC_HOOK_BLOCK, (void *)on_block, vm, 1, 0);
    return vm;
}
void xvm_free(xvm *vm){ if (vm){ uc_close(vm->uc); free(vm); } }
int xvm_stub(xvm *vm, uint32_t addr, xvm_stub_fn fn){
    if (vm->nstub == MAXSTUB) return -1;
    vm->stub[vm->nstub].addr = addr; vm->stub[vm->nstub].fn = fn; vm->nstub++;
    uc_hook h; uc_hook_add(vm->uc, &h, UC_HOOK_CODE, (void *)on_stub, vm, addr, addr);
    return 0;
}
void xvm_trace(xvm *vm, uint32_t flo, uint32_t fhi, uint32_t tlo, uint32_t thi, xvm_trace_fn fn){
    vm->tr.flo = flo; vm->tr.fhi = fhi; vm->tr.tlo = tlo; vm->tr.thi = thi; vm->tr.fn = fn;
}
int xvm_read(xvm *vm, uint32_t a, void *dst, uint32_t n){
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i += PG - ((a + i) & (PG - 1)))
        if (!vm->cfg.committed(vm->cfg.user, a + i)) return -1;
    if (n && !vm->cfg.committed(vm->cfg.user, a + n - 1)) return -1;
    memcpy(dst, vm->cfg.mem + a, n); return 0;
}
int xvm_write(xvm *vm, uint32_t a, const void *src, uint32_t n){
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i += PG - ((a + i) & (PG - 1)))
        if (!vm->cfg.committed(vm->cfg.user, a + i)) return -1;
    if (n && !vm->cfg.committed(vm->cfg.user, a + n - 1)) return -1;
    memcpy(vm->cfg.mem + a, src, n); return 0;
}
uint32_t xvm_rd32(xvm *vm, uint32_t a){ uint32_t v = 0; xvm_read(vm, a, &v, 4); return v; }

int xvm_call(xvm *vm, uint32_t fn, uint32_t *r){
    uint32_t esp0 = r[XR_ESP], saved = xvm_rd32(vm, esp0), sent = SENTINEL;
    if (xvm_write(vm, esp0, &sent, 4)){ snprintf(vm->why, sizeof vm->why, "stack 0x%08x not mapped", esp0); return 0; }
    r[XR_EIP] = fn;
    xvm_set(vm, r);
    uint32_t eip = fn;
    int ok = 0;
    vm->why[0] = 0;
    for (int guard = 0; guard < 4000000; guard++){
        vm->stop = ST_NONE;
        uc_err err = uc_emu_start(vm->uc, eip, 0, 0, 0);
        xvm_get(vm, r);
        if (vm->stop == ST_RET){ ok = 1; break; }
        if (vm->stop == ST_IMPORT){
            int idx = (int)((vm->stop_addr - STUB_BASE) / 16u);
            uint32_t ret = xvm_rd32(vm, r[XR_ESP]), eax = r[XR_EAX];
            int pop = vm->cfg.import ? vm->cfg.import(vm->cfg.user, vm, idx, vm->pe->imp[idx].dll, vm->pe->imp[idx].name, r[XR_ESP], &eax) : -1;
            if (pop < 0){ snprintf(vm->why, sizeof vm->why, "import %s!%s not implemented", vm->pe->imp[idx].dll, vm->pe->imp[idx].name); break; }
            xvm_get(vm, r);                                 /* the handler may have run code */
            r[XR_EAX] = eax; r[XR_ESP] += 4u + 4u * (uint32_t)pop; r[XR_EIP] = ret;
            xvm_set(vm, r); eip = ret;
            continue;
        }
        if (vm->stop == ST_FOREIGN){
            uint32_t tgt = vm->stop_addr;
            if (vm->cfg.foreign && vm->cfg.foreign(vm->cfg.user, vm, tgt)){ xvm_get(vm, r); eip = r[XR_EIP]; continue; }
            snprintf(vm->why, sizeof vm->why, "call into 0x%08x not bridged", tgt); break;
        }
        if (vm->stop == ST_FAULT){
            uint32_t a = vm->stop_addr;
            if (vm->cfg.fault && vm->cfg.fault(vm->cfg.user, vm, r[XR_EIP], a, vm->stop_write)){ xvm_get(vm, r); eip = r[XR_EIP]; continue; }
            snprintf(vm->why, sizeof vm->why, "fault: %s 0x%08x at eip 0x%08x", vm->stop_write == 1 ? "write" : vm->stop_write == 8 ? "fetch" : "read", a, r[XR_EIP]);
            break;
        }
        snprintf(vm->why, sizeof vm->why, "stopped: %s at eip 0x%08x", err ? uc_strerror(err) : "no reason", r[XR_EIP]);
        break;
    }
    xvm_write(vm, esp0, &saved, 4);
    if (ok && r[XR_ESP] <= esp0){ snprintf(vm->why, sizeof vm->why, "returned with esp 0x%08x not above 0x%08x", r[XR_ESP], esp0); ok = 0; }
    return ok;
}

/* ---- PE -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
static uint32_t g32(const uint8_t *p){ return (uint32_t)p[0] | (uint32_t)p[1] << 8 | (uint32_t)p[2] << 16 | (uint32_t)p[3] << 24; }
static uint16_t g16(const uint8_t *p){ return (uint16_t)(p[0] | p[1] << 8); }
int xpe_load(xpe *pe, xvm *vm, const char *path, const char *mapfile, uint32_t base,
             void (*commit)(void *user, uint32_t a, uint32_t n)){
    memset(pe, 0, sizeof *pe);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f){ fprintf(stderr, "asi_vm: cannot read %s\n", path); return -1; }
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END); long fl = ftell(f); fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    uint8_t *d = malloc((size_t)fl);
    if (fread(d, 1, (size_t)fl, f) != (size_t)fl){ fclose(f); free(d); return -1; }
    fclose(f);
    if (fl < 0x200 || d[0] != 'M' || d[1] != 'Z'){ free(d); return -1; }
    const uint8_t *nt = d + g32(d + 0x3C);
    if (g32(nt) != 0x4550u || g16(nt + 4) != 0x14C){ fprintf(stderr, "asi_vm: %s is not a PE32 i386 image\n", path); free(d); return -1; }
    int nsec = g16(nt + 6), opt = g16(nt + 20);
    const uint8_t *oh = nt + 24, *sh = oh + opt;
    pe->pref_base = g32(oh + 28); pe->size = g32(oh + 56); pe->base = base; pe->entry = base + g32(oh + 16);
    uint32_t hdrs = g32(oh + 60);
    commit(vm->cfg.user, base, pe->size);
    uint8_t *img = vm->cfg.mem + base;
    memset(img, 0, pe->size);
    memcpy(img, d, hdrs < (uint32_t)fl ? hdrs : (uint32_t)fl);
    for (int i = 0; i < nsec; i++){
        const uint8_t *s = sh + 40 * i;
        uint32_t va = g32(s + 12), raw = g32(s + 16), ptr = g32(s + 20);
        if (raw && ptr + raw <= (uint32_t)fl && va + raw <= pe->size) memcpy(img + va, d + ptr, raw);
    }
    free(d);
    const uint8_t *dd = oh + 96;
    /* base relocations */
    uint32_t delta = base - pe->pref_base, rva = g32(dd + 5 * 8), rsz = g32(dd + 5 * 8 + 4);
    for (uint32_t o = 0; rva && o + 8 <= rsz; ){
        uint32_t page = g32(img + rva + o), bs = g32(img + rva + o + 4);
        if (bs < 8) break;
        for (uint32_t k = 8; k + 2 <= bs; k += 2){
            uint16_t e = g16(img + rva + o + k);
            if ((e >> 12) == 3){ uint8_t *p = img + page + (e & 0xFFFu); uint32_t v = g32(p) + delta; memcpy(p, &v, 4); pe->nreloc++; }
            else if ((e >> 12) != 0){ fprintf(stderr, "asi_vm: relocation type %u not handled\n", e >> 12); return -1; }
        }
        o += bs;
    }
    /* imports: every name thunk -> a stub address */
    uint32_t irva = g32(dd + 1 * 8);
    for (uint32_t di = irva; irva; di += 20){
        uint32_t oft = g32(img + di), name = g32(img + di + 12), ft = g32(img + di + 16);
        if (!name && !ft) break;
        uint32_t th = oft ? oft : ft;
        for (uint32_t k = 0; ; k += 4){
            uint32_t v = g32(img + th + k);
            if (!v) break;
            if (v & 0x80000000u){ fprintf(stderr, "asi_vm: import by ordinal not handled\n"); return -1; }
            if (pe->nimp == 128) return -1;
            int i = pe->nimp++;
            snprintf(pe->imp[i].dll, sizeof pe->imp[i].dll, "%s", (const char *)img + name);
            snprintf(pe->imp[i].name, sizeof pe->imp[i].name, "%s", (const char *)img + v + 2);
            pe->imp[i].iat = base + ft + k;
            uint32_t stub = STUB_BASE + 16u * (uint32_t)i; memcpy(img + ft + k, &stub, 4);
        }
    }
    /* exports */
    uint32_t erva = g32(dd);
    if (erva){
        uint32_t nn = g32(img + erva + 24), af = g32(img + erva + 28), an = g32(img + erva + 32), ao = g32(img + erva + 36);
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < nn && pe->nexp < 16; k++){
            snprintf(pe->exp[pe->nexp].name, sizeof pe->exp[0].name, "%s", (const char *)img + g32(img + an + 4 * k));
            pe->exp[pe->nexp].va = base + g32(img + af + 4u * g16(img + ao + 2 * k)); pe->nexp++;
        }
    }
    /* linker map: "  0x10001000   name" */
    if (mapfile){
        FILE *m = fopen(mapfile, "r");
        if (m){
            char line[512]; int cap = 0;
            while (fgets(line, sizeof line, m)){
                unsigned long a; char nm[256];
                if (sscanf(line, " 0x%lx %255s", &a, nm) != 2 || strchr(nm, '(') || strchr(nm, '=') || a < pe->pref_base || a >= pe->pref_base + pe->size) continue;
                if (pe->nsym == cap){ cap = cap ? cap * 2 : 512; pe->sym = realloc(pe->sym, sizeof *pe->sym * (size_t)cap); }
                snprintf(pe->sym[pe->nsym].name, sizeof pe->sym[0].name, "%s", nm);
                pe->sym[pe->nsym].va = (uint32_t)a - pe->pref_base + base; pe->nsym++;
            }
            fclose(m);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
uint32_t xpe_export(const xpe *pe, const char *name){ for (int i = 0; i < pe->nexp; i++) if (!strcmp(pe->exp[i].name, name)) return pe->exp[i].va; return 0; }
uint32_t xpe_sym(const xpe *pe, const char *name){
    for (int i = 0; i < pe->nsym; i++) if (!strcmp(pe->sym[i].name, name) || (pe->sym[i].name[0] == '_' && !strcmp(pe->sym[i].name + 1, name))) return pe->sym[i].va;
    return 0;
}
void xvm_bind_pe(xvm *vm, const xpe *pe){ vm->pe = pe; }

        { "GetModuleHandleA", 1 }, { "GetPrivateProfileStringA", 6 }, { "GetTickCount", 0 }, { "InitializeCriticalSection", 1 },
        { "LeaveCriticalSection", 1 }, { "QueryPerformanceCounter", 1 }, { "QueryPerformanceFrequency", 1 }, { "Sleep", 1 },
        { "TryEnterCriticalSection", 1 }, { "VirtualProtect", 4 }, { "VirtualQuery", 3 }, { "WaitForSingleObject", 2 },
        { "WriteFile", 5 }, { "lstrcmpA", 2 }, { "lstrcmpiA", 2 }, { "lstrcpyA", 2 }, { "lstrlenA", 1 },

        { "socket", 3 },
    };

/* asi_vm.h -- run 32-bit Windows x86 code (the free-roam plugin
 * NFSU2FreeRoam.asi, and the game's own functions it calls) under Unicorn,
 * on a guest address space that is a host buffer (the port's 4 GB arena, or
 * a snapshot of it).  Used by tests/asi_harness.c (offline, two copies of a
 * snapshot) and runtime/roam_asipeer.c (a "virtual Windows friend" inside a
 * running port instance).  Test tooling: never part of the plugin.
 *
 * - A minimal PE loader: sections at any base, base relocations, imports
 *   bound to stub addresses; the host implements each import (stdcall).
 * - xvm_call: run from an address until the code returns to a sentinel
 *   return address planted on the stack, with every register in and out.
 * - Guest pages are mapped into Unicorn on first touch (16 KB blocks of the
 *   host buffer, zero copy); "foreign" code (the exe's .text, when the host
 *   bridges calls into it) is mapped without execute rights, and each
 *   transfer into it goes to the host's callback instead.
 */
#ifndef ASI_VM_H
#define ASI_VM_H
#include <stdint.h>
#include <unicorn/unicorn.h>

typedef struct xvm xvm;
typedef struct {
    void     *user;
    uint8_t  *mem;                                  /* host address of guest address 0 */
    int     (*committed)(void *user, uint32_t a);   /* guest address a is backed (RW) */
    uint32_t  fs_base;                              /* the TEB */
    uint16_t  fcw;                                  /* x87 control word at the start */
    /* a call of import idx (stdcall): read the arguments at esp + 4..., set
     * *eax; return the number of argument dwords the callee pops, or -1 for
     * "not implemented" (the run stops) */
    int     (*import)(void *user, xvm *vm, int idx, const char *dll, const char *name, uint32_t esp, uint32_t *eax);
    /* a transfer into [foreign_lo, foreign_hi): return 1 when the host ran
     * it (it has set the registers, eip = where to go on), 0 to stop */
    int     (*foreign)(void *user, xvm *vm, uint32_t target);
    uint32_t  foreign_lo, foreign_hi;
    /* a fault the code did not handle (an unmapped or protected access):
     * return 1 when the host has set the registers to go on (exception
     * dispatch), 0 to stop the run */
    int     (*fault)(void *user, xvm *vm, uint32_t eip, uint32_t addr, int write);
} xvm_cfg;

enum { XR_EAX, XR_ECX, XR_EDX, XR_EBX, XR_ESP, XR_EBP, XR_ESI, XR_EDI, XR_EIP, XR_EFL, XR__N };

xvm      *xvm_new(const xvm_cfg *cfg);
void      xvm_free(xvm *vm);
uc_engine *xvm_uc(xvm *vm);
void      xvm_get(xvm *vm, uint32_t *r);           /* XR__N registers */
void      xvm_set(xvm *vm, const uint32_t *r);
/* run fn with the registers r (in: r[XR_ESP] points at a return address
 * slot, which is replaced by the sentinel while running); out: the
 * registers after the return (esp above the popped return address).
 * Returns 1 on a normal return, 0 on a stop (xvm_why tells). */
int       xvm_call(xvm *vm, uint32_t fn, uint32_t *r);
const char *xvm_why(xvm *vm);
/* an emulated stub: when execution reaches addr, fn runs instead (it reads
 * the arguments, sets eax, and returns the stack bytes to pop besides the
 * return address) */
typedef int (*xvm_stub_fn)(void *user, xvm *vm, uint32_t addr, uint32_t *r);
int       xvm_stub(xvm *vm, uint32_t addr, xvm_stub_fn fn);
/* the guest memory as the emulator sees it (same bytes as cfg.mem) */
int       xvm_read(xvm *vm, uint32_t a, void *dst, uint32_t n);
int       xvm_write(xvm *vm, uint32_t a, const void *src, uint32_t n);
uint32_t  xvm_rd32(xvm *vm, uint32_t a);
/* trace: every transfer from [from_lo, from_hi) into [to_lo, to_hi) */
typedef void (*xvm_trace_fn)(void *user, xvm *vm, uint32_t from, uint32_t to);
void      xvm_trace(xvm *vm, uint32_t from_lo, uint32_t from_hi, uint32_t to_lo, uint32_t to_hi, xvm_trace_fn fn);
uint64_t  xvm_insns(xvm *vm);                      /* instructions run (when counting is on) */
void      xvm_count(xvm *vm, int on);

/* ---- PE ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
typedef struct {
    uint32_t base, size, entry;                    /* where it is loaded */
    uint32_t pref_base;                            /* the image base in the file */
    int      nimp;
    struct { char dll[32], name[48]; uint32_t iat; } imp[128];
    int      nexp;
    struct { char name[48]; uint32_t va; } exp[16];
    int      nsym;                                 /* from the linker map, if given */
    struct { char name[48]; uint32_t va; } *sym;
    int      nreloc;
} xpe;
/* map the PE file into guest memory at base (commit(user, a, n) must back
 * [a, a+n) first), relocate it, bind its imports to stub addresses; mapfile
 * (GNU ld -Map) may be 0.  0 on success. */
int       xpe_load(xpe *pe, xvm *vm, const char *path, const char *mapfile, uint32_t base,
                   void (*commit)(void *user, uint32_t a, uint32_t n));
uint32_t  xpe_export(const xpe *pe, const char *name);
uint32_t  xpe_sym(const xpe *pe, const char *name);  /* linker map symbol (relocated) */
void      xvm_bind_pe(xvm *vm, const xpe *pe);       /* the imports of this PE go to cfg.import */
/* nargs of the stdcall imports the plugin uses (-1: unknown) */
int       xvm_import_nargs(const char *name);

#define A(i) xvm_rd32(vm, esp + 4u + 4u * (i))
static void wr32(xvm *vm, uint32_t a, uint32_t v){ xvm_write(vm, a, &v, 4); }
static int gstr(xvm *vm, uint32_t a, char *o, int cap){
    int i = 0;
    for (; i < cap - 1; i++){ uint8_t c = 0; if (xvm_read(vm, a + (uint32_t)i, &c, 1) || !c) break; o[i] = (char)c; }
    o[i] = 0; return i;
}
static uint32_t pstr(xvm *vm, uint32_t a, uint32_t cap, const char *s){
    uint32_t n = (uint32_t)strlen(s);
    if (!cap) return 0;
    if (n > cap - 1) n = cap - 1;
    xvm_write(vm, a, s, n); uint8_t z = 0; xvm_write(vm, a + n, &z, 1);
    return n;
}
/* GetPrivateProfileStringA: [section] key = value, case-insensitive, the
 * value trimmed of blanks (comments after a value are NOT removed, as on
 * Windows: the plugin strips them itself) */
static int ini_get(const char *path, const char *sec, const char *key, char *out, int cap){
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "r");
    if (!f) return 0;
    char line[600]; int in = 0, found = 0;
    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, f)){
        char *p = line; while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;
        size_t n = strlen(p); while (n && (p[n - 1] == '\n' || p[n - 1] == '\r' || p[n - 1] == ' ' || p[n - 1] == '\t')) p[--n] = 0;
        if (*p == ';' || !*p) continue;
        if (*p == '['){ char *e = strchr(p, ']'); if (e){ *e = 0; in = !strcasecmp(p + 1, sec); } continue; }
        if (!in) continue;
        char *eq = strchr(p, '='); if (!eq) continue;
        char *k = p, *ke = eq; while (ke > k && (ke[-1] == ' ' || ke[-1] == '\t')) ke--;
        if ((size_t)(ke - k) != strlen(key) || strncasecmp(k, key, (size_t)(ke - k))) continue;
        char *v = eq + 1; while (*v == ' ' || *v == '\t') v++;
        size_t vn = strlen(v);
        if (vn >= 2 && ((v[0] == '"' && v[vn - 1] == '"') || (v[0] == '\'' && v[vn - 1] == '\''))){ v[vn - 1] = 0; v++; }
        snprintf(out, (size_t)cap, "%s", v); found = 1; break;
    }
    fclose(f);
    return found;
}
static void sa_get(xvm *vm, uint32_t a, uint32_t *ip, uint16_t *port){
    uint8_t s[8] = {0}; xvm_read(vm, a, s, 8);
    *port = (uint16_t)(s[2] << 8 | s[3]); *ip = (uint32_t)s[4] << 24 | (uint32_t)s[5] << 16 | (uint32_t)s[6] << 8 | s[7];
}
static void sa_put(xvm *vm, uint32_t a, uint32_t ip, uint16_t port){
    uint8_t s[16] = { 2, 0, (uint8_t)(port >> 8), (uint8_t)port, (uint8_t)(ip >> 24), (uint8_t)(ip >> 16), (uint8_t)(ip >> 8), (uint8_t)ip };
    xvm_write(vm, a, s, 16);
}

int aw32_import(aw32 *w, xvm *vm, const char *dll, const char *n, uint32_t esp, uint32_t *eax){
    (void)dll;
    w->calls++;
    int na = xvm_import_nargs(n);
    if (na < 0) return -1;
    uint32_t r = 0;
    if (!strcmp(n, "GetModuleHandleA")) r = A(0) ? 0u : 0x00400000u;
    else if (!strcmp(n, "GetModuleFileNameA")) r = pstr(vm, A(1), A(2), w->module_path);
    else if (!strcmp(n, "DisableThreadLibraryCalls") || !strcmp(n, "FlushInstructionCache") || !strcmp(n, "CloseHandle")){

    }
    else if (!strcmp(n, "GetCurrentProcess")) r = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    else if (!strcmp(n, "GetCurrentProcessId")) r = 100;
    else if (!strcmp(n, "GetCurrentThreadId")) r = 1;
    else if (!strcmp(n, "GetLastError")) r = w->last_error;
    else if (!strcmp(n, "GetTickCount")) r = (uint32_t)(w->now_us(w->user) / 1000);

        xvm_write(vm, A(0), &v, 8); r = 1;
    }

        int64_t us = w->now_us(w->user); uint64_t s = (uint64_t)us / 1000000u;
        uint16_t st[8] = { 2026, 10, 0, 18, (uint16_t)(s / 3600 % 24), (uint16_t)(s / 60 % 60), (uint16_t)(s % 60), (uint16_t)(us / 1000 % 1000) };
        xvm_write(vm, A(0), st, 16);
    }
    else if (!strcmp(n, "Sleep")) r = 0;
    else if (!strcmp(n, "WaitForSingleObject")) r = 0;
    else if (!strcmp(n, "GetEnvironmentVariableA")){
        char nm[128]; gstr(vm, A(0), nm, sizeof nm);
        const char *v = w->getenv ? w->getenv(w->user, nm) : 0;
        if (!v){ r = 0; w->last_error = 203; }                  /* ERROR_ENVVAR_NOT_FOUND */
        else if (strlen(v) + 1 > A(2)) r = (uint32_t)strlen(v) + 1;
        else r = pstr(vm, A(1), A(2), v);
    }

        gstr(vm, A(0), sec, sizeof sec); gstr(vm, A(1), key, sizeof key);

        if (!ini_get(w->ini_path, sec, key, val, sizeof val)) snprintf(val, sizeof val, "%s", def);
        r = pstr(vm, A(3), A(4), val);
    }

        char p[300]; gstr(vm, A(0), p, sizeof p);
        const char *b = p; for (const char *q = p; *q; q++) if (*q == '\\' || *q == '/') b = q + 1;

        r = 0xFFFFFFFFu;                                         /* INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE */
        if (k < 8){

    }

    }

    else if (!strcmp(n, "lstrcmpA") || !strcmp(n, "lstrcmpiA")){

    }

    else if (!strcmp(n, "WSAStartup")){ uint8_t z[400] = {0}; z[0] = 2; z[1] = 2; z[2] = 2; z[3] = 2; xvm_write(vm, A(1), z, 400); r = 0; }

        if (w->sock_bind && w->sock_bind(w->user, ip, port) != 0){ w->wsa_err = 10048; r = 0xFFFFFFFFu; } else r = 0;
    }
    else if (!strcmp(n, "sendto")){
        uint32_t ip; uint16_t port; sa_get(vm, A(4), &ip, &port);
        uint32_t len = A(2); uint8_t b[1500];
        if (len > sizeof b || xvm_read(vm, A(1), b, len)){ w->wsa_err = 10040; r = 0xFFFFFFFFu; }
        else { int k = w->sock_send ? w->sock_send(w->user, ip, port, b, (int)len) : -1;
               if (k < 0){ w->wsa_err = 10065; r = 0xFFFFFFFFu; } else { r = (uint32_t)k; w->bytes_sent += len; } }
    }
    else if (!strcmp(n, "recvfrom")){
        uint8_t b[1500]; uint32_t ip = 0; uint16_t port = 0;

            r = m; w->bytes_recv += m;
        }
    }

    return na;

static void on_alarm(int s){ (void)s;
    fprintf(stderr,"\n*** TIME LIMIT REACHED - the guest is still running (an endless loop or a long job)\n");
    fprintf(stderr,"    import calls: %llu  indirect: %llu  traps: %llu\n",
      (unsigned long long)g_win32_calls,(unsigned long long)g_stat_indirect_ok,
      (unsigned long long)g_stat_unsupported);
    /* The direct answer to "where did it get stuck?": the call chain of the
     * guest thread running at that moment. */
    { extern void guest_backtrace(CPU*,int);
      extern CPU *g_all_cpus[]; extern uint32_t g_all_tids[]; extern int g_all_n;
      fprintf(stderr,"    --- call chains of ALL guest threads (%d) ---\n", g_all_n);
      for (int i = 0; i < g_all_n; i++){
          if (!g_all_cpus[i]) continue;
          fprintf(stderr,"    [thread %d  tid=%u  esp=0x%08x]\n",
                  i, g_all_tids[i], g_all_cpus[i]->esp);
          guest_backtrace(g_all_cpus[i], 26);
      } }
    all_reports();
    /* In a PGO instrumented build the profile is written by atexit, which
     * _exit skips.  We look the symbol up with dlsym: on Mach-O a weak
     * declaration still fails the link when the symbol is missing. */
    { int (*wr)(void) = (int(*)(void))dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "__llvm_profile_write_file");
      if (wr) wr(); }

/* Sampler: periodically records the guest instruction being executed.
 * For finding endless loops and hot spots.                             */
#define SAMP_MAX 4096
static uint32_t g_samp[SAMP_MAX]; static int g_samp_n = 0;
static void *sampler_main(void *unused){
    (void)unused;
    extern uint32_t g_watch_prev_ip;
    long us = 2000;
    { const char *e = getenv("SAMPLE_US"); if (e) us = atol(e); }
    for (;;){
        struct timespec ts = { us/1000000L, (us%1000000L)*1000L };
        nanosleep(&ts, 0);
        /* Without WATCH=1, g_watch_prev_ip stays empty; in a COVERAGE=1 build
         * function entries update g_last_fn -> a function profile. */
        { extern uint32_t g_last_fn;
          uint32_t ip = g_watch_prev_ip ? g_watch_prev_ip : g_last_fn;
          if (g_samp_n < SAMP_MAX) g_samp[g_samp_n++] = ip; }
    }
    return 0;
}
void sampler_report(void){
    if (!g_samp_n) return;
    fprintf(stderr, "\n=== SAMPLER (%d samples) - hottest guest addresses ===\n", g_samp_n);
    /* simple count: group equal addresses */
    for (int pass = 0; pass < 12; pass++){
        uint32_t best = 0; int bc = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < g_samp_n; i++){
            if (!g_samp[i]) continue;
            int cnt = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < g_samp_n; j++) if (g_samp[j] == g_samp[i]) cnt++;
            if (cnt > bc){ bc = cnt; best = g_samp[i]; }
        }
        if (!bc) break;
        fprintf(stderr, "   0x%08x  %5d samples (%.1f%%)\n", best, bc, 100.0*bc/g_samp_n);
        for (int i = 0; i < g_samp_n; i++) if (g_samp[i] == best) g_samp[i] = 0;
    }
}

static void *guest_main_thread(void *unused){
    (void)unused;
    pthread_setname_np("guest main");
    mem_altstack_install();
    if (setjmp(g_exit_jmp)==0){
        g_exit_armed = 1;
        guest_lock(&cpu);
        PUSH32(0xDEADC0DEu);
        sub_0075bcc7(&cpu);
        guest_unlock();
        fprintf(stderr,"\n*** guest entry point RETURNED (eip=0x%08x, eax=0x%08x)\n",cpu.eip,cpu.eax);
    } else {
        fprintf(stderr,"\n*** guest exited with code %d\n", g_exit_code);
        guest_unlock();          /* ExitProcess longjmp'd out of a call holding it */
    }
    /* The window loop has to end too: in-game "Quit Game", or the WM_CLOSE
     * that Cmd-Q / the close button turned into (lifecycle.c). */
    lifecycle_guest_exited(g_exit_code);
    return 0;
}

        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC,&b);

         * frame production is here.  The default QoS is inherited, and it
         * dropped to background with the window not in front -> efficiency core. */
        pthread_attr_set_qos_class_np(&at, QOS_CLASS_USER_INTERACTIVE, 0);
        pthread_t th;

            pthread_t sth; pthread_create(&sth,0,sampler_main,0); pthread_detach(sth); }

         * first textures before the window opens; with no device they silently vanish. */
        if (getenv("WINDOW")){ extern void metal_early_init(void); metal_early_init(); }
        if (pthread_create(&th,&at,guest_main_thread,0)!=0){
            fprintf(stderr,"the guest main thread could not be created\n"); return 1; }
        if (getenv("WINDOW")){
            /* macOS: the window must be on the MAIN thread; the guest has its own thread already */
            extern void metal_run_main_loop(void);
            metal_run_main_loop();
        } else {
            pthread_join(th,0);
        }
    }

     * let open save files be closed, then stop all guest code for good
     * before the reports and exit. */
    lifecycle_drain_writes(5.0);
    if (!win32_freeze_guest(2000)) fprintf(stderr,"app: a guest thread still holds the guest lock\n");

    fprintf(stderr,"\n  hook hits: %llu   /GS failures: %llu\n",
            (unsigned long long)g_hook_hits,(unsigned long long)g_gs_fail);
    if (getenv("WATCH_ADDR")) watch_dump("end of run", 20);
    all_reports();
    return 0;
}

/* catchup_unit.c - the career's rubberbanding (runtime/catchup.c) without the
 * game: an AI driver and its car with the factors the game's 0x4172D0 leaves,
 * outside and in a career race, for each setting of catchup (NFSU2_CATCHUP).
 *   clang -O1 -g -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-function -Iruntime -o catchup_unit tests/catchup_unit.c
 * (web/test/runtime-unit.test.mjs) */
#define CATCHUP_UNIT
#include "../runtime/catchup.c"
#include <assert.h>
#include <string.h>

uint8_t *g_mem;
uint8_t g_cbits[1u << 15];

static int fails;
#define CHECK(name, c, ...) do { if (c) printf("PASS %s: ", name); else { printf("FAIL %s: ", name); fails++; } printf(__VA_ARGS__); putchar('\n'); } while (0)

#define DRV  0x01000000u
#define VEH  0x01100000u

static void commit(uint32_t a, uint32_t n){ for (uint32_t p = a >> 14; p <= (a + n - 1u) >> 14; p++) g_cbits[p >> 3] |= (uint8_t)(1u << (p & 7)); }
/* what 0x4172D0 leaves for a factor m: m in the driver, max(m, 1) in the car */
static void game(float m){ MRF32(DRV + DRV_PACE) = m; MRF32(VEH + VEH_BOOST) = m > 1.f ? m : 1.f; }
/* the setting as the runtime reads it, once per run: here again for each case */
static int mode_of(const char *env){
    if (env) setenv("NFSU2_CATCHUP", env, 1); else unsetenv("NFSU2_CATCHUP");
    g_mode = -1;
    return catchup_mode();
}

static void race(int mode, const char *name){
    float bp, bc, ap, ac;
    char n[48];
    MR32(DRV + DRV_VEHICLE) = VEH;
    /* not in a career race (free roam, Quick Race): as the game made them */
    MR32(G_CAREER + CAREER_RACE) = 0;
    game(1.3f); catchup_apply(DRV);
    snprintf(n, sizeof n, "%s-no-race", name);
    CHECK(n, MRF32(DRV + DRV_PACE) == 1.3f && MRF32(VEH + VEH_BOOST) == 1.3f, "no career race: the game's factors kept");

    MR32(G_CAREER + CAREER_RACE) = 0x01200000u;
    game(1.3f); catchup_apply(DRV); bp = MRF32(DRV + DRV_PACE); bc = MRF32(VEH + VEH_BOOST);
    game(0.6f); catchup_apply(DRV); ap = MRF32(DRV + DRV_PACE); ac = MRF32(VEH + VEH_BOOST);
    snprintf(n, sizeof n, "%s-behind", name);
    if (mode == CU_ORIGINAL) CHECK(n, bp == 1.3f && bc == 1.3f, "an AI behind gains (%.2f, car %.2f)", bp, bc);
    else                     CHECK(n, bp == 1.f && bc == 1.f, "an AI behind keeps its own pace (%.2f, car %.2f)", bp, bc);
    snprintf(n, sizeof n, "%s-ahead", name);
    if (mode == CU_OFF) CHECK(n, ap == 1.f && ac == 1.f, "an AI ahead does not wait (%.2f, car %.2f)", ap, ac);
    else                CHECK(n, ap == 0.6f && ac == 1.f, "an AI ahead waits (%.2f, car %.2f)", ap, ac);

    /* a driver without a car yet: only the driver's factor */
    MR32(DRV + DRV_VEHICLE) = 0;
    game(1.3f); catchup_apply(DRV);
    snprintf(n, sizeof n, "%s-no-car", name);
    CHECK(n, MRF32(DRV + DRV_PACE) == (mode == CU_ORIGINAL ? 1.3f : 1.f), "no car: no fault, driver %.2f", MRF32(DRV + DRV_PACE));
}

int main(void){
    g_mem = calloc(1, 0x02000000u); assert(g_mem);
    commit(G_CAREER, CAREER_RACE + 4u); commit(DRV, 0x800u); commit(VEH, 0x800u);

    CHECK("unset", mode_of(NULL) == CU_ORIGINAL, "no NFSU2_CATCHUP: original");
    CHECK("bogus", mode_of("bogus") == CU_ORIGINAL, "an unknown value: original");
    CHECK("case", mode_of("NoBoost") == CU_NOBOOST && mode_of("OFF") == CU_OFF, "any case");

    race(mode_of("original"), "original");
    race(mode_of("noboost"), "noboost");
    race(mode_of("off"), "off");

    if (!fails) puts("catchup unit tests: all passed");
    return fails != 0;
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Checks a tools/mock_discord.py frame log (and, for game runs, the game log).

    tests/discord_check.py <case> <frames.jsonl> [game log.txt [events.txt]]

Prints "PASS ..."/"FAIL ..." lines and exits 1 on any failure.  Cases are the
ones of tests/discord_unit.c (ipc late restart park noready close garbage slow
error badid noread) and of tests/discord_suite.sh (flow gamequit customize latekill malformed absent);
for those also the game log and the suite's events file (epoch seconds + what).
"""
import json, re, sys

DEFAULT_ID = '1442720706248052796'
fails = 0


def check(ok, msg):
    global fails
    print(('PASS ' if ok else 'FAIL ') + msg)
    if not ok: fails += 1


def load(path):
    rows = [json.loads(l) for l in open(path, encoding='utf-8') if l.strip()]
    # split into mock instances (a restarted mock appends to the same log)
    sessions, cur = [], None
    for r in rows:
        if r.get('dir') == 'event' and r.get('what') == 'listening':
            cur = []; sessions.append(cur)
        if cur is not None: cur.append(r)
    return rows, sessions


def activities(rows):
    """[(t, conn, activity-or-None)] for every SET_ACTIVITY the client sent."""
    out = []
    for r in rows:
        if r.get('dir') == 'in' and r.get('op') == 1 and isinstance(r.get('json'), dict) \
                and r['json'].get('cmd') == 'SET_ACTIVITY':
            out.append((r['t'], r.get('conn'), r['json'].get('args', {}).get('activity')))
    return out


def text(a):
    return None if a is None else (a.get('details', '') + ' | ' + a.get('state', ''))


def common(rows, app_id=DEFAULT_ID):
    bad = [r for r in rows if r.get('dir') == 'in' and isinstance(r.get('json'), dict) and '_raw' in r['json']]
    check(not bad, f'every client frame is valid UTF-8 JSON ({len(bad)} bad)')
    viol = [r['why'] for r in rows if r.get('what') == 'violation']
    check(not viol, 'no protocol/limit violations' + (f': {viol[:3]}' if viol else ''))
    hs = [r['json'] for r in rows if r.get('dir') == 'in' and r.get('op') == 0]
    check(all(h == {'v': 1, 'client_id': app_id} for h in hs),
          f'handshakes are {{"v":1,"client_id":"{app_id}"}} ({len(hs)} seen)')
    for s in split_conns(rows):
        n = [r['json'].get('nonce') for r in s if r.get('dir') == 'in' and r.get('op') == 1 and isinstance(r.get('json'), dict)]
        if len(n) != len(set(n)):
            check(False, f'nonces are unique per connection ({len(n)} commands, {len(set(n))} distinct)')
    return hs


def split_conns(rows):
    out, cur = [], {}
    for r in rows:
        if r.get('dir') == 'event' and r.get('what') == 'listening':
            for v in cur.values(): out.append(v)
            cur = {}
        if r.get('conn') is not None: cur.setdefault(r['conn'], []).append(r)
    out += list(cur.values())
    return out


def clean_end(rows):
    """The last connection ends with a clear (SET_ACTIVITY without activity) then CLOSE."""
    ins = [r for r in rows if r.get('dir') == 'in']
    if len(ins) < 2:
        check(False, 'clear + CLOSE at quit (too few frames)'); return
    last, before = ins[-1], ins[-2]
    ok = last.get('op') == 2 and before.get('op') == 1 and before['json'].get('cmd') == 'SET_ACTIVITY' \
        and 'activity' not in before['json'].get('args', {})
    check(ok, 'quit: activity cleared, then CLOSE')


def has_seq(acts, want):
    """want: list of (details-substring, state-substring) that must appear in this order."""
    i = 0
    for _, _, a in acts:
        if i < len(want) and a is not None and want[i][0] in a.get('details', '') and want[i][1] in a.get('state', ''):
            i += 1
    return i == len(want), i


def main():
    case, path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    game = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else None
    rows, sessions = load(path)
    acts = activities(rows)
    print(f'INFO {case}: {len(rows)} log rows, {len(sessions)} mock instance(s), {len(acts)} SET_ACTIVITY')
    for t, c, a in acts:
        print(f'INFO   t={t:7.2f} conn={c} {text(a) if a is not None else "(clear)"}'
              + (f' start={a.get("timestamps", {}).get("start")}' if a else ''))
    hs = common(rows)

    if case == 'ipc':
        ok, n = has_seq(acts, [('In the menus', ''), ('Customizing', 'Nissan 350Z'), ('Loading', 'Circuit'),
                               ('Circuit', 'Lap'), ('Career', 'Free roaming as A"B\\ é'), ('In the menus', '')])
        check(ok, f'presence sequence menus -> customize -> loading -> race -> career (odd name) -> menus ({n}/6)')
        last = [a for _, _, a in acts if a is not None][-1]
        check(last.get('details') == 'In the menus', f'coalescing: the last state shown is the latest one ({text(last)})')
        pongs = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get('dir') == 'in' and r.get('op') == 4)
        pings = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get('dir') == 'out' and r.get('op') == 3)
        check(pings > 0 and pongs >= pings - 1, f'PING answered with PONG ({pongs}/{pings})')
        clean_end(rows)
    elif case == 'late':
        check(len(hs) >= 1 and len(acts) >= 1, 'connected and showed a presence after Discord appeared')
        clean_end(rows)
    elif case == 'restart':
        check(len(sessions) == 2, 'two Discord instances (killed and started again)')
        for k, s in enumerate(sessions):
            a = [x for x in activities(s) if x[2] is not None]
            check(len(a) >= 1 and 'Circuit' in a[0][2].get('details', ''),
                  f'instance {k + 1}: race presence shown ({text(a[0][2]) if a else "none"})')
        clean_end(sessions[-1])
    elif case == 'park':
        ok, n = has_seq(acts, [('Circuit', 'Lap 2/3'), ('Circuit', 'Paused'), ('Circuit', 'Lap 2/3'),
                               ('Circuit', 'Paused'), ('Circuit', 'Lap 2/3'), ('In the menus', '')])
        check(ok, f'park: race -> paused while parked -> race -> paused -> race -> menus ({n}/6 steps in order)')
        race = [(t, a) for t, _, a in acts if a is not None and a.get('details', '').startswith('Circuit')]
        st = [(a.get('state', ''), a.get('timestamps', {}).get('start')) for _, a in race]
        laps = [s0 for x, s0 in st if x.startswith('Lap')]
        print(f'INFO park: race presences {st}')
        check(len(laps) >= 3 and laps[1] >= laps[0] + 3 and laps[2] == laps[1],
              f'park: after a 4 s park the race timer comes back re-anchored (later), after a 1 s park unchanged ({laps})')
        first_pause = next((i for i, (x, _) in enumerate(st) if x == 'Paused'), None)
        stale = [s0 for x, s0 in st[first_pause or 0:] if x.startswith('Lap') and laps and s0 == laps[0]]
        check(first_pause is not None and not stale,
              'park: the race with its pre-park timer is not shown again after the resume (waits for a fresh sample)')
        clean_end(rows)
    elif case in ('noready', 'close', 'garbage', 'slow'):
        check(len(hs) >= (1 if case == 'slow' else 2), f'{case}: handshake retried with backoff ({len(hs)} handshakes)')
        check(not [a for a in acts if a[2] is not None] or case == 'slow',
              f'{case}: no presence sent to a Discord that never became ready')
    elif case == 'error':
        check(len(acts) >= 1, 'error: presence sent and refused by Discord (ERROR reply)')
    elif case == 'noread':
        stopped = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get('what') == 'stopped reading')
        ended = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get('what') == 'flood ended')
        check(stopped >= 1 and ended >= 1 and len(hs) >= 2,
              f'noread: a Discord that stops reading is dropped and reconnected ({stopped} stopped reading, '
              f'{ended} dropped by the client, {len(hs)} handshakes)')
    elif case == 'badid':
        check(2 <= len(hs) <= 8, f'badid: refused client id retried slowly ({len(hs)} handshakes in ~4 s)')
    elif case == 'flow':
        # "Loading..." is shown only when a load lasts longer than the settle time (1 s), so it is optional here
        ok, n = has_seq(acts, [('In the menus', ''), ('Circuit — ', 'On the starting line'),
                               ('Circuit — ', 'Lap 1/3'), ('Circuit — ', 'Paused'), ('In the menus', ''),
                               ('Drift — ', 'On the starting line'), ('Drift — ', 'pts'), ('Drift — ', 'Paused'),
                               ('In the menus', '')])
        check(ok, f'flow presence sequence menus -> circuit (grid, lap, paused) -> menus -> drift (grid, points, '
                  f'paused) -> menus ({n}/9 steps seen in order)')
        loads = [text(a) for _, _, a in acts if a and a.get('details', '').startswith('Loading')]
        print(f'INFO loading screens long enough to be shown: {loads}')
        starts = [a.get('timestamps', {}).get('start') for _, _, a in acts if a]
        menus = [a.get('timestamps', {}).get('start') for _, _, a in acts if a and a.get('details') == 'In the menus']
        check(len(set(menus)) == 1, f'menus keep the session timer ({sorted(set(menus))})')
        race = [a.get('timestamps', {}).get('start') for _, _, a in acts if a and a.get('details', '').startswith('Circuit')]
        check(bool(race) and bool(menus) and min(race) > menus[0], 'the race has its own (later) timer')
        # both quick races have 4 racers (the HUD shows "/4"); the race status
        # keeps 6 entries, of which only the first [+0x24] are in use
        counts = sorted({int(m.group(1)) for _, _, a in acts if a
                         for m in [re.search(r' of (\d+)', a.get('state', ''))] if m})
        check(counts == [4], f'racer count is the 4 of the race ("of N" seen: {counts})')
        clean_end(rows)
    elif case == 'gamequit':
        ok, n = has_seq(acts, [('In the menus', '')])
        check(ok, 'menus shown before quitting')
        clean_end(rows)
    elif case == 'customize':
        ok, n = has_seq(acts, [('In the menus', ''), ('Customizing', 'Peugeot 206')])
        check(ok, 'customize shows the car on screen (Peugeot 206, the default first car)')
        clean_end(rows)
    elif case == 'latekill':
        check(len(sessions) == 2, 'Discord appeared mid-race, was killed and started again (2 instances)')
        for k, s in enumerate(sessions):
            a = [x for x in activities(s) if x[2] is not None]
            check(len(a) >= 1 and 'Circuit' in a[0][2].get('details', ''),
                  f'instance {k + 1}: the current race was shown ({text(a[0][2]) if a else "none"})')
        clean_end(sessions[-1] if sessions else rows)
    elif case == 'malformed':
        modes = [next((r.get('mode') for r in s if r.get('what') == 'listening'), '?') for s in sessions]
        print(f'INFO mock instances: {modes}')
        for m, s in zip(modes, sessions):
            h = [r for r in s if r.get('dir') == 'in' and r.get('op') == 0]
            print(f'INFO   {m}: {len(h)} handshake(s), {len([x for x in activities(s)])} SET_ACTIVITY')
        last = sessions[-1] if sessions else []
        a = [x for x in activities(last) if x[2] is not None]
        check(modes[-1:] == ['normal'] and len(a) >= 1, 'once Discord behaved, the presence was shown')
        check(sum(1 for m, s in zip(modes, sessions) if m != 'normal' and any(r.get('op') == 0 for r in s)) >= 3,
              'the client met at least 3 misbehaving Discords')
        clean_end(last)
    elif case == 'absent':
        check(len(rows) == 0 or not hs, 'no Discord, no connection')

    if game:
        log = open(game, encoding='latin-1').read()
        if case == 'gamequit':
            check('guest ExitProcess' in log, 'game: quit through its own menu (ExitProcess)')
            check('[discord] presence -> (cleared)' in log, 'game: cleared the presence at ExitProcess')
        else:
            check('quit at guest frame' in log, 'game: reached the end of its script')
            check(not re.search(r'FAULT IN GUEST|GUEST MEMORY FAULT|HOST SEGV|TIME LIMIT REACHED', log), 'game: no fault or timeout')
        check('[discord] on:' in log, 'game: Discord presence was on (mock socket only)')
        check('mock-user-secret' not in log, "game: the READY payload (user's Discord name) is never logged")
        frames = [(float(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), float(m.group(3)), float(m.group(4)))
                  for m in re.finditer(r'\[discord\] frames: wall=([\d.]+) n=(\d+) avg=([\d.]+)ms max=([\d.]+)ms', log)]
        events = []
        if len(sys.argv) > 4:
            for l in open(sys.argv[4]):
                t, _, what = l.strip().partition(' ')
                events.append((float(t), what))
        race = [t for t, w in events if w == 'race']
        end = [t for t, w in events if w.startswith('game exited')]
        if frames and race and end:
            # the steady part of the race: from 10 s after it started to 8 s before the game quit
            win = [f for f in frames if race[0] + 10 <= f[0] - 5 and f[0] <= end[-1] - 8]
            if win:
                worst = max(f[3] for f in win)
                avg = sum(f[2] * f[1] for f in win) / sum(f[1] for f in win)
                print(f'INFO race frame pacing: {len(win)} windows of 5 s, avg {avg:.2f} ms/frame, worst frame {worst:.1f} ms')
                for t, w in events:
                    if w.startswith('mock') or w.startswith('race presence') or w == 'reconnected':
                        near = [f for f in win if f[0] - 5 <= t <= f[0]]
                        if near:
                            print(f'INFO   window with "{w}": avg {near[0][2]:.2f} ms, max {near[0][3]:.1f} ms')
                if case in ('latekill', 'malformed', 'absent'):
                    check(worst < 250, f'game: no stalled frame during the race (worst {worst:.1f} ms; a blocking '
                          f'socket call would stall >= 1000 ms)')
                with open(game + '.pacing.json', 'w') as f:
                    json.dump({'avg_ms': avg, 'worst_ms': worst, 'windows': len(win)}, f)
        m = re.search(r'\[discord\] sampler: (\d+) samples, avg ([\d.]+) us, max ([\d.]+) us', log)
        if m: print(f'INFO game sampler cost: {m.group(1)} samples, avg {m.group(2)} us, max {m.group(3)} us')
    sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/bin/bash
# Game-level Discord Rich Presence scenarios (runtime/discord.c).
#   tests/discord_suite.sh <outdir> [flow gamequit customize latekill malformed absent]
#
# Every run talks to tools/mock_discord.py through NFSU2_DISCORD_IPC=<socket in
# a private temp dir>, never to the Discord app; TMPDIR and XDG_RUNTIME_DIR
# point at that dir too.  One game instance at a time.  Scenarios:
#   flow       boot -> menus -> Circuit (pause, quit to menu) -> Drift -> menus ->
#              clean quit: presence texts in order, timers, rate limit, clear + CLOSE
#   gamequit   the game's own Quit Game (ExitProcess): clear + CLOSE at once
#   customize  main menu -> Customize -> car shop -> parts: "Customizing" + the car
#   latekill   Discord absent at start, appears mid-race (connects); then killed
#              mid-race (game unaffected) and started again (reconnects)
#   malformed  Discord answers garbage, never READY, is slow, closes at once,
#              then behaves: no hang, no crash, presence shown in the end
#   absent     Discord never there: baseline frame pacing for the same race
# Needs NFSU2_DATA (game folder) unless the default ../../work/gamedata works.
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
OUT="${1:?usage: tests/discord_suite.sh <outdir> [scenario...]}"; shift
mkdir -p "$OUT"; OUT="$(cd "$OUT" && pwd)"
SEED="${NFSU2_REGFILE_SEED:-$ROOT/tests/web/seed/registry_perf4_native.txt}"
SCEN="${*:-flow gamequit customize latekill malformed absent}"
SOCKDIR="$(mktemp -d /tmp/nfsu2-dsuite.XXXXXX)"            # short: sun_path < 104 bytes
MOCK="/usr/bin/python3 -I $ROOT/tools/mock_discord.py"
MPID=""; GPID=""
cleanup(){ [ -n "$MPID" ] && kill "$MPID" 2>/dev/null; [ -n "$GPID" ] && { pkill -P "$GPID" 2>/dev/null; kill "$GPID" 2>/dev/null; }
           rm -rf "$SOCKDIR"; }
trap cleanup EXIT

now(){ /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import time; print("%.3f" % time.time())'; }
ev(){ echo "$(now) $*" >> "$D/events.txt"; echo "  [$(date +%T)] $*"; }
mock_start(){   # mode
  $MOCK "$SOCK" --log "$D/frames.jsonl" --mode "$1" --ping 5 > /dev/null 2>&1 &
  MPID=$!
  for _ in $(seq 100); do [ -S "$SOCK" ] && break; sleep 0.05; done
  ev "mock $1 started"
}
mock_kill(){    # signal
  [ -n "$MPID" ] && kill "-$1" "$MPID" 2>/dev/null && wait "$MPID" 2>/dev/null
  MPID=""; rm -f "$SOCK"; ev "mock killed ($1)"
}
game_start(){   # script, extra VAR=val...
  local s="$1"; shift
  NFSU2_REGFILE_SEED="$SEED" TMPDIR="$SOCKDIR" XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$SOCKDIR" \
    "$ROOT/tools/autorun.sh" "$D/game" NOFOCUS=2 NFSU2_TIMEOUT=420 NFSU2_FNG_LOG=1 NFSU2_STATUS_EVERY=1200 \
      NFSU2_DUMP_SCALE=0.3 NFSU2_INPUT_SCRIPT="$ROOT/tests/scripts/$s" \
      NFSU2_DISCORD=1 NFSU2_DISCORD_IPC="$SOCK" NFSU2_DISCORD_LOG=1 "$@" > "$D/game.run" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
  GPID=$!
  ev "game started ($s)"
}
game_wait(){ wait "$GPID"; local rc=$?; GPID=""; ev "game exited ($rc)"; return $rc; }
# wait until the mock log has a frame matching a regex (or the game ended)
wait_frames(){  # regex timeout_s
  local t=0
  while [ $t -lt $(( $2 * 10 )) ]; do
    grep -qE "$1" "$D/frames.jsonl" 2>/dev/null && return 0
    [ -n "$GPID" ] && ! kill -0 "$GPID" 2>/dev/null && return 1
    sleep 0.1; t=$((t + 1))
  done
  return 1
}
wait_count(){   # regex count timeout_s  (mock log)
  local t=0
  while [ $t -lt $(( $3 * 10 )) ]; do
    [ "$(grep -cE "$1" "$D/frames.jsonl" 2>/dev/null)" -ge "$2" ] && return 0
    [ -n "$GPID" ] && ! kill -0 "$GPID" 2>/dev/null && return 1
    sleep 0.1; t=$((t + 1))
  done
  return 1
}
wait_log(){     # regex timeout_s  (game log)
  local t=0
  while [ $t -lt $(( $2 * 10 )) ]; do
    LC_ALL=C grep -aqE "$1" "$D/game/log.txt" 2>/dev/null && return 0
    [ -n "$GPID" ] && ! kill -0 "$GPID" 2>/dev/null && return 1
    sleep 0.1; t=$((t + 1))
  done
  return 1
}
check(){        # case
  /usr/bin/python3 -I "$ROOT/tests/discord_check.py" "$1" "$D/frames.jsonl" "$D/game/log.txt" "$D/events.txt" \
    > "$D/check.txt" 2>&1
  local rc=$?
  grep -v "^INFO   t=" "$D/check.txt" | sed 's/^/  /'
  "$ROOT/.venv/bin/python" "$ROOT/tools/contact_sheet.py" "$D/game" 5 260 >/dev/null 2>&1
  return $rc
}

pass=0; fail=0
for name in $SCEN; do
  D="$OUT/$name"; rm -rf "$D"; mkdir -p "$D"; : > "$D/events.txt"; : > "$D/frames.jsonl"
  SOCK="$SOCKDIR/$name.sock"
  echo "== $name"
  ok=1
  case "$name" in
  flow)
    mock_start normal
    game_start discord_flow.txt
    game_wait || ok=0
    sleep 0.5; mock_kill TERM ;;
  gamequit)
    mock_start normal
    game_start discord_gamequit.txt
    # ExitProcess clears the presence at once; in a window the base port then
    # stays open until its timeout (not a Discord matter), so stop it here.
    wait_log "LOG MARK quitting" 120 || ok=0
    wait_frames '"op": 2' 20 || ok=0
    ev "CLOSE received"
    sleep 2; pkill -P "$GPID" 2>/dev/null; game_wait
    mock_kill TERM ;;
  latekill)
    game_start discord_race_long.txt
    wait_log "LOG MARK race" 180 || ok=0
    ev "race"
    sleep 8
    mock_start normal                                      # Discord appears mid-race
    wait_frames '"state": "Lap ' 40 || { ok=0; echo "  no race presence after Discord appeared"; }
    ev "race presence shown"
    sleep 10
    mock_kill KILL                                         # Discord dies mid-race
    sleep 15
    mock_start normal                                      # ... and comes back
    wait_count '"dir": "in", "op": 0' 2 40 || { ok=0; echo "  no reconnection"; }
    ev "reconnected"
    game_wait || ok=0
    sleep 0.5; mock_kill TERM ;;
  malformed)
    game_start discord_race_long.txt
    raced=0
    for m in garbage noready slow close error; do
      mock_start "$m"
      for _ in $(seq 25); do
        sleep 1
        [ $raced -eq 0 ] && LC_ALL=C grep -aq "LOG MARK race" "$D/game/log.txt" 2>/dev/null && { raced=1; ev "race"; }
      done
      mock_kill KILL
    done
    mock_start normal
    wait_frames '"details": "Circuit' 60 || { ok=0; echo "  no presence once Discord behaved"; }
    ev "race presence shown"
    game_wait || ok=0
    sleep 0.5; mock_kill TERM ;;
  customize)
    mock_start normal
    game_start mainmenu_item3.txt
    game_wait || ok=0
    sleep 0.5; mock_kill TERM ;;
  absent)
    game_start discord_race_long.txt
    wait_log "LOG MARK race" 180 || ok=0
    ev "race"
    game_wait || ok=0 ;;
  *) echo "unknown scenario $name"; ok=0 ;;
  esac
  check "$name" || ok=0
  if [ $ok -eq 1 ]; then pass=$((pass+1)); echo "PASS $name"; else fail=$((fail+1)); echo "FAIL $name"; fi
done
echo "discord suite: $pass passed, $fail failed  ($OUT)"
[ $fail -eq 0 ]

/* discord_unit.c -- tests for runtime/discord.c without the game.
 *
 *   tests/discord_unit.sh            build and run every case (with the mock)
 *   out/discord_unit <case> [mock.py tmpdir]
 *
 * Cases:
 *   text      JSON escaping, Windows-1252 -> UTF-8, clamping to 128 characters
 *   state     situation -> text on a synthetic guest memory image (game flow,
 *             race parameters and status, string/track/car tables, screens)
 *   ipc       against tools/mock_discord.py: handshake, READY, a session of
 *             presence changes incl. a burst (rate limit, coalescing), odd
 *             characters, PING/PONG, clear + CLOSE on quit
 *   bench     cost of the Present hook per frame (off, and on)
 *   absent    no Discord: no connection, ~zero CPU, quick quit
 *   late      Discord appears after the game started -> connects
 *   restart   Discord killed and started again -> reconnects, shows it again
 *   guard     which runs count as tests (no discovery without the mock), and
 *             that discovery stays inside a test's private $TMPDIR (and /tmp)
 *   park      the app parks the game in the background (no Present, no
 *             samples): a race shows "Paused" until the game samples again
 *   noready close garbage slow error badid noread
 *             a misbehaving Discord: no hang, no crash, bounded quit (noread:
 *             it stops reading, so the client's writes block)
 * Every case prints "PASS <case> ..." or "FAIL <case> ..." lines; IPC cases
 * also leave <tmpdir>/<case>.jsonl (the mock's frame log) for
 * tests/discord_check.py.  Timings are shortened here (DS_* overrides).

                             printf("\n"); fflush(stdout); }while(0)

/* ---- stubs for autotest.c ------------------------------------------- */
static const char *g_top, *g_scr;
static const char *g_batch_t[8];               /* screens initialised in the frame of g_scr */
const char *autotest_top_fng(void){ return g_top; }
const char *autotest_screen(void){ return g_scr; }
const char *autotest_screen_batch(int i){
    if (!g_batch_t[0]) return i == 0 ? g_scr : 0;           /* default: g_scr alone */
    return i >= 0 && i < 8 ? g_batch_t[i] : 0;
}
/* ---- stub for roam_game.c: free-roam friends connected ---------------- */
