/* a record as a payload has it: its car type and keys at the time */
typedef struct { uint32_t type, keys[0xaa]; } Rec;
static void rec_of(uint32_t r, Rec *x){ x->type = MR32(r + R_TYPE); for (uint32_t s = 0; s < 0xaau; s++) x->keys[s] = MR32(r + R_KEY(s)); }
static int rec_is(const Rec *x, uint32_t type, const uint32_t *keys){ return x->type == type && !memcmp(x->keys, keys, sizeof x->keys); }
/* a save of player 1's profile NAME, as garage.c's 0x52A450 makes it: the payload with the stand-ins (fp its cars'
 * fingerprint), MODPARTS.NEW, the payload as it is if that fails (raw_fp), the profile written.  What the payloads
 * had: g_pay (slot 1's car, slot 2's, the Customize car), g_raw_pay */
static Rec g_pay[3], g_raw_pay[3];
static int g_raw;
static void seen(Rec *x){ rec_of(CAR, &x[0]); rec_of(CAR2, &x[1]); rec_of(CUST, &x[2]); }
static void save_as(const char *name, uint64_t fp, uint64_t raw_fp, int write){
    modparts_hide(&g_c, DB, 0);
    seen(g_pay);
    modparts_built(0, 0, fp, name, 0);
    g_raw = !modparts_stage(0, fp, name);
    if (g_raw){ modparts_raw(&g_c, DB, 0, 1); seen(g_raw_pay); modparts_raw(&g_c, DB, 0, 0); }
    char path[700]; snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s/%s", g_dir, name, name);
    if (write) modparts_written(path, g_raw ? raw_fp : fp, name);
}
static void save(const char *name, uint64_t fp){ save_as(name, fp, fp ^ 0xfeed, 1); }
static void kept_payload(const char *name, uint64_t fp){ modparts_hide(&g_c, DB, 0); modparts_built(0, 0, fp, name, 1); }
static void profile_load(const char *name, uint64_t fp){ modparts_loaded(&g_c, DB, 0, 0, fp, name, 0); }
typedef struct { uint32_t w[8]; } Ent;
static uint32_t g_hd3, g_headname, g_headcount;
/* a MODPARTS file's entries but its head (g_hd3 its head word, g_headname/count its head entry's) */
static int read_file(const char *name, const char *file, Ent *e, int max){
    char path[700]; snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s/%s", g_dir, name, file);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return -1;
    uint32_t hd[4];
    int n = -2;
    g_headname = g_headcount = 0;
    if (fread(hd, sizeof hd, 1, f) == 1 && hd[0] == 0x504d324eu && hd[1] == 1u){
        n = 0; g_hd3 = hd[3];
        while (n < max && fread(e[n].w, sizeof e[n].w, 1, f) == 1){
            if (e[n].w[7] == 3 && e[n].w[0] == 0x4448504du){ g_headname = e[n].w[1]; g_headcount = e[n].w[2]; continue; }
            n++;
        }
    }
    fclose(f);
    return n;
}
static int count_kind(const Ent *e, int n, uint32_t kind){ int k = 0; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) k += e[i].w[7] == kind; return k; }
static void rm(const char *name, const char *file){ char p[700]; snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s/%s", g_dir, name, file); remove(p); }
static void clean(const char *name){ rm(name, "MODPARTS.DAT"); rm(name, "MODPARTS.NEW"); rm(name, "MODPARTS.OLD"); rm(name, "MODPARTS.OLD2"); }
static int there(const char *name, const char *file){ char p[700]; snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s/%s", g_dir, name, file); struct stat st; return stat(p, &st) == 0; }
/* a fresh start: no file, the profile loaded with nothing beside it */
static void fresh_load(const char *name, uint64_t fp){ clean(name); profile_load(name, fp); }
static void write_raw(const char *name, const char *file, const uint32_t *hd, const uint32_t *ent, int n){
    char p[700]; snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s/%s", g_dir, name, file);
    FILE *w = fopen(p, "wb"); fwrite(hd, 16, 1, w); fwrite(ent, 32, (size_t)n, w); fclose(w);
}
static uint32_t first_word(const char *name, const char *file){
    char p[700]; snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s/%s", g_dir, name, file);
    uint32_t b[12] = { 0 }; FILE *x = fopen(p, "rb");
    if (x){ if (fread(b, sizeof b, 1, x) != 1) b[4] = 0; fclose(x); }
    return b[4];
}

int main(void){
    g_mem = mmap(0, 1ull << 32, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_NORESERVE, -1, 0);
    if (g_mem == MAP_FAILED){ perror("mmap"); return 2; }
    snprintf(g_dir, sizeof g_dir, "%s/modparts_unit.%d", getenv("TMPDIR") ? getenv("TMPDIR") : "/tmp", (int)getpid());
    mkdir(g_dir, 0755);
    char d[700];
    snprintf(d, sizeof d, "%s/ANN", g_dir); mkdir(d, 0755);
    snprintf(d, sizeof d, "%s/MY CAR", g_dir); mkdir(d, 0755);
    commit(0x00130000u - 0x8000u, 0x10000u); g_c.esp = 0x00130000u;
    commit(0x008a1cccu, 4); commit(CAR, 0x4000); commit(TYPES, 46u * TYPE_SZ); commit(PARTS, 46u * 0xaau * 4u);
    PEUGOT = hash_of("PEUGOT"); FOCUS = hash_of("FOCUS"); ADDON = hash_of("ADDONCAR"); ADDA = hash_of("ADDA"); ADDB = hash_of("ADDB");
    AF28 = hash_of("ART_F_28"); AF29 = hash_of("ART_F_29"); AF30 = hash_of("ART_F_30"); AF12 = hash_of("ART_F_12");
    BLITZ = hash_of("BLITZ_BRW03"); AVUS = hash_of("AVUS_AF502"); TUNED0 = hash_of("TUNED_CAR_0"); SLOT1 = 0x319a8ca1u; SLOT2 = 0x319a8ca2u;
    MR32(0x008a1cccu) = TYPES;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 46u; i++){ MR32(TYPES + i * TYPE_SZ + 0xd0u) = 0x7e570000u + i; MR32(TYPES + i * TYPE_SZ + 0x840u) = i; }
    MR32(TYPES + 0xd0u) = PEUGOT; MR32(TYPES + TYPE_SZ + 0xd0u) = FOCUS;
    /* MODPACKS: one rim of a mod (its look-alike a rim of the game's) */
    g.p = calloc(1, sizeof *g.p); g.nparts = 1; g.p[0].key = BLITZ; g.p[0].stand = AVUS; g_grown = 1;
    car_init(CAR, SLOT1, PEUGOT, 0); car_init(CAR2, SLOT2, PEUGOT, 0); MR8(CAR2 + 0x7f5u) = 0;   /* (slot 2: no car yet) */
    car_init(CUST, TUNED0, FOCUS, 1);
    Ent e[1100]; int n;
    static uint32_t own[0xaa], ownb[0xaa], stockp[0xaa];
    for (uint32_t s = 0; s < 0xaau; s++){ own[s] = s >= 0x60u && s < 0x69u ? 0 : 0xadd00000u | s; ownb[s] = 0xbbb00000u | s; stockp[s] = stock_of(0, s); }

    /* af-hide */
    profile_load("ANN", 0x1111);
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) = AF28;
    save("ANN", 0x2222);
    n = read_file("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100);
    CHECK(g_pay[0].keys[0x40] == 0 && MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) == AF28 && n == 1 && e[0].w[0] == SLOT1 && e[0].w[1] == PEUGOT &&
          e[0].w[2] == 0x40u && e[0].w[3] == AF28 && e[0].w[4] == 0 && e[0].w[7] == 0 && g_hd3 == 1u && g_headcount == 1u && g_headname == name_hash("ANN"),
          "af-hide the payload had %08x in the vinyl slot, the car %08x after; MODPARTS.DAT %d entr%s, write %u (head %u), its profile %s",
          g_pay[0].keys[0x40], MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)), n, n == 1 ? "y" : "ies", g_hd3, g_headcount, g_headname == name_hash("ANN") ? "ANN" : "?");

    /* af-back */
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) = 0;                                /* as the profile holds it */
    profile_load("ANN", 0x2222);
    CHECK(MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) == AF28, "af-back the vinyl slot %08x", MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)));

    /* af-wait */
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) = 0; g_vp_have = 0;
    profile_load("ANN", 0x2222);
    uint32_t waited = MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u));
    save("ANN", 0x3333);
    n = read_file("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100);
    CHECK(waited == 0 && n == 1 && e[0].w[3] == AF28 && g_hd3 == 2u, "af-wait the slot %08x meanwhile; kept again: %d entr%s, write %u", waited, n,
          n == 1 ? "y" : "ies", g_hd3);
    g_vp_have = 1;

    /* af-elsewhere */
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) = AF12;                             /* the PC game gave it Art Factory 12 */
    profile_load("ANN", 0x3333);
    uint32_t kept = MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u));
    save("ANN", 0x4444);
    n = read_file("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100);
    CHECK(kept == AF12 && n == -1, "af-elsewhere the slot %08x; MODPARTS.DAT %s", kept, n == -1 ? "gone (nothing to keep)" : "still there");
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) = 0;

    /* rawback: the Customize car of a car type the game has not */
    fresh_load("ANN", 0x5000);
    addon(CUST, TUNED0, ADDON, own, 0x434u); convert(CUST, 0x434u);
    kept_payload("ANN", 0x5000);                                 /* (the game keeps the payload it compares with) */
    int asked = modparts_changed(&g_c, 0);
    save("ANN", 0x5555);
    int raw1 = rec_is(&g_pay[2], ADDON, own), stand1 = MR32(CUST + R_TYPE) == PEUGOT && MR32(CUST + R_KEY(0)) == stockp[0];
    save("ANN", 0x5556);
    int raw2 = rec_is(&g_pay[2], ADDON, own);
    n = read_file("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100);
    CHECK(raw1 && raw2 && stand1 && !asked && n == -1, "rawback the payload has the car as it was: %d (and at the next save %d), the stand-in "
          "after: %d; the load itself something to save: %d; MODPARTS.DAT %s", raw1, raw2, stand1, asked, n == -1 ? "none" : "MADE");
    g_mk.on = 0;

    /* trade: ADDA in slot 1, ADDB in slot 2, both the stand-in */
    fresh_load("ANN", 0x8000);
    addon(CAR, SLOT1, ADDA, own, 0x7f8u); convert(CAR, 0x7f8u);
    addon(CAR2, SLOT2, ADDB, ownb, 0x7f8u); convert(CAR2, 0x7f8u);
    car_init(CUST, TUNED0, FOCUS, 1);
    save("ANN", 0x8001);
    int both = rec_is(&g_pay[0], ADDA, own) && rec_is(&g_pay[1], ADDB, ownb);
    /* garage.c trade(): slot 1 traded, the last car (slot 2's) moves into slot 1's record, slot 2 empty */
    modparts_car_gone(0, CAR, SLOT1);
    for (uint32_t o = 4u; o < 0x7f8u; o += 4u) if (o != 8u) MR32(CAR + o) = MR32(CAR2 + o);
    memset(g_mem + CAR2 + 0x18u, 0, 0x7e0); MR8(CAR2 + 0x7f5u) = 0;
    modparts_car_moved(0, CAR2, SLOT2, CAR, SLOT1);
    save("ANN", 0x8002);
    CHECK(both && rec_is(&g_pay[0], ADDB, ownb) && g_pay[1].type == 0, "trade before: both as they were %d; after Trade Car: slot 1 %s, slot 2 %s",
          both, rec_is(&g_pay[0], ADDB, ownb) ? "ADDB as it was" : g_pay[0].type == ADDA ? "ADDA (the car sold)" : "the stand-in (ADDB LOST)",
          g_pay[1].type == 0 ? "empty" : "NOT empty");

    /* changed: a part bought on the stand-in */
    fresh_load("ANN", 0x9000);
    addon(CAR, SLOT1, ADDA, own, 0x7f8u); convert(CAR, 0x7f8u);
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x30u)) = 0x12340030u;                      /* the shop's buy */
    static uint32_t bought[0xaa]; memcpy(bought, stockp, sizeof bought); bought[0x30] = 0x12340030u;
    save("ANN", 0x9001);
    int c1 = rec_is(&g_pay[0], PEUGOT, bought);
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x30u)) = stockp[0x30];                     /* (even back to the stock part: the player's car now) */
    save("ANN", 0x9002);
    CHECK(c1 && g_pay[0].type == PEUGOT, "changed the payload has the stand-in with the part bought: %d; the next save, the part taken off "
          "again: %s", c1, g_pay[0].type == PEUGOT ? "the stand-in still" : "the old car AGAIN");
    /* ... and a tuning change alone (bytes past the keys) */
    fresh_load("ANN", 0x9100);
    addon(CAR, SLOT1, ADDA, own, 0x7f8u); convert(CAR, 0x7f8u);
    MR32(CAR + 0x348u) ^= 0x01010101u;                           /* a setup of its tuning */
    save("ANN", 0x9101);
    CHECK(g_pay[0].type == PEUGOT, "changed a tuning change alone: the payload has %s", g_pay[0].type == PEUGOT ? "the stand-in, tuned" : "the old car");

    /* trade-in: the car lot's trade-in of the car (0x516B90 there: garage.c), a stock PEUGOT in its record */
    fresh_load("ANN", 0xa000);
    addon(CAR, SLOT1, ADDA, own, 0x7f8u); convert(CAR, 0x7f8u);
    modparts_car_gone(0, CAR, SLOT1);                            /* (the hook) */
    car_init(CAR, SLOT1, PEUGOT, 0);
    save("ANN", 0xa001);
    CHECK(rec_is(&g_pay[0], PEUGOT, stockp), "trade-in the payload has %s", rec_is(&g_pay[0], PEUGOT, stockp) ? "the stock car bought" : "the OLD car");

    /* deleted-tuned: Delete Tuned Car (the record not in use) */
    fresh_load("ANN", 0xa100);
    addon(CUST, TUNED0, ADDON, own, 0x434u); convert(CUST, 0x434u);
    MR32(CUST + 0x10u) = 0;
    save("ANN", 0xa101);
    CHECK(g_pay[2].type == PEUGOT, "deleted-tuned the payload has the record as the game left it: %s", g_pay[2].type == PEUGOT ? "yes" : "the OLD car");
    car_init(CUST, TUNED0, FOCUS, 1);

    /* kinds: a later page's kind 9, and kinds 1 and 2 (never shipped), in MODPARTS.DAT */
    clean("ANN");
    car_init(CAR, SLOT1, PEUGOT, 0);
    { uint32_t hd[4] = { 0x504d324eu, 1u, 3u, 0 }, en[24] = { 0xAAAA, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9,  SLOT1, PEUGOT, 0, ADDA, 1, 7, 8, 1,  SLOT1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 2 };
      write_raw("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", hd, en, 3); }
    profile_load("ANN", 0xb000);
    save("ANN", 0xb001);
    n = read_file("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100);
    CHECK(n == 3 && count_kind(e, n, 9) == 1 && count_kind(e, n, 1) == 1 && count_kind(e, n, 2) == 1 && e[0].w[0] == 0xAAAA,
          "kinds written again as they were: %d entries (kinds 9, 1, 2: %d %d %d)", n, count_kind(e, n, 9), count_kind(e, n, 1), count_kind(e, n, 2));

    /* writefail (M-A): MODPARTS.NEW cannot be made, a raw part on slot 1's car and one waiting on the Customize car */
    clean("ANN");
    car_init(CAR, SLOT1, PEUGOT, 0); car_init(CUST, TUNED0, FOCUS, 1);
    MR32(CUST + R_KEY(0x40u)) = 0;
    { uint64_t fpc = car_fp(CUST); uint32_t hd[4] = { 0x504d324eu, 1u, 1u, 0 }, en[8] = { TUNED0, FOCUS, 0x40u, AF30, 0, (uint32_t)fpc, (uint32_t)(fpc >> 32), 0 };
      write_raw("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", hd, en, 1); }
    g_vp_have = 0;
    profile_load("ANN", 0xc000);                                 /* ART_F_30 waits (no VINYLPACKS) */
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) = AF28;                             /* bought here (a profile of before, or VINYLPACKS gone since) */
    int n_before = read_file("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100);
    snprintf(d, sizeof d, "%s/ANN/MODPARTS.NEW", g_dir); mkdir(d, 0755);   /* fopen(.NEW, "wb") fails */
    save("ANN", 0xc001);
    rmdir(d);
    n = read_file("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100);
    int raw_ok = g_raw && g_raw_pay[0].keys[0x40] == AF28 && g_raw_pay[2].keys[0x40] == AF30;
    int after = MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) == AF28 && MR32(CUST + R_KEY(0x40u)) == 0;
    int as_was = n == n_before && e[0].w[3] == AF30;
    save("ANN", 0xc002);
    int nn = read_file("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100), both_kept = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < nn; i++) both_kept += e[i].w[7] == 0 && (e[i].w[3] == AF28 || e[i].w[3] == AF30);
    CHECK(raw_ok && after && as_was && both_kept == 2, "writefail the payload made again: slot 1's vinyl %08x (%s), the Customize car's %08x "
          "(%s); after it as before: %d; MODPARTS.DAT as it was: %d; the next save keeps both: %d", g_raw_pay[0].keys[0x40],
          g_raw_pay[0].keys[0x40] == AF28 ? "ART_F_28 raw" : "NOT", g_raw_pay[2].keys[0x40], g_raw_pay[2].keys[0x40] == AF30 ? "the waiting ART_F_30" : "LOST",
          after, as_was, both_kept);
    g_vp_have = 1; MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) = 0;

    /* counter: ART_F_28 for ART_F_29, the rename cut */
    clean("ANN");
    car_init(CAR, SLOT1, PEUGOT, 0); MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) = AF28;
    profile_load("ANN", 0xd000);
    save("ANN", 0xd001);                                         /* MODPARTS.DAT: ART_F_28, write k */
    read_file("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100); uint32_t wk = g_hd3;
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) = AF29;
    save_as("ANN", 0xd001, 0, 0);                                /* MODPARTS.NEW written, the profile too (the same bytes), no rename */
    int both_there = there("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT") && there("ANN", "MODPARTS.NEW");
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) = 0;                                /* as the profile holds it */
    profile_load("ANN", 0xd001);
    int got29 = MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) == AF29;
    n = read_file("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100);
    int renamed = !there("ANN", "MODPARTS.NEW") && n == 1 && e[0].w[3] == AF29 && g_hd3 == wk + 1u;
    /* a lone MODPARTS.NEW of another profile (its head names BOB) */
    clean("ANN");
    { uint32_t hd[4] = { 0x504d324eu, 1u, 2u, 5u }, en[16] = { 0x4448504du, name_hash("BOB"), 5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 3,  SLOT1, PEUGOT, 0x40u, AF30, 0, 0, 0, 0 };
      write_raw("ANN", "MODPARTS.NEW", hd, en, 2); }
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) = 0;
    profile_load("ANN", 0xd002);
    int lone_left = g_wait[0].n == 0 && MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) == 0 && there("ANN", "MODPARTS.NEW");
    /* a MODPARTS.DAT of a page of before (head word 0, our head carried inside) beside a MODPARTS.NEW of ours: the NEW
     * came after it (such a page writes through MODPARTS.NEW and renames it, so ours could not have lived through its save):
     * ours is taken (a cut rename after an older page's save, AF28 swapped for AF29: the same cars) */
    clean("ANN");
    { uint64_t fpc = car_fp(CAR);
      uint32_t hd[4] = { 0x504d324eu, 1u, 2u, 0 }, en[16] = { 0x4448504du, name_hash("ANN"), 3, 0xd003, 0, 0, 0, 3,  SLOT1, PEUGOT, 0x40u, AF12 ^ 1u, 0, (uint32_t)fpc, (uint32_t)(fpc >> 32), 0 };
      write_raw("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", hd, en, 2);
      uint32_t hn[4] = { 0x504d324eu, 1u, 2u, 4u }, eo[16] = { 0x4448504du, name_hash("ANN"), 4, 0xd003, 0, 0, 0, 3,  SLOT1, PEUGOT, 0x40u, AF29, 0, (uint32_t)fpc, (uint32_t)(fpc >> 32), 0 };
      write_raw("ANN", "MODPARTS.NEW", hn, eo, 2); }
    g_vp_have = 0;
    profile_load("ANN", 0xd003);
    int new_wins = g_wait[0].n == 1 && g_wait[0].e[0].w[3] == AF29;
    g_vp_have = 1;
    CHECK(both_there && got29 && renamed && lone_left && new_wins, "counter the cut rename: ART_F_29 on the car %d, MODPARTS.NEW renamed at the "
          "load %d; a lone MODPARTS.NEW of another profile not taken %d; ours over a page of before's MODPARTS.DAT %d", got29, renamed, lone_left, new_wins);
    clean("ANN"); MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) = 0;

    /* kind0-unknown: a part this game lacks (ART_F_28, no VINYLPACKS) waiting on a car of a car type it lacks */
    clean("ANN");
    addon(CUST, TUNED0, ADDON, own, 0x434u); MR32(CUST + R_KEY(0x40u)) = 0;
    { uint64_t cfp = car_fp(CUST); uint32_t hd[4] = { 0x504d324eu, 1u, 1u, 0 }, en[8] = { TUNED0, ADDON, 0x40u, AF28, 0, (uint32_t)cfp, (uint32_t)(cfp >> 32), 0 };
      write_raw("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", hd, en, 1); }
    g_vp_have = 0;
    profile_load("ANN", 0xe000);
    convert(CUST, 0x434u);
    save("ANN", 0xe001);
    n = read_file("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100);
    static uint32_t want[0xaa]; memcpy(want, own, sizeof want); want[0x40] = 0;
    CHECK(n == 1 && e[0].w[3] == AF28 && e[0].w[1] == ADDON && rec_is(&g_pay[2], ADDON, want), "kind0-unknown the car as it was (its own car type, the "
          "vinyl's stand-in): %d; ART_F_28 %s", rec_is(&g_pay[2], ADDON, want), n == 1 && e[0].w[3] == AF28 ? "kept for it" : "LOST");
    g_vp_have = 1; car_init(CUST, TUNED0, FOCUS, 1);

    /* names: a profile with a space in its name */
    car_init(CAR, SLOT1, PEUGOT, 0);
    profile_load("MY CAR", 0xf000);
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) = AF28;
    save("MY CAR", 0xf001);
    n = read_file("MY CAR", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100);
    CHECK(n == 1 && e[0].w[3] == AF28, "names \"MY CAR\": its MODPARTS.DAT %s", n == 1 ? "written" : "NOT written");
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) = 0;

    /* foreign: a later page's MODPARTS.DAT kept aside, twice */
    clean("ANN");
    car_init(CAR, SLOT1, PEUGOT, 0);
    { uint32_t v2[4] = { 0x504d324eu, 2u, 1u, 0 }, a1[8] = { 0xAAAA, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 9 }; write_raw("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", v2, a1, 1); }
    profile_load("ANN", 0x10000); MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) = AF28; save("ANN", 0x10001);
    { uint32_t v2[4] = { 0x504d324eu, 2u, 1u, 0 }, b1[8] = { 0xBBBB, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 9 }; write_raw("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", v2, b1, 1); }
    profile_load("ANN", 0x10002); save("ANN", 0x10003);
    uint32_t w1 = first_word("ANN", "MODPARTS.OLD"), w2 = first_word("ANN", "MODPARTS.OLD2");
    n = read_file("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100);
    CHECK(w1 == 0xAAAA && w2 == 0xBBBB && n == 1, "foreign the first later page's file in MODPARTS.OLD: %s, the second in MODPARTS.OLD2: %s; ours "
          "written: %d", w1 == 0xAAAA ? "yes" : "NO", w2 == 0xBBBB ? "yes" : "NO", n == 1);
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) = 0;

    /* deleted: the profile deleted in the game, a new one of its name */
    clean("ANN");
    car_init(CAR, SLOT1, PEUGOT, 0);
    { uint64_t fpc = car_fp(CAR); uint32_t hh[4] = { 0x504d324eu, 1u, 1u, 0 }, ee[8] = { SLOT1, PEUGOT, 0x40u, AF28, 0, (uint32_t)fpc, (uint32_t)(fpc >> 32), 0 };
      write_raw("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", hh, ee, 1); }
    g_vp_have = 0;
    profile_load("ANN", 0x11001);                                /* ART_F_28 waits */
    int waits = g_wait[0].n == 1;
    clean("ANN"); modparts_deleted("ANN");
    save("ANN", 0x11002);                                        /* the new profile ANN, saved without a load first */
    n = read_file("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100);
    CHECK(waits && n == -1, "deleted before: a part waiting %d; the new profile of its name saved: %s", waits, n == -1 ? "nothing of the old one" : "the OLD ONE'S PARTS");
    g_vp_have = 1;

    /* cut-before-profile (M1): MODPARTS.NEW of a save written, the profile not (a page closed, a write failed): the
     * load of the profile on disk takes its own MODPARTS.DAT and removes that MODPARTS.NEW (the reviewer's R1) */
    clean("ANN");
    car_init(CAR, SLOT1, PEUGOT, 0); MR32(CAR + R_KEY(SLOT_RIM)) = BLITZ;
    profile_load("ANN", 0x12000);
    save("ANN", 0x12001);                                        /* MODPARTS.DAT: BLITZ; the profile 0x12001 */
    uint32_t keep10 = MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x10u));
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x10u)) = 0x51000999u;                      /* a part of the game's bought */
    save_as("ANN", 0x12002, 0, 0);                               /* MODPARTS.NEW staged; the profile never written */
    int staged = there("ANN", "MODPARTS.NEW");
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(SLOT_RIM)) = AVUS; MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x10u)) = keep10;   /* the profile on disk, 0x12001 */
    profile_load("ANN", 0x12001);
    int rim_back = MR32(CAR + R_KEY(SLOT_RIM)) == BLITZ, gone_new = !there("ANN", "MODPARTS.NEW");
    save("ANN", 0x12003);
    n = read_file("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100);
    int blitz = 0; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) blitz += e[i].w[3] == BLITZ;
    CHECK(staged && rim_back && gone_new && blitz == 1, "cut-before-profile the rim back from MODPARTS.DAT: %d, the unwritten save's MODPARTS.NEW "
          "removed: %d, the next save keeps the rim: %d", rim_back, gone_new, blitz);
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(SLOT_RIM)) = stock_of(0, SLOT_RIM);

    /* new-profile (M2): a profile made this session (never loaded) counts its own writes; a cut rename after its
     * second save of parts loses nothing (the reviewer's R2) */
    { char dd[700]; snprintf(dd, sizeof dd, "%s/BOB", g_dir); mkdir(dd, 0755); }
    clean("BOB");
    car_init(CAR, SLOT1, PEUGOT, 0);
    save("BOB", 0x13001);
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(SLOT_RIM)) = BLITZ;
    save("BOB", 0x13002);
    read_file("BOB", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100); uint32_t b1 = g_hd3;
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) = AF28;
    save_as("BOB", 0x13003, 0, 0);                               /* MODPARTS.NEW, the profile 0x13003, the rename cut */
    read_file("BOB", "MODPARTS.NEW", e, 1100); uint32_t b2 = g_hd3;
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(SLOT_RIM)) = AVUS; MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) = 0;
    profile_load("BOB", 0x13003);
    CHECK(b2 == b1 + 1u && MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) == AF28 && MR32(CAR + R_KEY(SLOT_RIM)) == BLITZ, "new-profile its writes %u then %u; after the "
          "cut rename the vinyl %s, the rim %s", b1, b2, MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) == AF28 ? "back" : "LOST", MR32(CAR + R_KEY(SLOT_RIM)) == BLITZ ? "back" : "LOST");
    MR32(CAR + R_KEY(SLOT_RIM)) = stock_of(0, SLOT_RIM); MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x40u)) = 0;

    /* modded-keys (M3): a modded game's car whose own keys have a mod's rim and ART_F_28: written back with them, all
     * 170 keys as loaded, nothing of it beside the profile, and nothing to save while nothing changed (the reviewer's R3) */
    clean("ANN");
    car_init(CAR2, SLOT2, PEUGOT, 0); MR8(CAR2 + 0x7f5u) = 0; car_init(CUST, TUNED0, FOCUS, 1);
    { static uint32_t k3[0xaa]; for (uint32_t s = 0; s < 0xaau; s++) k3[s] = 0xadd00000u | s; k3[SLOT_RIM] = BLITZ; k3[0x40] = AF28;
      addon(CAR, SLOT1, ADDON, k3, 0x7f8u);
      profile_load("ANN", 0x14000); convert(CAR, 0x7f8u);
      kept_payload("ANN", 0x14001);
      int ch = modparts_changed(&g_c, 0), ch2 = modparts_changed(&g_c, 0);
      save("ANN", 0x14002);
      n = read_file("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100);
      CHECK(!ch && !ch2 && rec_is(&g_pay[0], ADDON, k3) && n == -1, "modded-keys something to save with nothing changed: %d, %d; the payload's car "
            "%s; MODPARTS.DAT %s", ch, ch2, rec_is(&g_pay[0], ADDON, k3) ? "as loaded, the rim and the vinyl its own" : "NOT as loaded",
            n == -1 ? "none" : "MADE"); }
    car_init(CAR, SLOT1, PEUGOT, 0);

    /* stance-*: runtime/stance.c's entries (kind 4), as its menu sets them (set_mine) */
    commit(G_PROFILE_NAME, 0x40); commit(G_GAMEMODE, 4); commit(G_CAREER_CAR, 4); commit(G_QR_CAR, 8);
    setenv("NFSU2_STANCE", "1", 1);
    MR32(G_GAMEMODE) = 1u; MR32(G_CAREER_CAR) = SLOT1;
    car_init(CAR, SLOT1, PEUGOT, 0); car_init(CAR2, SLOT2, PEUGOT, 0); MR8(CAR2 + 0x7f5u) = 1; car_init(CUST, TUNED0, FOCUS, 1);
    {   StanceV v1 = { 50, 20, 10, 20, 110 }, v2 = { 30, 0, -10, 0, 90 }, v3 = { 0, 60, 0, 40, 120 };
        #define PROFILE(nm) do { memset(g_mem + G_PROFILE_NAME, 0, 0x24); if (nm){ snprintf((char *)g_mem + G_PROFILE_NAME, 32, "%s", (const char *)(nm)); MR8(G_PROFILE_NAME + 0x20u) = 1; } } while (0)
        #define SHOWN(h) (entry(0, (h)) != 0)
        #define HAS(h) ({ int _h = 0; for (int _i = 0; _i < g_cars[0].n; _i++) _h |= g_cars[0].e[_i].handle == (h); _h; })
        #define KIND4(nm, h) ({ static Ent _e[1100]; int _n = read_file((nm), "MODPARTS.DAT", _e, 1100), _k = 0; \
                                for (int _i = 0; _i < _n; _i++) _k += _e[_i].w[7] == 4u && _e[_i].w[0] == (h); _n < 0 ? -1 : _k; })
        char nm[8];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++){ snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "%s", i == 0 ? "ANN" : i == 1 ? "BOB" : "CAT"); clean(nm); }

        /* basic */
        PROFILE("ANN"); profile_load("ANN", 0x15000);
        set_mine(0, SLOT1, &v1); save("ANN", 0x15001);
        n = read_file("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100);
        int fp_ok = n == 1 && e[0].w[7] == 4u && (e[0].w[5] | e[0].w[6]) && ((uint64_t)e[0].w[5] | (uint64_t)e[0].w[6] << 32) == car_fp(CAR);
        g_cars[0].n = 0; profile_load("ANN", 0x15001);
        CHECK(fp_ok && SHOWN(SLOT1) && !memcmp(&entry(0, SLOT1)->v, &v1, sizeof v1), "stance-basic saved with its car's fingerprint %d, back "
              "after the load %d", fp_ok, SHOWN(SLOT1));

        /* elsewhere: another ANN's car of the same handle and car type (a restore over it), or this one with a part changed
         * in the PC game: not drawn, but kept waiting in the file; a stance set here then takes its place */
        g_cars[0].n = 0;
        MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x10u)) = 0x51000999u;
        profile_load("ANN", 0x15777);
        int drawn = SHOWN(SLOT1);
        save("ANN", 0x15778);
        int kept = KIND4("ANN", SLOT1);
        CHECK(!drawn && kept == 1, "stance-elsewhere the stance %s on a car changed elsewhere, %s in the file", drawn ? "TAKEN" : "not taken",
              kept == 1 ? "kept" : "LOST");
        set_mine(0, SLOT1, &v2); save("ANN", 0x15779);
        n = read_file("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100);
        CHECK(n == 1 && e[0].w[4] == v2.tw, "stance-replaced a stance set here takes the waiting one's place: %d entr%s", n, n == 1 ? "y" : "ies");
        MR32(CAR + R_KEY(0x10u)) = stock_of(0, 0x10u);

        /* split: split screen (garage.c's keep and end) with a load of BOB's cars into player 1's meanwhile */
        clean("ANN"); clean("BOB");
        PROFILE("BOB"); profile_load("BOB", 0x15100); set_mine(0, SLOT1, &v2); save("BOB", 0x15101);
        PROFILE("ANN"); profile_load("ANN", 0x15200); set_mine(0, SLOT1, &v1); save("ANN", 0x15201);
        stance_split_keep();
        profile_load("BOB", 0x15101);                                /* (player 1's cars from BOB's profile, the name still ANN's) */
        stance_split_back();                                        /* (the mode's end: ANN's cars back, no load) */
        save("ANN", 0x15201);
        CHECK(KIND4("ANN", SLOT1) == 1 && SHOWN(SLOT1) && entry(0, SLOT1)->v.tw == v1.tw, "stance-split ANN's stance after split screen: %s",
              KIND4("ANN", SLOT1) == 1 ? "kept" : "LOST");

        /* noprofile: set in Customize with no profile, then a profile made of that state (no load) and saved */
        clean("BOB"); g_cars[0].n = 0; g_cars[0].name[0] = 0;
        PROFILE(0); MR32(G_GAMEMODE) = 2u; MR32(G_QR_CAR) = TUNED0;
        set_mine(0, TUNED0, &v3);
        PROFILE("BOB"); save("BOB", 0x15301);
        CHECK(KIND4("BOB", TUNED0) == 1, "stance-noprofile saved with the profile made after: %s", KIND4("BOB", TUNED0) == 1 ? "yes" : "NO");
        MR32(G_GAMEMODE) = 1u;

        /* deleted: CAT deleted, a new CAT made in the session: none of the old one's */
        clean("CAT"); PROFILE("CAT"); profile_load("CAT", 0x15400); set_mine(0, SLOT1, &v1); save("CAT", 0x15401);
        clean("CAT"); modparts_deleted("CAT");
        CHECK(!HAS(SLOT1), "stance-deleted the deleted CAT's stance %s", HAS(SLOT1) ? "STILL KEPT" : "gone");

        /* order, changed: "anything to save?" */
        clean("ANN"); PROFILE("ANN"); profile_load("ANN", 0x15500);
        set_mine(0, SLOT1, &v1); set_mine(0, SLOT2, &v2); set_mine(0, TUNED0, &v3);
        kept_payload("ANN", 0x15501);
        int c0 = modparts_changed(&g_c, 0);
        set_mine(0, SLOT1, 0); set_mine(0, SLOT1, &v1);
        int c1 = modparts_changed(&g_c, 0);
        CHECK(!c0 && !c1, "stance-order something to save: %d with nothing changed, %d after a stance reset and set again as it was", c0, c1);
        kept_payload("ANN", 0x15502);
        StanceV v1b = v1; v1b.tw = 115; set_mine(0, SLOT1, &v1b);
        CHECK(modparts_changed(&g_c, 0) == 1, "stance-changed a tire width changed: something to save");

        /* later: a later page's kind 4 on SLOT2 (values out of this page's ranges): carried as it was, not drawn */
        clean("ANN"); PROFILE("ANN");
        {   uint64_t f2 = car_fp(CAR2);
            uint32_t hd[4] = { 0x504d324eu, 1u, 2u, 5u };
            uint32_t ent[16] = { 0x4448504du, name_hash("ANN"), 5u, 0x700, 0, 0, 0, 3u,
                                 SLOT2, PEUGOT, 300u, 0, 100u, (uint32_t)f2, (uint32_t)(f2 >> 32), 4u };
            write_raw("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", hd, ent, 2); }
        g_cars[0].n = 0; profile_load("ANN", 0x700);
        save("ANN", 0x701);
        n = read_file("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT", e, 1100);
        CHECK(n == 1 && e[0].w[2] == 300u && !SHOWN(SLOT2), "stance-later carried %d, drawn %d", n == 1 && e[0].w[2] == 300u, SHOWN(SLOT2));

        /* trade: Trade Car of slot 1 (slot 2's car moved into slot 1's record) */
        clean("ANN"); PROFILE("ANN"); profile_load("ANN", 0x15600);
        set_mine(0, SLOT1, &v1); set_mine(0, SLOT2, &v2);
        modparts_car_gone(0, CAR, SLOT1); modparts_car_moved(0, CAR2, SLOT2, CAR, SLOT1);
        CHECK(SHOWN(SLOT1) && entry(0, SLOT1)->v.tw == v2.tw && !HAS(SLOT2), "stance-trade slot 2's stance now slot 1's");

        /* modrim: a car with a mod's rim (its stand-in in the payload) and a stance: back after the load, nothing to save */
        clean("ANN"); PROFILE("ANN"); profile_load("ANN", 0x15700);
        MR32(CAR + R_KEY(SLOT_RIM)) = BLITZ; set_mine(0, SLOT1, &v1); save("ANN", 0x15701);
        g_cars[0].n = 0; MR32(CAR + R_KEY(SLOT_RIM)) = AVUS;        /* (the profile as saved: the look-alike in the slot) */
        profile_load("ANN", 0x15701);
        int back = SHOWN(SLOT1) && MR32(CAR + R_KEY(SLOT_RIM)) == BLITZ;
        kept_payload("ANN", 0x15701);
        CHECK(back && !modparts_changed(&g_c, 0), "stance-modrim the rim and the stance back %d; something to save with nothing changed %d",
              back, modparts_changed(&g_c, 0));
        MR32(CAR + R_KEY(SLOT_RIM)) = stock_of(0, SLOT_RIM);

        /* addon: a car of a car type this game has not (its stand-in here): a stance set on it is saved with its own car type,
         * and back after the load */
        clean("ANN"); PROFILE("ANN");
        {   static uint32_t k6[0xaa]; for (uint32_t s6 = 0; s6 < 0xaau; s6++) k6[s6] = 0xadd00000u | s6;
            addon(CAR, SLOT1, ADDON, k6, 0x7f8u);
            g_cars[0].n = 0; profile_load("ANN", 0x15900); convert(CAR, 0x7f8u);
            MR32(G_CAREER_CAR) = SLOT1; set_mine(0, SLOT1, &v2);
            int drawn6 = SHOWN(SLOT1) && stance_mine(0) != 0;
            save("ANN", 0x15901);
            int k6n = KIND4("ANN", SLOT1);
            addon(CAR, SLOT1, ADDON, k6, 0x7f8u);                   /* (the profile as saved: the car as it was) */
            g_cars[0].n = 0; profile_load("ANN", 0x15901); convert(CAR, 0x7f8u);
            CHECK(drawn6 && k6n == 1 && stance_mine(0) && stance_mine(0)->tw == v2.tw, "stance-addon drawn on the stand-in %d, saved %d, "
                  "back after the load %d", drawn6, k6n, stance_mine(0) != 0); }
        car_init(CAR, SLOT1, PEUGOT, 0);

        /* reset-all: a profile whose only entries are stances, all set back to the game's: no MODPARTS.DAT */
        clean("ANN"); PROFILE("ANN"); profile_load("ANN", 0x15800);
        set_mine(0, SLOT1, &v1); save("ANN", 0x15801);
        set_mine(0, SLOT1, 0); save("ANN", 0x15802);
        CHECK(!there("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT"), "stance-reset-all MODPARTS.DAT %s", there("ANN", "MODPARTS.DAT") ? "STILL THERE" : "removed");
        #undef PROFILE
        #undef SHOWN
        #undef HAS
        #undef KIND4
    }

    char cmd[800]; snprintf(cmd, sizeof cmd, "rm -rf '%s'", g_dir); if (system(cmd)) {}
    printf(g_fail ? "modparts_unit: FAILED\n" : "modparts_unit: passed\n");
    return g_fail;
}

{"id": "AT000691", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/tests/net/lan_race.sh", "originalBytes": 4612, "originalSha256": "e1d1182f5a4f2a78bb1c46385b07b03c4263ab5952cbc43fd3766e809a98951d", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 4612, "utf8TotalBytes": 4612}

#!/bin/bash
# lan_race.sh -- end-to-end LAN check: two game instances on the virtual LAN
# race each other to the finish (about 8 minutes).
#
#   tests/net/lan_race.sh <outdir> [circuit|sprint|drag] [races]
#
# Instance 1 hosts with the lifted server.dll (Host LAN Server, Select Car,
# Create Game), instance 2 finds it, joins (lobby Filter for sprint/drag) and
# readies; the game's AI drives both cars (drag: the synthetic pad).  Scripts
# from tools/gen_lan_race.py, run by tests/net/vlan_run.sh (NOFOCUS=2,
# loopback-only sandbox, no real network).  PASS when both instances exit 0
# through their scripts, reach the results screen (UI_PostRaceResults.fng),
# log no fault / timeout / trap / unresolved call / "[net] BLOCKED", and
# tools/lan_trace.py finds each car where its owner had it while the two
# cars are within 150 m of each other (p95 < 1.5 m, no teleports, at least
# 500 such frames).  Farther apart the game shows a car less closely (steps
# every 0.1 s from about 150-200 m, 1-2.5 m off beyond 300 m: an AI car that
# crashes at the start leaves the other alone for the rest of the race,
# netfix/lanrace-final; tools/lan_trace.py).  The results
# tables are in <outdir>/i*/ *results*.png.
# races > 1: one session of that many races (after each, the host creates a
# new game and the joiner presses Refresh and joins it); PASS also needs the
# last race's results on both, and the guest heap after each race is printed
# (a long LAN evening); the trace check covers the first race.
set -u
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
OUT="${1:?usage: tests/net/lan_race.sh <outdir> [circuit|sprint|drag] [races]}"; MODE="${2:-circuit}"; RACES="${3:-1}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"; OUT="$(cd "$OUT" && pwd)"
PY="$ROOT/.venv/bin/python"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=python3
# game data: NFSU2_DATA, else a gamedata folder two folders up from the checkout
if [ -z "${NFSU2_DATA:-}" ]; then
  for d in "$ROOT/../../work/gamedata" "$ROOT/../../gamedata"; do [ -f "$d/SPEED2.EXE" ] && NFSU2_DATA="$d" && break; done
fi
export NFSU2_DATA="${NFSU2_DATA:?set NFSU2_DATA to the game folder}"
G="$ROOT/tools/gen_lan_race.py"
case "$MODE" in
  circuit) H="--mode 0 --race-ms 120000"; J="--refresh --race-ms 120000" ;;
  sprint)  H="--mode 1 --race-ms 90000";  J="--filter 1 --race-ms 90000" ;;
  drag)    H="--mode 2 --drag --race-ms 40000"; J="--filter 2 --drag --race-ms 40000" ;;
  *) echo "mode: circuit|sprint|drag"; exit 2 ;;
esac
# shellcheck disable=SC2086
"$PY" "$G" host --name HOSTMAC --car 0 --races "$RACES" $H > "$OUT/host.txt" || exit 2
# shellcheck disable=SC2086
"$PY" "$G" join --name JOINER --car 1 --races "$RACES" $J > "$OUT/join.txt" || exit 2
NFSU2_TIMEOUT="${NFSU2_TIMEOUT:-$((900 * RACES))}" NET_EXTRA="${NET_EXTRA:-}" \
  NET_EXTRA_1="NFSU2_CAR_TRACE=$OUT/i1/cars.csv" NET_EXTRA_2="NFSU2_CAR_TRACE=$OUT/i2/cars.csv" \
  "$ROOT/tests/net/vlan_run.sh" "$OUT" --quit-after $((1800 * RACES)) -- "$OUT/host.txt" "$OUT/join.txt" > "$OUT/vlan_run.txt" 2>&1
rc=$?
why=""
[ $rc -eq 0 ] || why="$why exit=$rc"
for i in 1 2; do
  log="$OUT/i$i/log.txt"
  LC_ALL=C grep -aq "quit at guest frame" "$log" || why="$why i$i:no-quit"
  LC_ALL=C grep -aq "screen UI_PostRaceResults.fng" "$log" || why="$why i$i:no-results"
  LC_ALL=C grep -aq "FAULT IN GUEST\|GUEST MEMORY FAULT\|HOST SEGV" "$log" && why="$why i$i:fault"
  LC_ALL=C grep -aq "TIME LIMIT REACHED" "$log" && why="$why i$i:timeout"
  LC_ALL=C grep -aq "^\[trap\]" "$log" && why="$why i$i:trap"
  LC_ALL=C grep -aq "UNRESOLVED INDIRECT" "$log" && why="$why i$i:unresolved-icall"
  LC_ALL=C grep -aq "^\[net\] BLOCKED" "$log" && why="$why i$i:net-blocked"
  if [ "$RACES" -gt 1 ]; then
    LC_ALL=C grep -aq "LOG results_r$RACES\$" "$log" || why="$why i$i:no-results-r$RACES"
    # guest heap after each race (heap.c's [status] line at the results screen:
    # live/peak and the reserved VA), a long LAN evening
    echo "i$i: $(LC_ALL=C awk '/LOG results(_r[0-9]+)?$/{r=$NF; w=1; next} w && /^\[status\]/{match($0, /heap=[^ ]+ va=[^ ]+/); printf "%s %s; ", r, substr($0, RSTART, RLENGTH); w=0}' "$log")"
  fi
done
"$PY" "$ROOT/tools/lan_trace.py" "$OUT" > "$OUT/trace.txt" 2>&1
cat "$OUT/trace.txt"
"$PY" - "$OUT/trace.txt" <<'EOF' || why="$why trace"
import re, sys
t = open(sys.argv[1]).read()
near = re.findall(r'within \d+ m of the viewer: (\d+) samples, err median \S+ m, p95 (\S+) m; jumps (\d+)', t)
ok = len(near) == 2 and all(int(n) >= 500 and float(p) < 1.5 and int(j) == 0 for n, p, j in near)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
EOF
if [ -z "$why" ]; then echo "PASS lan_race $MODE ($OUT)"; exit 0; fi
echo "FAIL lan_race $MODE:$why ($OUT)"; exit 1

#!/bin/bash
# loop_run.sh -- run two game instances that talk over REAL BSD sockets on
# 127.0.0.1 (NFSU2_NET=loopback), the code path of the "lan" mode except for
# the address policy.  No hub: each instance sees itself and one peer.
#
#   tests/net/loop_run.sh <outdir> <script1> <script2>
#
# Instance 1 is 10.77.0.2 (host name LOOP-2), instance 2 is 10.77.0.3
# (LOOP-3); each is the other's NFSU2_NET_LOOPPEER.  Their game ports are
# moved apart on 127.0.0.1 (NFSU2_NET_LOOPOFFSET / NFSU2_NET_LOOPPEEROFFSET,
# defaults 23000 and 24000: 9999 -> 32999 / 33999, 9900 -> 32900 / 33900,
# 3658 -> 26658 / 27658), so a broadcast reaches the own port and the peer's,
# and a datagram or connection from a port that is not one of an instance's
# own sockets is reported as coming from the peer.  Both run under the
# loopback-only sandbox (tools/autorun.sh), NOFOCUS=2, a timeout, a quarter
# render scale and 60 fps.  LOOP_OFF1/LOOP_OFF2 change the offsets;
# NET_EXTRA, NET_EXTRA_1, NET_EXTRA_2 add instance variables; NFSU2_TIMEOUT
# (default 300).  Exit status: 0 when both instances exited 0.

PIDS=(); n=0

  n=$((n+1))

     NFSU2_NET_LOOPOFFSET="$off" NFSU2_NET_LOOPPEEROFFSET="$poff" \
     NFSU2_TIMEOUT="${NFSU2_TIMEOUT:-300}" NFSU2_FNG_LOG=1 \
     NFSU2_DUMP_SCALE=0.5 NFSU2_RENDER=scale:0.25 NFSU2_FPS=60 NFSU2_STATUS_EVERY=600 \

;; loopback-only.sb -- sandbox-exec profile for network tests of the port.
;; Everything is allowed except IP networking beyond 127.0.0.1: outgoing
;; connections and datagrams, binds and inbound traffic on any other address
;; are refused by the kernel (EPERM).  AF_UNIX (the vlan hub) is not IP and
;; stays allowed.  Note: bind(0.0.0.0) is NOT refused by this profile, which
;; is why the HLE's loopback guard rewrites wildcard binds to 127.0.0.1 itself.
;;   sandbox-exec -f tests/net/loopback-only.sb out/nfsu2_boot ...
(version 1)
(allow default)
(deny network-outbound (remote ip "*:*"))
(allow network-outbound (remote ip "localhost:*"))
(deny network-bind (local ip "*:*"))
(allow network-bind (local ip "localhost:*"))
(deny network-inbound (local ip "*:*"))
(allow network-inbound (local ip "localhost:*"))

#!/bin/bash
# vlan_run.sh -- run 2-4 game instances on one virtual LAN (tools/vlanhub.py).
#
#   tests/net/vlan_run.sh <outdir> [hub options --] <script1> <script2> [<script3> <script4>]

# render scale and 60 fps (LAN races run at 30 anyway), started 3 s apart.  The

  while [ $# -gt 0 ] && [ "$1" != "--" ]; do HUBOPT+=("$1"); shift; done

# least 30 min; a "--quit-after" among the hub options wins

"${SB[@]}" "$PY" -I "$ROOT/tools/vlanhub.py" --sock "$HUB" --pcap "$OUT/hub.pcap" --log "$OUT/hub.log" \
  --quit-after "$QA" ${HUBOPT[@]+"${HUBOPT[@]}"} &

{"id": "AT000696", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/tests/net_harness.c", "originalBytes": 84561, "originalSha256": "5e615f64b5a671dbd1e37b84ef86bc77533792602205b517452e1f8deb28947b", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 84561, "utf8TotalBytes": 84561}

/* net_harness.c -- checks runtime/winsock.c (+ net_vlan.c) against the
 * documented Windows Winsock 2 / Netbios behaviour, without the game.
 *
 * The import handlers are called the way runtime/win32.c calls them: a CPU
 * whose esp points at the stdcall arguments (return address already popped),
 * fs_base = a TEB (WSAGetLastError lives at TEB+0x34), and the guest lock
 * held; guest_wait_begin/end below release and retake an emulated guest lock,
 * so the tests can also check that waiting calls let other threads run.
 *
 * Network safety: the harness forces NFSU2_NET_HARNESS=1, so the HLE can only
 * run in "off", "loopback" (127.0.0.1 only; anything else is BLOCKED) or
 * "vlan" (AF_UNIX to tools/vlanhub.py) mode.  The few plain host sockets the
 * tests open themselves (a fake peer) are bound to 127.0.0.1.  The "lan
 * identity" check only reads the interface list and the routing table.
 *
 *   clang -O1 -Iruntime -o out/net_harness tests/net_harness.c runtime/winsock.c \
 *         runtime/net_vlan.c runtime/mem.c
 *   out/net_harness [--vlan-hub <python> <tools/vlanhub.py>]   # exit 0 = all pass
 */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "winsock.h"
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <poll.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

int winsock_call(CPU *c, const char *dll, const char *n, uint32_t *out);
void winsock_test_reset(void);
uint64_t winsock_blocked_count(void);

/* winsock.c overrides the lifted NetTick (sub_0074b730); not used here */
void sub_0074b730_orig(CPU *c){ (void)c; }
/* bundle.m's Local Network notice (a weak reference in winsock.c): counted */
static int g_notices;
void app_local_network_notice(void){ g_notices++; }
/* win32.c's per-thread last error (TEB+0x34), which winsock.c uses */
void win32_set_last_error(CPU *c, uint32_t e){
    if (c && c->fs_base && mem_is_committed(c->fs_base + 0x34u)) MR32(c->fs_base + 0x34u) = e;
}
uint32_t win32_get_last_error(CPU *c){
    return (c && c->fs_base && mem_is_committed(c->fs_base + 0x34u)) ? MR32(c->fs_base + 0x34u) : 0u;
}

/* ---- emulated guest lock ---- */
static pthread_mutex_t g_gil = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static _Atomic int g_releases;
void guest_wait_begin(void){ atomic_fetch_add(&g_releases, 1); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_gil); }
void guest_wait_end(void){ pthread_mutex_lock(&g_gil); }

static int g_pass, g_fail;
static const char *g_section = "";
static void check(const char *what, int ok, const char *fmt, ...){
    char b[300] = "";
    if (fmt){ va_list ap; va_start(ap, fmt); vsnprintf(b, sizeof b, fmt, ap); va_end(ap); }
    printf("  %s  %-58s %s\n", ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL", what, b);
    if (ok) g_pass++; else { g_fail++; fprintf(stderr, "FAILED [%s] %s %s\n", g_section, what, b); }
}
static void section(const char *s){ g_section = s; printf("%s\n", s); }

/* ---- guest threads ---- */
typedef struct { CPU cpu; uint32_t teb, stack; } Th;
static Th T[4];
static void th_init(Th *t, int i){
    memset(t, 0, sizeof *t);
    t->teb = 0x00C00000u + 0x20000u * (uint32_t)i;
    t->stack = 0x00D00000u + 0x10000u * (uint32_t)(i + 1);
    mem_commit(t->teb, 0x2000); memset(g_mem + t->teb, 0, 0x2000);
    MR32(t->teb + 0x18) = t->teb; MR32(t->teb + 0x24) = 1u + (uint32_t)i;
    t->cpu.fs_base = t->teb;
}
static uint32_t wcv(Th *t, const char *name, int n, va_list ap){
    CPU *c = &t->cpu;
    c->esp = t->stack - 0x400u;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) MR32(c->esp + 4u * (uint32_t)i) = va_arg(ap, uint32_t);
    c->eip = 0x00C0FFEEu;
    uint32_t r = 0xDEADDEADu;
    const char *dll = !strcmp(name, "Netbios") ? "netapi32.dll" : "ws2_32.dll";
    if (!winsock_call(c, dll, name, &r)){ fprintf(stderr, "winsock_call does not handle %s\n", name); exit(3); }
    return r;
}
static uint32_t wc(Th *t, const char *name, int n, ...){
    va_list ap; va_start(ap, n); uint32_t r = wcv(t, name, n, ap); va_end(ap); return r;
}
#define W(...) wc(&T[0], __VA_ARGS__)
static uint32_t err0(void){ return wc(&T[0], "WSAGetLastError", 0); }
#define SE 0xFFFFFFFFu                         /* SOCKET_ERROR / INVALID_SOCKET */

/* ---- guest scratch memory ---- */
#define GB 0x00E00000u
static uint32_t g_bump = GB;
static uint32_t galloc(uint32_t n){ uint32_t p = (g_bump + 15u) & ~15u; g_bump = p + n; memset(g_mem + p, 0, n); return p; }
static uint32_t sa(const char *ip, uint16_t port){
    uint32_t p = galloc(16);
    struct in_addr a; inet_pton(AF_INET, ip, &a);
    MR16(p) = 2; MR8(p + 2) = (uint8_t)(port >> 8); MR8(p + 3) = (uint8_t)port; MR32(p + 4) = a.s_addr;
    memset(g_mem + p + 8, 0xA5, 8);            /* sin_zero garbage: Winsock ignores it, DirtySock stores data there */
    return p;
}
static uint32_t u32p(uint32_t v){ uint32_t p = galloc(4); MR32(p) = v; return p; }
static uint16_t sa_port(uint32_t p){ return (uint16_t)(MR8(p + 2) << 8 | MR8(p + 3)); }
static const char *sa_ip(uint32_t p, char *b){ const uint8_t *q = g_mem + p + 4; snprintf(b, 16, "%u.%u.%u.%u", q[0], q[1], q[2], q[3]); return b; }
static uint32_t fdset(int n, const uint32_t *h){
    uint32_t p = galloc(4 + 4u * (uint32_t)(n > 64 ? n : 64));
    MR32(p) = (uint32_t)n; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) MR32(p + 4 + 4u * (uint32_t)i) = h[i];
    return p;
}
static uint32_t tv(int sec, int usec){ uint32_t p = galloc(8); MR32(p) = (uint32_t)sec; MR32(p + 4) = (uint32_t)usec; return p; }
static double now_s(void){ struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts); return ts.tv_sec + ts.tv_nsec / 1e9; }
static uint32_t gstr(const char *s){ uint32_t p = galloc((uint32_t)strlen(s) + 1); strcpy((char *)g_mem + p, s); return p; }

static void startup_mode(const char *mode){
    setenv("NFSU2_NET", mode, 1);
    winsock_test_reset();
}
static uint32_t udp_bound(const char *ip, uint16_t port){
    uint32_t s = W("socket", 3, 2, 2, 0);
    if (s == SE) return SE;
    uint32_t one = u32p(1);
    W("ioctlsocket", 3, s, 0x8004667Eu, one);
    W("setsockopt", 5, s, 0xFFFFu, 0x20u, one, 4u);
    if (W("bind", 3, s, sa(ip, port), 16u) != 0){ W("closesocket", 1, s); return SE; }
    return s;
}
static uint16_t local_port(uint32_t s){
    uint32_t a = galloc(16), l = u32p(16);
    if (W("getsockname", 3, s, a, l)) return 0;
    return sa_port(a);
}
static int wait_readable(Th *t, uint32_t s, int ms){
    uint32_t r = wc(t, "select", 5, 0u, fdset(1, &s), 0u, 0u, tv(ms / 1000, (ms % 1000) * 1000));
    return r == 1;
}

/* ======================================================================= */
static void t_startup(void){
    section("WSAStartup / WSACleanup / WSADATA");
    startup_mode("loopback");
    check("socket before WSAStartup -> WSANOTINITIALISED", W("socket", 3, 2, 2, 0) == SE && err0() == WSANOTINITIALISED, "err %u", err0());
    uint32_t wd = galloc(400);
    memset(g_mem + wd, 0xCC, 400);
    uint32_t r = W("WSAStartup", 2, 0x0002u, wd);
    check("WSAStartup(2.0) returns 0", r == 0, "r=%u", r);
    check("WSADATA.wVersion = 0x0002, wHighVersion = 0x0202", MR16(wd) == 0x0002 && MR16(wd + 2) == 0x0202, "%04x %04x", MR16(wd), MR16(wd + 2));
    check("szDescription at +4, szSystemStatus at +261", !strcmp((char *)g_mem + wd + 4, "WinSock 2.0") && !strcmp((char *)g_mem + wd + 261, "Running"), 0);
    check("iMaxSockets/iMaxUdpDg 0, lpVendorInfo NULL at +396", MR16(wd + 390) == 0 && MR16(wd + 392) == 0 && MR32(wd + 396) == 0, 0);
    check("the swapped wVersion passes DirtySock's >= 0x200 gate", ((MR16(wd) & 0xFF) << 8 | MR16(wd) >> 8) >= 0x200, 0);
    uint32_t wd2 = galloc(400);
    check("WSAStartup(2.2) -> wVersion 0x0202", W("WSAStartup", 2, 0x0202u, wd2) == 0 && MR16(wd2) == 0x0202, 0);
    check("WSAStartup(0.0) -> WSAVERNOTSUPPORTED", W("WSAStartup", 2, 0x0000u, wd2) == WSAVERNOTSUPPORTED, 0);
    check("WSAStartup(NULL) -> WSAEFAULT", W("WSAStartup", 2, 0x0002u, 0u) == WSAEFAULT, 0);
    uint32_t s = udp_bound("0.0.0.0", 0);
    check("first WSACleanup keeps sockets (reference counted)", W("WSACleanup", 0) == 0 && W("closesocket", 1, s) == 0, 0);
    s = W("socket", 3, 2, 2, 0);
    check("last WSACleanup returns 0", W("WSACleanup", 0) == 0, 0);
    check("... and closed the sockets: WSANOTINITIALISED now", W("closesocket", 1, s) == SE && err0() == WSANOTINITIALISED, "err %u", err0());
    W("WSAStartup", 2, 0x0002u, wd);
    check("after a new WSAStartup the old handle is gone (WSAENOTSOCK)", W("closesocket", 1, s) == SE && err0() == WSAENOTSOCK, "err %u", err0());
    check("WSACleanup without startup count -> SOCKET_ERROR", W("WSACleanup", 0) == 0 && W("WSACleanup", 0) == SE && err0() == WSANOTINITIALISED, 0);
    W("WSAStartup", 2, 0x0002u, wd);
}

static void t_sockets(void){
    section("socket handles, bind, sockaddr layout");
    uint32_t s1 = W("socket", 3, 2, 2, 0), s2 = W("socket", 3, 2, 1, 0), s3 = W("socket", 3, 2, 3, 1);
    check("socket(UDP), socket(TCP), socket(RAW, ICMP) succeed", s1 != SE && s2 != SE && s3 != SE, "%x %x %x", s1, s2, s3);
    check("SOCKETs are non-zero multiples of 4, all different", s1 && !(s1 & 3) && !(s2 & 3) && s1 != s2 && s2 != s3, 0);
    check("socket(AF_INET6=23) -> WSAEAFNOSUPPORT", W("socket", 3, 23, 2, 0) == SE && err0() == WSAEAFNOSUPPORT, 0);
    check("socket(RAW, TCP) -> WSAEPROTONOSUPPORT", W("socket", 3, 2, 3, 6) == SE && err0() == WSAEPROTONOSUPPORT, 0);
    check("socket(type 5) -> WSAESOCKTNOSUPPORT", W("socket", 3, 2, 5, 0) == SE && err0() == WSAESOCKTNOSUPPORT, 0);
    check("closesocket(bogus) -> WSAENOTSOCK", W("closesocket", 1, 0x1235u) == SE && err0() == WSAENOTSOCK, 0);
    check("bind with namelen 8 -> WSAEFAULT", W("bind", 3, s1, sa("0.0.0.0", 0), 8u) == SE && err0() == WSAEFAULT, 0);
    uint32_t bad = sa("0.0.0.0", 0); MR16(bad) = 23;
    check("bind AF_INET6 sockaddr -> WSAEAFNOSUPPORT", W("bind", 3, s1, bad, 16u) == SE && err0() == WSAEAFNOSUPPORT, 0);
    check("bind 0.0.0.0:47123", W("bind", 3, s1, sa("0.0.0.0", 47123), 16u) == 0, "err %u", err0());
    uint32_t a = galloc(16), l = u32p(99); memset(g_mem + a, 0xEE, 16);
    W("getsockname", 3, s1, a, l);
    check("getsockname: u16 family 2 (no BSD sin_len), port, 0.0.0.0", g_mem[a] == 2 && g_mem[a + 1] == 0 && sa_port(a) == 47123 && MR32(a + 4) == 0, "%02x %02x", g_mem[a], g_mem[a + 1]);
    check("getsockname: sin_zero cleared, namelen written 16", MR32(a + 8) == 0 && MR32(a + 12) == 0 && MR32(l) == 16, "len %u", MR32(l));
    check("getsockname namelen 15 -> WSAEFAULT", W("getsockname", 3, s1, a, u32p(15)) == SE && err0() == WSAEFAULT, 0);
    check("bind twice -> WSAEINVAL", W("bind", 3, s1, sa("0.0.0.0", 47124), 16u) == SE && err0() == WSAEINVAL, 0);
    uint32_t s4 = W("socket", 3, 2, 2, 0);
    check("second UDP bind to the same port -> WSAEADDRINUSE", W("bind", 3, s4, sa("0.0.0.0", 47123), 16u) == SE && err0() == WSAEADDRINUSE, "err %u", err0());
    check("getsockname on an unbound socket -> WSAEINVAL", W("getsockname", 3, s4, a, u32p(16)) == SE && err0() == WSAEINVAL, 0);
    check("shutdown(SD_BOTH) on an unconnected UDP socket -> 0 (Windows)", W("shutdown", 2, s1, 2u) == 0, 0);
    check("shutdown on an unconnected TCP socket -> WSAENOTCONN", W("shutdown", 2, s2, 2u) == SE && err0() == WSAENOTCONN, 0);
    check("listen on UDP -> WSAEOPNOTSUPP", W("listen", 2, s4, 5u) == SE && err0() == WSAEOPNOTSUPP, 0);
    check("listen on an unbound TCP socket -> WSAEINVAL", W("listen", 2, s2, 5u) == SE && err0() == WSAEINVAL, 0);
    check("accept on a non-listening socket -> WSAEINVAL", W("accept", 3, s2, 0u, 0u) == SE && err0() == WSAEINVAL, 0);
    check("getpeername on unconnected TCP -> WSAENOTCONN", W("getpeername", 3, s2, a, u32p(16)) == SE && err0() == WSAENOTCONN, 0);
    check("htons(0x1234) = 0x3412, htonl(0x11223344) = 0x44332211", W("htons", 1, 0x1234u) == 0x3412 && W("htonl", 1, 0x11223344u) == 0x44332211u, 0);
    check("ntohs, ntohl", W("ntohs", 1, 0xABCDu) == 0xCDAB && W("ntohl", 1, 0x01020304u) == 0x04030201u, 0);
    W("closesocket", 1, s1); W("closesocket", 1, s2); W("closesocket", 1, s3); W("closesocket", 1, s4);
}

static void t_udp(void){
    section("UDP: datagrams, WSAEMSGSIZE, WSAEWOULDBLOCK, broadcast, loopback guard");
    uint32_t r = udp_bound("0.0.0.0", 47200), s = udp_bound("0.0.0.0", 0);
    uint16_t sp = local_port(s);
    uint32_t buf = galloc(2048), from = galloc(16), fl = u32p(16);
    check("non-blocking recvfrom on an empty socket -> WSAEWOULDBLOCK", W("recvfrom", 6, r, buf, 2048u, 0u, from, fl) == SE && err0() == WSAEWOULDBLOCK, "err %u", err0());
    uint32_t msg = galloc(100); for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) MR8(msg + (uint32_t)i) = (uint8_t)i;
    check("sendto own address 10.77.0.2 returns the length", W("sendto", 6, s, msg, 100u, 0u, sa("10.77.0.2", 47200), 16u) == 100, "err %u", err0());
    MR32(fl) = 16;
    uint32_t n = wait_readable(&T[0], r, 1000) ? W("recvfrom", 6, r, buf, 2048u, 0u, from, fl) : SE;
    char b[16];
    check("recvfrom gets it, from = 10.77.0.2:<sender port>", n == 100 && !memcmp(g_mem + buf, g_mem + msg, 100) && !strcmp(sa_ip(from, b), "10.77.0.2") && sa_port(from) == sp, "n=%u from %s:%u", n, b, sa_port(from));
    check("from: family 2, sin_zero 0, fromlen 16", MR16(from) == 2 && MR32(from + 8) == 0 && MR32(fl) == 16, 0);
    /* truncation */
    W("sendto", 6, s, msg, 100u, 0u, sa("10.77.0.2", 47200), 16u);
    uint32_t m2 = galloc(8); memcpy(g_mem + m2, "SECOND!!", 8);
    W("sendto", 6, s, m2, 8u, 0u, sa("10.77.0.2", 47200), 16u);
    wait_readable(&T[0], r, 1000);
    memset(g_mem + buf, 0, 64);
    n = W("recvfrom", 6, r, buf, 10u, 0u, from, fl);
    check("10-byte buffer for a 100-byte datagram -> WSAEMSGSIZE", n == SE && err0() == WSAEMSGSIZE, "n=%d err %u", (int)n, err0());
    check("... buffer holds the first 10 bytes", !memcmp(g_mem + buf, g_mem + msg, 10) && MR8(buf + 10) == 0, 0);
    wait_readable(&T[0], r, 1000);
    n = W("recvfrom", 6, r, buf, 2048u, 0u, from, fl);
    check("... and the rest is discarded: the next recv is the next datagram", n == 8 && !memcmp(g_mem + buf, "SECOND!!", 8), "n=%d", (int)n);
    /* MSG_PEEK */
    W("sendto", 6, s, m2, 8u, 0u, sa("10.77.0.2", 47200), 16u);
    wait_readable(&T[0], r, 1000);
    uint32_t nr = galloc(4);
    W("ioctlsocket", 3, r, 0x4004667Fu, nr);
    check("FIONREAD on UDP = size of the next datagram", MR32(nr) == 8, "%u", MR32(nr));
    n = W("recvfrom", 6, r, buf, 2048u, 2u, from, fl);
    uint32_t n2 = W("recvfrom", 6, r, buf, 2048u, 0u, from, fl);
    check("MSG_PEEK leaves the datagram queued", n == 8 && n2 == 8, 0);
    /* broadcast */
    uint32_t nb = W("socket", 3, 2, 2, 0);
    W("bind", 3, nb, sa("0.0.0.0", 0), 16u);
    check("broadcast without SO_BROADCAST -> WSAEACCES", W("sendto", 6, nb, msg, 10u, 0u, sa("255.255.255.255", 47200), 16u) == SE && err0() == WSAEACCES, "err %u", err0());
    /* A fake peer at 127.0.0.1:48999 = 10.77.0.3:47999 (NFSU2_NET_LOOPMAP set
     * in main).  Not 9999 itself: other loopback-mode game runs on this Mac
     * may hold 127.0.0.1:9999 (loopback mode has one IP for everyone). */
    int peer = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, 0);
    struct sockaddr_in pa = { sizeof pa, AF_INET, htons(48999), { htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK) }, { 0 } };
    int pb = bind(peer, (struct sockaddr *)&pa, sizeof pa);
    uint32_t g9 = udp_bound("0.0.0.0", 47999);
    check("guest binds 0.0.0.0:47999 (host 127.0.0.1:47999), peer 127.0.0.1:48999", g9 != SE && pb == 0, "err %u, peer bind %d", err0(), pb);
    uint32_t q = galloc(384); memcpy(g_mem + q, "gEA\0\0\0\0\0?", 9);
    check("broadcast 255.255.255.255:47999 with SO_BROADCAST", W("sendto", 6, g9, q, 384u, 0u, sa("255.255.255.255", 47999), 16u) == 384, "err %u", err0());
    MR32(fl) = 16;
    n = wait_readable(&T[0], g9, 1000) ? W("recvfrom", 6, g9, buf, 2048u, 0u, from, fl) : SE;
    check("own copy arrives (Windows loops broadcasts back), from 10.77.0.2:47999", n == 384 && !strcmp(sa_ip(from, b), "10.77.0.2") && sa_port(from) == 47999, "n=%d %s:%u", (int)n, b, sa_port(from));
    uint8_t pbuf[512]; struct sockaddr_in pf; socklen_t pfl = sizeof pf;
    struct pollfd pp = { peer, POLLIN, 0 }; poll(&pp, 1, 1000);
    ssize_t pn = recvfrom(peer, pbuf, sizeof pbuf, MSG_DONTWAIT, (struct sockaddr *)&pf, &pfl);
    check("the mapped peer port gets the broadcast too", pn == 384 && !memcmp(pbuf, "gEA", 3), "pn=%zd", pn);
    struct sockaddr_in dst = { sizeof dst, AF_INET, htons(47999), { htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK) }, { 0 } };
    sendto(peer, "gEA advert", 10, 0, (struct sockaddr *)&dst, sizeof dst);
    MR32(fl) = 16;
    n = wait_readable(&T[0], g9, 1000) ? W("recvfrom", 6, g9, buf, 2048u, 0u, from, fl) : SE;
    check("the peer's unicast reply appears from 10.77.0.3:47999", n == 10 && !strcmp(sa_ip(from, b), "10.77.0.3") && sa_port(from) == 47999, "n=%d %s:%u", (int)n, b, sa_port(from));
    check("unicast to the peer (10.77.0.3:47999 -> 127.0.0.1:48999)", W("sendto", 6, g9, msg, 5u, 0u, sa("10.77.0.3", 47999), 16u) == 5, 0);
    poll(&pp, 1, 1000); pn = recv(peer, pbuf, sizeof pbuf, MSG_DONTWAIT);
    check("... arrives at the peer", pn == 5, "pn=%zd", pn);
    close(peer);
    /* guard */
    uint64_t b0 = winsock_blocked_count();
    check("sendto 8.8.8.8:53 -> WSAENETUNREACH (BLOCKED)", W("sendto", 6, s, msg, 10u, 0u, sa("8.8.8.8", 53), 16u) == SE && err0() == WSAENETUNREACH, "err %u", err0());
    check("sendto 192.168.178.1:9999 -> WSAENETUNREACH (BLOCKED)", W("sendto", 6, s, msg, 10u, 0u, sa("192.168.178.1", 9999), 16u) == SE && err0() == WSAENETUNREACH, 0);
    check("UDP connect 24.1.1.1 (route probe) -> WSAENETUNREACH (BLOCKED)", W("connect", 3, nb, sa("24.1.1.1", 0), 16u) == SE && err0() == WSAENETUNREACH, 0);
    uint32_t bb = W("socket", 3, 2, 2, 0);
    check("bind 192.168.1.5 -> WSAEADDRNOTAVAIL (BLOCKED)", W("bind", 3, bb, sa("192.168.1.5", 0), 16u) == SE && err0() == WSAEADDRNOTAVAIL, 0);
    check("every refusal counted as BLOCKED", winsock_blocked_count() == b0 + 4, "%llu", (unsigned long long)(winsock_blocked_count() - b0));
    check("sendto the peer's unmapped port: silently lost, like a LAN", W("sendto", 6, s, msg, 10u, 0u, sa("10.77.0.3", 5555), 16u) == 10 && winsock_blocked_count() == b0 + 4, 0);
    /* connected UDP */
    uint32_t cu = W("socket", 3, 2, 2, 0);
    check("UDP connect to own address, then send() and getpeername", W("connect", 3, cu, sa("10.77.0.2", 47200), 16u) == 0 && W("send", 4, cu, msg, 7u, 0u) == 7, "err %u", err0());
    uint32_t pa2 = galloc(16);
    check("getpeername on connected UDP", W("getpeername", 3, cu, pa2, u32p(16)) == 0 && sa_port(pa2) == 47200, 0);
    wait_readable(&T[0], r, 1000);
    check("... the datagram arrives", W("recv", 4, r, buf, 2048u, 0u) == 7, 0);
    check("send on unconnected UDP -> WSAENOTCONN", W("send", 4, s, msg, 7u, 0u) == SE && err0() == WSAENOTCONN, 0);
    check("recvfrom on an unbound UDP socket -> WSAEINVAL", W("recvfrom", 6, bb, buf, 10u, 0u, 0u, 0u) == SE && err0() == WSAEINVAL, 0);
    uint32_t big = galloc(70000);
    check("sendto 65508 bytes -> WSAEMSGSIZE", W("sendto", 6, s, big, 65508u, 0u, sa("10.77.0.2", 47200), 16u) == SE && err0() == WSAEMSGSIZE, 0);
    uint32_t hs[] = { r, s, nb, g9, bb, cu };
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) W("closesocket", 1, hs[i]);
}

static void t_tcp(void){
    section("TCP: non-blocking connect, select semantics, accept, close/reset, SIGPIPE");
    uint32_t one = u32p(1), w, x;
    /* refused */
    uint32_t c1 = W("socket", 3, 2, 1, 0);
    W("ioctlsocket", 3, c1, 0x8004667Eu, one);
    uint32_t r = W("connect", 3, c1, sa("10.77.0.2", 47391), 16u);
    check("non-blocking connect to a closed port -> WSAEWOULDBLOCK", r == SE && err0() == WSAEWOULDBLOCK, "err %u", err0());
    w = fdset(1, &c1); x = fdset(1, &c1);
    uint32_t rs = fdset(1, &c1);
    r = W("select", 5, 0u, rs, w, x, tv(1, 0));
    check("select: a failed connect is in exceptfds only (not readable/writable)", r == 1 && MR32(x) == 1 && MR32(w) == 0 && MR32(rs) == 0, "r=%d w=%u x=%u r=%u", (int)r, MR32(w), MR32(x), MR32(rs));
    uint32_t ov = galloc(4), ol = u32p(4);
    W("getsockopt", 5, c1, 0xFFFFu, 0x1007u, ov, ol);
    check("getsockopt(SO_ERROR) = WSAECONNREFUSED", MR32(ov) == WSAECONNREFUSED && MR32(ol) == 4, "%u", MR32(ov));
    MR32(ol) = 4; W("getsockopt", 5, c1, 0xFFFFu, 0x1007u, ov, ol);
    check("... and is cleared once read", MR32(ov) == 0, "%u", MR32(ov));
    /* the same set as write and except set, as server.dll passes it */
    uint32_t c2 = W("socket", 3, 2, 1, 0); W("ioctlsocket", 3, c2, 0x8004667Eu, one);
    W("connect", 3, c2, sa("10.77.0.2", 47391), 16u);
    uint32_t al = fdset(1, &c2);
    r = W("select", 5, 0u, 0u, al, al, tv(1, 0));
    check("aliased write/except set: count 1, the set ends up holding the socket", r == 1 && MR32(al) == 1 && MR32(al + 4) == c2, "r=%d n=%u", (int)r, MR32(al));
    /* success */
    uint32_t ls = W("socket", 3, 2, 1, 0);
    W("bind", 3, ls, sa("0.0.0.0", 0), 16u);
    uint16_t LP = local_port(ls);
    check("listen", W("listen", 2, ls, 5u) == 0, 0);
    W("ioctlsocket", 3, ls, 0x8004667Eu, one);
    uint32_t acc0 = galloc(16), accl = u32p(16);
    check("accept with nothing pending (non-blocking) -> WSAEWOULDBLOCK", W("accept", 3, ls, acc0, accl) == SE && err0() == WSAEWOULDBLOCK, 0);
    uint32_t c3 = W("socket", 3, 2, 1, 0); W("ioctlsocket", 3, c3, 0x8004667Eu, one);
    r = W("connect", 3, c3, sa("10.77.0.2", LP), 16u);
    check("non-blocking connect to a listener -> WSAEWOULDBLOCK", r == SE && err0() == WSAEWOULDBLOCK, 0);
        w = fdset(1, &c3); x = fdset(1, &c3);
    r = W("select", 5, 1u, 0u, w, x, tv(1, 0));
    check("select: a completed connect is writable, not in exceptfds", r == 1 && MR32(w) == 1 && MR32(x) == 0, "r=%d", (int)r);
    check("connect after completion -> WSAEISCONN", W("connect", 3, c3, sa("10.77.0.2", LP), 16u) == SE && err0() == WSAEISCONN, "err %u", err0());
    rs = fdset(1, &ls);
    check("select: the listener is readable", W("select", 5, 0u, rs, 0u, 0u, tv(1, 0)) == 1, 0);
    MR32(accl) = 16;
    uint32_t a = W("accept", 3, ls, acc0, accl);
    char b[16];
    check("accept -> new SOCKET, peer 10.77.0.2:<client port>", a != SE && !strcmp(sa_ip(acc0, b), "10.77.0.2") && sa_port(acc0) == local_port(c3), "%s:%u", b, sa_port(acc0));
    uint32_t pn = galloc(16);
    check("client getpeername = 10.77.0.2:<listener port>", W("getpeername", 3, c3, pn, u32p(16)) == 0 && sa_port(pn) == LP && !strcmp(sa_ip(pn, b), "10.77.0.2"), 0);
    uint32_t ln = galloc(16);
    check("connected getsockname = 10.77.0.2 (not 0.0.0.0)", W("getsockname", 3, c3, ln, u32p(16)) == 0 && !strcmp(sa_ip(ln, b), "10.77.0.2"), "%s", b);
    uint32_t msg = galloc(64); memcpy(g_mem + msg, "@dir hello", 10);
    check("send on the connection", W("send", 4, c3, msg, 10u, 0u) == 10, 0);
    uint32_t buf = galloc(256);
    W("ioctlsocket", 3, a, 0x8004667Eu, one);
    wait_readable(&T[0], a, 1000);
    uint32_t nr = galloc(4); W("ioctlsocket", 3, a, 0x4004667Fu, nr);
    check("FIONREAD on TCP = 10", MR32(nr) == 10, "%u", MR32(nr));
    check("recv on the accepted socket", W("recv", 4, a, buf, 256u, 0u) == 10 && !memcmp(g_mem + buf, "@dir hello", 10), 0);
    check("recv with nothing pending -> WSAEWOULDBLOCK", W("recv", 4, a, buf, 256u, 0u) == SE && err0() == WSAEWOULDBLOCK, 0);
    /* graceful close */
    W("closesocket", 1, c3);
    wait_readable(&T[0], a, 1000);
    check("peer closed gracefully: recv returns 0", W("recv", 4, a, buf, 256u, 0u) == 0, "err %u", err0());
    W("closesocket", 1, a);
    /* abortive close with the Windows 4-byte linger, passed with len 8 as server.dll does */
    uint32_t c4 = W("socket", 3, 2, 1, 0); W("ioctlsocket", 3, c4, 0x8004667Eu, one);
    W("connect", 3, c4, sa("10.77.0.2", LP), 16u);
    w = fdset(1, &c4); W("select", 5, 0u, 0u, w, 0u, tv(1, 0));
    wait_readable(&T[0], ls, 1000);
    MR32(accl) = 16; a = W("accept", 3, ls, acc0, accl);
    uint32_t lg = galloc(8); MR32(lg) = 1; MR32(lg + 4) = 0;     /* two dwords {1, 0}: Windows reads u_short {1, 0} */
    check("setsockopt(SO_LINGER, {1,0}, len 8)", W("setsockopt", 5, a, 0xFFFFu, 0x80u, lg, 8u) == 0, "err %u", err0());
    uint32_t lgo = galloc(8), lgl = u32p(8);
    W("getsockopt", 5, a, 0xFFFFu, 0x80u, lgo, lgl);
    check("getsockopt(SO_LINGER) -> 4 bytes {1, 0}", MR32(lgl) == 4 && MR16(lgo) == 1 && MR16(lgo + 2) == 0, "len %u", MR32(lgl));
    W("closesocket", 1, a);
    wait_readable(&T[0], c4, 1000);
    r = W("recv", 4, c4, buf, 256u, 0u);
    check("abortive close: the peer's recv -> WSAECONNRESET", r == SE && err0() == WSAECONNRESET, "r=%d err %u", (int)r, err0());
    w = fdset(1, &c4); x = fdset(1, &c4);
    r = W("select", 5, 0u, 0u, w, x, tv(0, 0));
    check("after a reset select says writable, not exceptional (as Windows)", r == 1 && MR32(w) == 1 && MR32(x) == 0, "r=%d w=%u x=%u", (int)r, MR32(w), MR32(x));
    check("after a reset getpeername -> WSAENOTCONN (DirtySock's disconnect test)", W("getpeername", 3, c4, pn, u32p(16)) == SE && err0() == WSAENOTCONN, "err %u", err0());
    signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_DFL);                     /* a SIGPIPE would kill the harness */
    int ok = 1; for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++){ r = W("send", 4, c4, msg, 10u, 0u); if (r != SE) ok = 0; }
    check("send after the reset fails (no SIGPIPE: the harness is alive)", ok && (err0() == WSAECONNRESET || err0() == WSAENOTCONN), "err %u", err0());
    W("closesocket", 1, c4); W("closesocket", 1, c1); W("closesocket", 1, c2);
    /* guard */
    uint32_t g = W("socket", 3, 2, 1, 0);
    check("TCP connect 192.168.1.1:80 -> WSAENETUNREACH (BLOCKED)", W("connect", 3, g, sa("192.168.1.1", 80), 16u) == SE && err0() == WSAENETUNREACH, 0);
    uint32_t g2 = W("socket", 3, 2, 1, 0); W("ioctlsocket", 3, g2, 0x8004667Eu, one);
    W("connect", 3, g2, sa("10.77.0.3", 1234), 16u);
    x = fdset(1, &g2);
    check("TCP connect to an unmapped peer port: refused (exceptfds)", W("select", 5, 0u, 0u, 0u, x, tv(0, 0)) == 1, 0);
    W("closesocket", 1, g); W("closesocket", 1, g2); W("closesocket", 1, ls);
}

static void t_select(void){
    section("select: > 64 sockets, errors, timeouts with the lock released");
    uint32_t h[100];
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) h[i] = udp_bound("0.0.0.0", 0);
    uint32_t snd = udp_bound("0.0.0.0", 0), m = galloc(4);
    W("sendto", 6, snd, m, 4u, 0u, sa("10.77.0.2", local_port(h[77])), 16u);
    uint32_t set = fdset(100, h);
    uint32_t r = W("select", 5, 0u, set, 0u, 0u, tv(1, 0));
    check("100 sockets in one read set: 1 ready", r == 1 && MR32(set) == 1 && MR32(set + 4) == h[77], "r=%d n=%u", (int)r, MR32(set));
    check("__WSAFDIsSet", W("__WSAFDIsSet", 2, h[77], set) == 1 && W("__WSAFDIsSet", 2, h[3], set) == 0, 0);
    uint32_t es = fdset(0, h);
    check("all sets empty -> WSAEINVAL", W("select", 5, 0u, es, 0u, 0u, tv(0, 0)) == SE && err0() == WSAEINVAL, 0);
    check("all sets NULL -> WSAEINVAL", W("select", 5, 0u, 0u, 0u, 0u, tv(0, 0)) == SE && err0() == WSAEINVAL, 0);
    uint32_t bogus = 0x1003u, bs = fdset(1, &bogus);
    check("a non-socket in a set -> WSAENOTSOCK", W("select", 5, 0u, bs, 0u, 0u, tv(0, 0)) == SE && err0() == WSAENOTSOCK, 0);
    uint32_t ws = fdset(2, h);
    check("UDP sockets are writable", W("select", 5, 0u, 0u, ws, 0u, tv(0, 0)) == 2, 0);
    set = fdset(1, &h[5]);
    int rel0 = atomic_load(&g_releases);
    double t0 = now_s();
    r = W("select", 5, 0u, set, 0u, 0u, tv(0, 250000));
    double dt = now_s() - t0;
    check("timeout {0, 250000}: returns 0 after 0.25 s, set emptied", r == 0 && MR32(set) == 0 && dt > 0.22 && dt < 0.6, "r=%d %.3fs", (int)r, dt);
    check("... with the guest lock released while waiting", atomic_load(&g_releases) > rel0, 0);
    set = fdset(1, &h[5]); t0 = now_s();
    r = W("select", 5, 0u, set, 0u, 0u, tv(0, 0));
    check("timeout {0, 0} polls once", r == 0 && now_s() - t0 < 0.05, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) W("closesocket", 1, h[i]);
    W("closesocket", 1, snd);
}

/* ---- threads: blocking calls ---- */
typedef struct { Th *t; uint32_t s, buf; uint32_t r, e; double dt; } BArg;
static void *blocking_recv(void *p){
    BArg *b = p;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_gil);
    double t0 = now_s();
    b->r = wc(b->t, "recvfrom", 6, b->s, b->buf, 256u, 0u, 0u, 0u);
    b->e = wc(b->t, "WSAGetLastError", 0);
    b->dt = now_s() - t0;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_gil);
    return 0;
}
static void t_threads(void){
    section("threads: per-thread errors and hostent, blocking calls, closesocket wakes waiters");
    W("WSASetLastError", 1, 10035u);
    wc(&T[1], "WSASetLastError", 1, 10054u);
    check("WSAGetLastError is per thread (TEB+0x34)", err0() == 10035 && wc(&T[1], "WSAGetLastError", 0) == 10054 && MR32(T[0].teb + 0x34) == 10035, 0);
    uint32_t h0 = W("gethostbyname", 1, gstr("")), h1 = wc(&T[1], "gethostbyname", 1, gstr(""));
    check("gethostbyname: one hostent per thread", h0 && h1 && h0 != h1, "%x %x", h0, h1);
    uint32_t l0 = MR32(h0 + 12), a0 = MR32(l0);
    char b[16]; snprintf(b, 16, "%u.%u.%u.%u", MR8(a0), MR8(a0 + 1), MR8(a0 + 2), MR8(a0 + 3));
    check("hostent: h_addrtype 2, h_length 4, h_addr_list[0] = 10.77.0.2", MR16(h0 + 8) == 2 && MR16(h0 + 10) == 4 && !strcmp(b, "10.77.0.2") && MR32(l0 + 4) == 0, "%s", b);
    check("hostent: h_name = gethostname, empty alias list", !strcmp((char *)g_mem + MR32(h0), "NFSU2-LOOP") && MR32(MR32(h0 + 4)) == 0, 0);
    uint32_t hb = galloc(256);
    check("gethostname", W("gethostname", 2, hb, 256u) == 0 && !strcmp((char *)g_mem + hb, "NFSU2-LOOP"), 0);
    check("gethostname with a short buffer -> WSAEFAULT", W("gethostname", 2, hb, 5u) == SE && err0() == WSAEFAULT, 0);
    uint32_t hn = W("gethostbyname", 1, hb);
    check("gethostbyname(own name) answered locally", hn && MR32(MR32(MR32(hn + 12))) == MR32(a0), 0);
    hn = W("gethostbyname", 1, gstr("nfsu2-loop.local"));
    check("gethostbyname(own name + .local), any case: locally, no mDNS", hn != 0, 0);
    hn = W("gethostbyname", 1, gstr("localhost"));
    check("gethostbyname(localhost) = 127.0.0.1", hn && MR8(MR32(MR32(hn + 12))) == 127, 0);
    hn = W("gethostbyname", 1, gstr("10.1.2.3"));
    check("gethostbyname(dotted quad) without DNS", hn && MR32(MR32(MR32(hn + 12))) == inet_addr("10.1.2.3") && !strcmp((char *)g_mem + MR32(hn), "10.1.2.3"), 0);
    uint64_t b0 = winsock_blocked_count();
    hn = W("gethostbyname", 1, gstr("pcnfs05.ea.com"));
    check("gethostbyname(pcnfs05.ea.com) -> NULL, WSAHOST_NOT_FOUND, no lookup", !hn && err0() == WSAHOST_NOT_FOUND && winsock_blocked_count() == b0 + 1, 0);
    check("inet_addr / inet_ntoa", W("inet_addr", 1, gstr("1.2.3.4")) == inet_addr("1.2.3.4") && !strcmp((char *)g_mem + W("inet_ntoa", 1, inet_addr("5.6.7.8")), "5.6.7.8"), 0);
    /* blocking recv woken by data */
    uint32_t s = udp_bound("0.0.0.0", 0), zero = u32p(0);
    W("ioctlsocket", 3, s, 0x8004667Eu, zero);
    BArg ba = { &T[1], s, galloc(256), 0, 0, 0 };
    pthread_t th;
    int rel0 = atomic_load(&g_releases);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_gil);
    pthread_create(&th, 0, blocking_recv, &ba);
    usleep(150000);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_gil);
    uint32_t snd = udp_bound("0.0.0.0", 0), m = gstr("wake");
    W("sendto", 6, snd, m, 4u, 0u, sa("10.77.0.2", local_port(s)), 16u);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_gil);
    pthread_join(th, 0);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_gil);
    check("blocking recvfrom waits with the lock released, then gets the data", ba.r == 4 && ba.dt > 0.1 && atomic_load(&g_releases) > rel0, "r=%d %.3fs", (int)ba.r, ba.dt);
    /* blocking recv woken by closesocket from another thread */
    BArg bc = { &T[1], s, galloc(256), 0, 0, 0 };
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_gil);
    pthread_create(&th, 0, blocking_recv, &bc);
    usleep(150000);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_gil);
    double t0 = now_s();
    check("closesocket while another thread blocks in recvfrom", W("closesocket", 1, s) == 0, 0);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_gil);
    pthread_join(th, 0);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_gil);
    check("... the blocked call returns SOCKET_ERROR / WSAEINTR within 0.2 s", bc.r == SE && bc.e == WSAEINTR && now_s() - t0 < 0.2, "r=%d e=%u %.3fs", (int)bc.r, bc.e, now_s() - t0);
    check("... and the handle is gone", W("closesocket", 1, s) == SE && err0() == WSAENOTSOCK, 0);
    /* SO_RCVTIMEO */
    s = udp_bound("0.0.0.0", 0); W("ioctlsocket", 3, s, 0x8004667Eu, zero);
    uint32_t to = u32p(150);
    W("setsockopt", 5, s, 0xFFFFu, 0x1006u, to, 4u);
    t0 = now_s();
    uint32_t r = W("recvfrom", 6, s, galloc(16), 16u, 0u, 0u, 0u);
    double dt = now_s() - t0;
    check("SO_RCVTIMEO 150 ms: blocking recv -> WSAETIMEDOUT after ~0.15 s", r == SE && err0() == WSAETIMEDOUT && dt > 0.13 && dt < 0.5, "%.3fs err %u", dt, err0());
    W("closesocket", 1, s); W("closesocket", 1, snd);
    /* blocking TCP connect + accept */
    uint32_t ls = W("socket", 3, 2, 1, 0);
    W("bind", 3, ls, sa("0.0.0.0", 0), 16u); W("listen", 2, ls, 2u);
    uint32_t c = W("socket", 3, 2, 1, 0);
    check("blocking connect returns 0 once connected", W("connect", 3, c, sa("10.77.0.2", local_port(ls)), 16u) == 0, "err %u", err0());
    uint32_t a = W("accept", 3, ls, 0u, 0u);
    check("blocking accept (NULL addr) returns the connection", a != SE, 0);
    uint32_t c2 = W("socket", 3, 2, 1, 0);
    r = W("connect", 3, c2, sa("10.77.0.2", 47396), 16u);
    check("blocking connect to a closed port -> WSAECONNREFUSED", r == SE && err0() == WSAECONNREFUSED, "err %u", err0());
    W("closesocket", 1, a); W("closesocket", 1, c); W("closesocket", 1, c2); W("closesocket", 1, ls);
}

static void t_ioctl_opts(void){
    section("WSAIoctl, ioctlsocket, socket options, raw ICMP");
    uint32_t s = W("socket", 3, 2, 2, 0);
    uint32_t out = galloc(16), ret = u32p(0);
    char b[16];
    uint32_t r = W("WSAIoctl", 9, s, 0xC8000014u, sa("24.1.1.1", 0), 16u, out, 16u, ret, 0u, 0u);
    check("SIO_ROUTING_INTERFACE_QUERY(24.1.1.1) = 10.77.0.2, 16 bytes", r == 0 && !strcmp(sa_ip(out, b), "10.77.0.2") && MR32(ret) == 16 && MR16(out) == 2, "%s", b);
    r = W("WSAIoctl", 9, s, 0xC8000014u, sa("159.153.253.82", 0), 16u, out, 16u, ret, 0u, 0u);
    check("... toward server.dll's %%bind address: 10.77.0.2, no traffic", r == 0 && !strcmp(sa_ip(out, b), "10.77.0.2"), 0);
    r = W("WSAIoctl", 9, s, 0xC8000014u, sa("127.0.0.1", 0), 16u, out, 16u, ret, 0u, 0u);
    check("... toward 127.0.0.1 = 127.0.0.1", r == 0 && !strcmp(sa_ip(out, b), "127.0.0.1"), 0);
    check("... with an 8-byte output buffer -> WSAEFAULT", W("WSAIoctl", 9, s, 0xC8000014u, sa("24.1.1.1", 0), 16u, out, 8u, ret, 0u, 0u) == SE && err0() == WSAEFAULT, 0);
    check("unknown WSAIoctl code -> WSAEOPNOTSUPP", W("WSAIoctl", 9, s, 0x12345678u, 0u, 0u, 0u, 0u, ret, 0u, 0u) == SE && err0() == WSAEOPNOTSUPP, 0);
    check("ioctlsocket(unknown) -> WSAEINVAL", W("ioctlsocket", 3, s, 0x1234u, u32p(0)) == SE && err0() == WSAEINVAL, 0);
    check("setsockopt(SO_BROADCAST) on TCP -> WSAENOPROTOOPT", W("setsockopt", 5, W("socket", 3, 2, 1, 0), 0xFFFFu, 0x20u, u32p(1), 4u) == SE && err0() == WSAENOPROTOOPT, 0);
    check("setsockopt(unknown level/option) -> WSAENOPROTOOPT", W("setsockopt", 5, s, 0xFFFFu, 0x7777u, u32p(1), 4u) == SE && err0() == WSAENOPROTOOPT, 0);
    uint32_t v = galloc(4), vl = u32p(4);
    W("setsockopt", 5, s, 0xFFFFu, 0x20u, u32p(1), 4u);
    check("getsockopt(SO_BROADCAST) = 1, SO_TYPE = 2", W("getsockopt", 5, s, 0xFFFFu, 0x20u, v, vl) == 0 && MR32(v) == 1 &&
          (MR32(vl) = 4, W("getsockopt", 5, s, 0xFFFFu, 0x1008u, v, vl) == 0) && MR32(v) == 2, 0);
    MR32(vl) = 1;
    check("getsockopt of a BOOL into a 1-byte buffer", W("getsockopt", 5, s, 0xFFFFu, 0x20u, v, vl) == 0 && MR32(vl) == 1, 0);
    check("setsockopt(IP_TTL 64)", W("setsockopt", 5, s, 0u, 4u, u32p(64), 4u) == 0, 0);
    check("setsockopt(SO_REUSEADDR) / SO_RCVBUF / TCP_NODELAY", W("setsockopt", 5, s, 0xFFFFu, 4u, u32p(1), 4u) == 0 &&
          W("setsockopt", 5, s, 0xFFFFu, 0x1002u, u32p(65536), 4u) == 0 &&
          W("setsockopt", 5, W("socket", 3, 2, 1, 0), 6u, 1u, u32p(1), 4u) == 0, 0);
    /* raw ICMP: the guest's ICMP message out, IP header + ICMP in */
    uint32_t ic = W("socket", 3, 2, 3, 1);
    W("setsockopt", 5, ic, 0u, 4u, u32p(64), 4u);
    uint32_t pk = galloc(24);
    uint8_t m[24] = { 8, 0, 0, 0, 0x12, 0x34, 0, 7, 's', 'P', 'S', 'g', 1, 2, 3, 4, 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X' };
    uint32_t sum = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 24; i += 2) sum += (uint32_t)(m[i] << 8 | m[i + 1]);
    while (sum >> 16) sum = (sum & 0xFFFF) + (sum >> 16);
    sum = ~sum & 0xFFFF; m[2] = (uint8_t)(sum >> 8); m[3] = (uint8_t)sum;
    memcpy(g_mem + pk, m, 24);
    r = W("sendto", 6, ic, pk, 24u, 0u, sa("10.77.0.2", 0), 16u);
    check("raw ICMP echo request to own address (no root needed)", r == 24, "err %u", err0());
    uint32_t rb = galloc(0x424), from = galloc(16), fl = u32p(16);
    uint32_t n = wait_readable(&T[0], ic, 1000) ? W("recvfrom", 6, ic, rb, 0x424u, 0u, from, fl) : SE;
    int okh = n == 44 && MR8(rb) == 0x45 && (MR8(rb + 2) << 8 | MR8(rb + 3)) == 44 && MR8(rb + 9) == 1;
    check("reply: 20-byte IPv4 header first, total length 44 (wire format)", okh, "n=%d", (int)n);
    check("... ICMP type 0 at +0x14, magic 'sPSg' at +0x1C, id kept", n == 44 && MR8(rb + 0x14) == 0 && !memcmp(g_mem + rb + 0x1C, "sPSg", 4) && MR8(rb + 0x18) == 0x12 && MR8(rb + 0x19) == 0x34, 0);
    uint32_t cs = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 20; i += 2) cs += (uint32_t)(MR8(rb + (uint32_t)i) << 8 | MR8(rb + (uint32_t)i + 1));
    while (cs >> 16) cs = (cs & 0xFFFF) + (cs >> 16);
    check("... IP header checksum valid, from 10.77.0.2", cs == 0xFFFF && !strcmp(sa_ip(from, b), "10.77.0.2"), "%s", b);
    uint64_t b0 = winsock_blocked_count();
    check("ping 8.8.8.8 -> WSAENETUNREACH (BLOCKED)", W("sendto", 6, ic, pk, 24u, 0u, sa("8.8.8.8", 0), 16u) == SE && err0() == WSAENETUNREACH && winsock_blocked_count() == b0 + 1, 0);
    W("closesocket", 1, ic); W("closesocket", 1, s);
}

static void t_netbios(void){
    section("netapi32!Netbios");
    uint32_t ncb = galloc(64), buf = galloc(0xF0);
    memset(g_mem + ncb, 0, 64); MR8(ncb) = 0x32; MR8(ncb + 0x30) = 0;
    check("NCBRESET LANA 0 -> NRC_GOODRET", W("Netbios", 1, ncb) == 0 && MR8(ncb + 1) == 0 && MR8(ncb + 0x31) == 0, 0);
    MR8(ncb + 0x30) = 1;
    check("NCBRESET LANA 1 -> NRC_BRIDGE (one adapter)", W("Netbios", 1, ncb) == 0x23 && MR8(ncb + 1) == 0x23, 0);
    memset(g_mem + ncb, 0, 64); MR8(ncb) = 0x33; MR32(ncb + 4) = buf; MR16(ncb + 8) = 0xF0;
    memcpy(g_mem + ncb + 0xA, "*               ", 16);
    memset(g_mem + buf, 0xCC, 0xF0);
    uint32_t r = W("Netbios", 1, ncb);
    check("NCBASTAT \"*\" -> NRC_GOODRET, ncb_length 60", r == 0 && MR16(ncb + 8) == 60, "r=%u len=%u", r, MR16(ncb + 8));
