    g_c.esp = STACK;
}
/* a frame: the world's step of 1/60 s (every car moved on by its velocity, as the game's physics after the blend),
 * then the main loop's hook */
static void frame(void){
    g_fake_ns += 16666667u;
    for (uint32_t car = CAR_A; car; car = car == CAR_A ? CAR_B : car == CAR_B ? CAR_ME : 0)
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 3; k++) MRF32(car + CAR_POS + 4u * k) += MRF32(car + CAR_VEL + 4u * k) * 0.016667f;
    racecars_frame(&g_c);
}
/* an N2RS of slot at p moving v (x), its stamp t_us, echoing our stamp echo (held); with g_n2rs_eng its engine at
 * that rpm (the sound's scale) in the extension */
static uint16_t g_n2rs_eng;
static int n2rs(uint8_t *m, int slot, uint32_t t_us, float px, float vx, uint32_t tx, uint32_t echo, uint32_t held){
    rc_state s; memset(&s, 0, sizeof s);
    s.t_us = t_us; s.p[0] = px; s.p[1] = 210.f; s.p[2] = 5.f; s.v[0] = vx; s.q[3] = 1.f; s.throttle = 1.f;
    s.ext = g_n2rs_eng != 0; s.eng = g_n2rs_eng; s.eng_acc = 255;
    rc_w w; rc_w_init(&w, m, 256);
    rc_putb(&w, "N2RS", 4); rc_put8(&w, 1); rc_put8(&w, s.ext); rc_put8(&w, (uint32_t)slot); rc_put8(&w, 1);
    rc_put8(&w, 1); rc_put8(&w, 1); rc_put8(&w, RC_ST_ROAM); rc_put8(&w, 0);
    rc_put32(&w, tx); rc_put32(&w, echo); rc_put32(&w, held);
    rc_state_put(&w, &s, s.ext);
    return (int)w.n;
}
static uint32_t now32(void){ return (uint32_t)(g_fake_ns / 1000u); }
/* what a racer 50 ms of round trip away holds of our stamp tx when its message comes now */
static uint32_t held50(uint32_t tx){ return now32() - tx - 50000u; }
static Rc *rc_ip(uint32_t ip){ for (int i = 0; i < NCARS; i++) if (g_rc[i].ip == ip) return &g_rc[i]; return 0; }
/* the car drawn this step: the game's blend (nothing), then ours */
static int draw(uint32_t car, uint32_t ctl){
    int fed = racecars_pre(car);
    return fed && racecars_step(&g_c, ctl, car);
}

int main(void){
    g_mem = mmap(0, 1ull << 32, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_NORESERVE, -1, 0);
    if (g_mem == MAP_FAILED){ perror("mmap"); return 2; }
    /* the cases below draw the cars where their states say (no physics here to drive them): the test knob off */
    setenv("NFSU2_INPUT_SCRIPT", "racecars_unit", 1); setenv("NFSU2_RACE_DRIVE", "0", 1);
    race_setup();
    uint8_t m[256];

    /* wire */
    frame(); frame();
    int sent_a = 0, sent_b = 0, okm = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nout; i++){
        sent_a += g_out[i].to == IP_A; sent_b += g_out[i].to == IP_B;
        okm &= !memcmp(g_out[i].m, "N2RS", 4) && g_out[i].m[4] == 1 && g_out[i].m[5] == 1 && g_out[i].m[6] == 1 && g_out[i].m[7] == 1;
    }
    rc_state s; rc_r rd; int dec = -1;
    if (g_nout){ rc_r_init(&rd, g_out[g_nout - 1].m + 24, (uint32_t)g_out[g_nout - 1].n - 24u); dec = rc_state_get(&rd, &s, 1); }
    CHECK(sent_a >= 1 && sent_b >= 1 && okm && dec == RC_OK && fabsf(s.p[0] - MRF32(CAR_ME + CAR_POS)) < 0.01f && fabsf(s.v[0] - 30.f) < 0.5f &&
          fabsf(s.q[3]) > 0.999f && s.eng == 4321 && s.eng_acc == 200, "wire: to A %d, to B %d, header %d, the state %d at x %.2f (car %.2f), "
          "vx %.2f, q.w %.3f, engine %u (pulling %u)", sent_a, sent_b, okm, dec, dec == RC_OK ? (double)s.p[0] : 0., (double)MRF32(CAR_ME + CAR_POS),
          dec == RC_OK ? (double)s.v[0] : 0., dec == RC_OK ? (double)s.q[3] : 0., dec == RC_OK ? s.eng : 0u, dec == RC_OK ? s.eng_acc : 0u);
    uint32_t our_tx = g_nout ? (uint32_t)g_out[g_nout - 1].m[12] | (uint32_t)g_out[g_nout - 1].m[13] << 8 | (uint32_t)g_out[g_nout - 1].m[14] << 16 |
                               (uint32_t)g_out[g_nout - 1].m[15] << 24 : 0;

    /* stranger, own-slot */
    uint32_t ref0 = S.refused;
    racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 2, 1000000, 110.f, 30.f, now32(), 0, 0), IP_X);
    CHECK(S.refused == ref0 + 1 && !rc_ip(IP_X), "stranger: refused %u, kept %d", S.refused - ref0, !!rc_ip(IP_X));
    racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 1, 1000000, 110.f, 30.f, now32(), 0, 0), IP_A);
    CHECK(S.refused == ref0 + 2 && !rc_ip(IP_A), "own-slot: refused %u", S.refused - ref0);

    /* bound */
    racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 2, 1000000, 110.f, 30.f, now32(), 0, 0), IP_A);
    Rc *a = rc_ip(IP_A);
    int took = a && a->slot == 2 && a->mo.n == 1 && a->car == CAR_A;
    racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 2, 1000000, 300.f, 0.f, now32(), 0, 0), IP_B);
    int b_refused = !rc_ip(IP_B) || rc_ip(IP_B)->slot != 2;
    racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 3, 1016667, 111.f, 30.f, now32(), 0, 0), IP_A);
    int a_kept = a && a->slot == 2 && a->mo.n == 1;
    racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 3, 1000000, 400.f, 0.f, now32(), 0, 0), IP_B);
    Rc *b = rc_ip(IP_B);
    CHECK(took && b_refused && a_kept && b && b->slot == 3 && b->car == CAR_B, "bound: A takes slot 2 %d, B naming it refused %d, A naming 3 refused %d, "
          "B takes 3 %d", took, b_refused, a_kept, b && b->slot == 3);

    /* rtt: A echoes our stamp, 60 ms after it went, having held it 10 ms */
    g_fake_ns += 60000000u;
    racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 2, 1060000, 111.8f, 30.f, now32(), our_tx, 10000), IP_A);
    CHECK(a && a->rn == 1 && abs(a->rtt[0] - 50000) < 200, "rtt: %d samples, %.1f ms", a ? a->rn : 0, a && a->rn ? a->rtt[0] / 1000.0 : 0.);

    /* drawn: its states at 30 m/s along x, 60 a second; drawn where they carry it */
    for (int k = 1; k <= 30; k++){
        frame();
        racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 2, 1060000 + (uint32_t)k * 16667u, 111.8f + 0.5f * (float)k, 30.f, now32(), our_tx, held50(our_tx)), IP_A);
        draw(CAR_A, CTL_A);
    }
    int ap0 = g_applies;
    float bx = MRF32(CTL_A + CTL_BLEND + 0x10u), want = 111.8f + 0.5f * 30.f;
    int drew = draw(CAR_A, CTL_A);
    float vw = 30.f / (float)K.vscale;            /* per our world's second (our stamp clock catches up after the 60 ms above) */
    CHECK(drew && g_applies == ap0 + 1 && fabsf(bx - want) < 3.f && fabsf(MRF32(CAR_A + CAR_VEL) - vw) < 0.3f,
          "drawn: %d, applied %d, x %.2f (newest state's %.2f), vx %.2f (%.2f a world second)", drew, g_applies - ap0, (double)bx, (double)want,
          (double)MRF32(CAR_A + CAR_VEL), (double)vw);

    /* ghost: our car 500 m off: its delay slides to GHOST_US; back near it: to half the round trip ahead */
    MRF32(CAR_ME + CAR_POS + 4u) = 800.f;
    for (int k = 31; k <= 300; k++){
        frame();
        racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 2, 1060000 + (uint32_t)k * 16667u, 111.8f + 0.5f * (float)k, 30.f, now32(), our_tx, held50(our_tx)), IP_A);
        draw(CAR_A, CTL_A);
    }
    int64_t far_d = a ? a->delay : 0;
    MRF32(CAR_ME + CAR_POS) = MRF32(CAR_A + CAR_POS); MRF32(CAR_ME + CAR_POS + 4u) = MRF32(CAR_A + CAR_POS + 4u) + 3.f;
    for (int k = 301; k <= 600; k++){
        frame();
        MRF32(CAR_ME + CAR_POS) = MRF32(CAR_A + CAR_POS);
        racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 2, 1060000 + (uint32_t)k * 16667u, 111.8f + 0.5f * (float)k, 30.f, now32(), our_tx, held50(our_tx)), IP_A);
        draw(CAR_A, CTL_A);
    }
    int64_t near_d = a ? a->delay : 0;
    CHECK(far_d == GHOST_US && near_d == -25000, "ghost: far %.1f ms (want %.1f), near %.1f ms (want -25.0)", far_d / 1000.0, GHOST_US / 1000.0, near_d / 1000.0);

    /* hit: the game stamps one; the car is left where its physics put it */
    MR32(CTL_A + CTL_HIT) = 12345u;
    MRF32(CAR_A + CAR_POS) += 0.7f;
    float hx = MRF32(CAR_A + CAR_POS);
    ap0 = g_applies;
    int dh = draw(CAR_A, CTL_A);
    int own = a && a->own;
    CHECK(dh && own && MRF32(CAR_A + CAR_POS) == hx && g_applies == ap0, "hit: on its own %d, left at %.2f (%.2f), applied %d", own,
          (double)MRF32(CAR_A + CAR_POS), (double)hx, g_applies - ap0);
    for (int k = 601; k <= 640; k++){
        frame();
        racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 2, 1060000 + (uint32_t)k * 16667u, 111.8f + 0.5f * (float)k, 30.f, now32(), our_tx, held50(our_tx)), IP_A);
        draw(CAR_A, CTL_A);
    }
    CHECK(a && !a->own && a->own_hit == 1 && a->glides + a->snaps == 1, "hit-back: own %d, hits %u, glides %u, snaps %u", a ? a->own : -1,
          a ? a->own_hit : 0, a ? a->glides : 0, a ? a->snaps : 0);

    /* driven: the car left where it is (its physics moves it), its velocity toward its states' place: 1 m behind
     * it, moving 30 m/s, it gets about 30 + 1 / DRIVE_TAU */
    O.init = 0; setenv("NFSU2_RACE_DRIVE", "1", 1); opts();
    frame();
    racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 2, 1060000 + 641u * 16667u, 111.8f + 0.5f * 641.f, 30.f, now32(), our_tx, held50(our_tx)), IP_A);
    draw(CAR_A, CTL_A);                                  /* (on its target) */
    frame();
    racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 2, 1060000 + 642u * 16667u, 111.8f + 0.5f * 642.f, 30.f, now32(), our_tx, held50(our_tx)), IP_A);
    MRF32(CAR_A + CAR_POS) -= 1.f;                       /* the physics left it 1 m short */
    float dx = MRF32(CAR_A + CAR_POS);
    ap0 = g_applies;
    int dd = draw(CAR_A, CTL_A);
    float vput = MRF32(CTL_A + CTL_BLEND + 0x20u), want_v = 30.f / (float)K.vscale + 1.f / DRIVE_TAU;
    CHECK(dd && a && a->driving && g_applies == ap0 + 1 && MRF32(CTL_A + CTL_BLEND + 0x10u) == dx && fabsf(vput - want_v) < 1.5f,
          "driven: %d, put at its own place %d, velocity %.2f m/s (about %.2f)", a ? a->driving : 0, MRF32(CTL_A + CTL_BLEND + 0x10u) == dx,
          (double)vput, (double)want_v);

    /* reset */
    MR32(RC) = 0;
    frame();
    int any = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < NCARS; i++) any |= g_rc[i].ip != 0;
    CHECK(!any && !racecars_fed(CAR_A), "reset: racers left %d", any);

    /* claimed: the next race, the slots known (the creator's race connections, or its list on a joiner: A drives 2,
     * B 3); B names A's slot from the race's start, every frame for half a second (the 2026-11-05 security audit:
     * first come, it spoke for A's car all race, put it where it liked, and its jumps went into every game's report
     * against A) */
    O.init = 0; setenv("NFSU2_RACE_DRIVE", "0", 1); opts();
    MR32(RC) = RC_RACING;
    frame();
    g_slot_ip[0] = IP_A; g_slot_of[0] = 2; g_slot_ip[1] = IP_B; g_slot_of[1] = 3; g_nslot = 2;
    uint32_t ref1 = S.refused;
    for (int k = 0; k < 30; k++){
        frame();
        racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 2, 3000000 + (uint32_t)k * 16667u, 500.f, 0.f, now32(), 0, 0), IP_B);
    }
    uint32_t tries = S.refused - ref1;
    CHECK(tries == 30 && !rc_ip(IP_B) && !racecars_fed(CAR_A), "claimed: B naming A's slot 2 from the start refused %u of 30, "
          "A's car from B's states %d", tries, racecars_fed(CAR_A));

    /* honest: then A's states for slot 2 and B's for slot 3 (B still naming 2 now and then): each car from its own */
    for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++){
        frame();
        uint32_t t = 3500000 + (uint32_t)k * 16667u;
        racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 2, t, 120.f + 0.5f * (float)k, 30.f, now32(), 0, 0), IP_A);
        racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 3, t, 400.f, 0.f, now32(), 0, 0), IP_B);
        if (k % 3 == 0) racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 2, t, 500.f, 0.f, now32(), 0, 0), IP_B);
    }
    Rc *a2 = rc_ip(IP_A), *b2 = rc_ip(IP_B);
    CHECK(a2 && a2->slot == 2 && a2->n == 10 && rc_of_car(CAR_A) == a2 && b2 && b2->slot == 3 && b2->n == 10 && rc_of_car(CAR_B) == b2 &&
          S.refused == ref1 + 34, "honest: A for slot 2 %d (%u states), B for slot 3 %d (%u states), B naming 2 refused %u more",
          a2 && a2->slot == 2 && rc_of_car(CAR_A) == a2, a2 ? a2->n : 0, b2 && b2->slot == 3 && rc_of_car(CAR_B) == b2, b2 ? b2->n : 0,
          S.refused - ref1 - 30);

    /* old-creator: the next race, the slots not known (a list from a creator of an older version): the first slot an
     * address names, as before (not every state refused) */
    MR32(RC) = 0; frame(); MR32(RC) = RC_RACING; frame();
    g_nslot = 0;
    racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 2, 4000000, 500.f, 0.f, now32(), 0, 0), IP_B);
    racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 2, 4000000, 120.f, 30.f, now32(), 0, 0), IP_A);
    racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 3, 4000000, 400.f, 0.f, now32(), 0, 0), IP_A);
    Rc *a3 = rc_ip(IP_A), *b3 = rc_ip(IP_B);
    CHECK(b3 && b3->slot == 2 && a3 && a3->slot == 3, "old-creator: B naming slot 2 first takes it %d, A then slot 3 %d",
          b3 && b3->slot == 2, a3 && a3->slot == 3);

    /* engine: the next race; A's states carry its engine, B's none (an older game's) */
    MR32(RC) = 0; frame(); MR32(RC) = RC_RACING; frame();
    for (int k = 0; k < 20; k++){
        frame();
        uint32_t t = 5000000 + (uint32_t)k * 16667u;
        g_n2rs_eng = (uint16_t)(5000 + 10 * k); racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 2, t, 120.f + 0.5f * (float)k, 30.f, now32(), 0, 0), IP_A);
        g_n2rs_eng = 0; racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 3, t, 400.f, 0.f, now32(), 0, 0), IP_B);
        draw(CAR_A, CTL_A); draw(CAR_B, 0);
    }
    frame();
    float ha = racecars_engine_heard(CAR_A), hb = racecars_engine_heard(CAR_B);
    CHECK(g_sfx_cars == 1 && ha > 5100.f && ha < 5200.f && fabsf(g_sfx_eng - ha) < 0.5f && hb == 0.f,
          "engine: %d car(s) played, A's at %.0f (its last states 5100 .. 5190), carsfx.c given %.0f; B's %.0f (none)", g_sfx_cars,
          (double)ha, (double)g_sfx_eng, (double)hb);
    /* ...then A's states without one (a game of before put on mid-race, say): back to the game's */
    for (int k = 20; k < 40; k++){
        frame();
        racecars_heard(m, n2rs(m, 2, 5000000 + (uint32_t)k * 16667u, 120.f + 0.5f * (float)k, 30.f, now32(), 0, 0), IP_A);
        draw(CAR_A, CTL_A);
    }
    frame();
    CHECK(g_sfx_cars == 0 && racecars_engine_heard(CAR_A) == 0.f, "engine-off: %d car(s) played, A's %.0f", g_sfx_cars,
          (double)racecars_engine_heard(CAR_A));

    printf("racecars unit tests: %s\n", g_fail ? "FAILED" : "all passed");
    return g_fail;
}

/* racenet_unit.c -- tests for runtime/racenet.c's car states straight between
 * the joiners' games ("N2CS") and the creator's list ("N2PL"), without the
 * game: who may send a joiner the list, and which slot each address may
 * speak for.
 *
 *   clang -O1 -g -Wall -Wno-unused-function -Iruntime -o out/racenet_unit tests/racenet_unit.c
 *   out/racenet_unit
 *
 * The game's memory is a 4 GB reservation of our own with only the pages a
 * test uses marked committed; the virtual LAN (net_lan.c) and the game's
 * handler of the creator's messages are stand-ins, the clock a fake one.
 * Cases, on a joiner (slot 1, the creator slot 0):
 *   stranger   a list from a race peer the game's race link does not send to
 *              (anyone who sends a datagram to our UDP 3658 is one): refused
 *   creator    the list from the creator (the race link sends to it): taken
 *   second     a list from another address the race link sends to: refused,
 *              the creator's kept
 *   direct     a car state from a joiner on the list: to the game's handler
 *   own-slot   that joiner naming another slot than its first: refused
 *   taken-slot another joiner naming that slot: refused; its own: taken
 *   rules      our slot, the creator's, a slot past 5, an address not on
 *              the list: refused
 *   reset      the race over: no list, no slots; the next race starts anew
 *   (the cases above with a list from an older creator, without the slots)
 *   list-slots a list with the slots: a joiner naming another's slot from
 *              the race's start refused every time; each joiner its own taken
 *   old-creator a list without the slots: the first slot named, as before
 *   host-list  the creator: its list only to the race peers its race link
 *              sends to, naming only them (not a stranger who sent to 3658)
 *   host-slots the creator: each listed joiner's slot from the game's race
 *              connections (none for one without a connection), its own
 * Every case prints "PASS <case> ..." or "FAIL <case> ..."; exit 1 on a FAIL. */

int vlan_rt_send(uint16_t port, uint32_t ip_h, const void *p, int n){
    (void)port; g_nout++;
    const uint8_t *m = p;
    if (n >= 8 && !memcmp(m, "N2PL", 4) && g_npl_out < 8){
        int k = g_npl_out++;
        g_pl_to[k] = ip_h; g_pl_k[k] = m[6];
        g_pl_len[k] = n < 64 ? n : 64; memcpy(g_pl_raw[k], m, (size_t)g_pl_len[k]);
        for (int i = 0; i < m[6] && i < NPL_MAX_TEST && 8 + 4 * i + 3 < n; i++)
            g_pl_named[k][i] = (uint32_t)m[8 + 4 * i] | (uint32_t)m[9 + 4 * i] << 8 | (uint32_t)m[10 + 4 * i] << 16 | (uint32_t)m[11 + 4 * i] << 24;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int g_calls; static uint32_t g_fn, g_len; static uint8_t g_bytes[64];
void dispatch_indirect(CPU *c, uint32_t addr);
#include "../runtime/racenet.c"
void dispatch_indirect(CPU *c, uint32_t addr){
    if (addr != FN_JOIN_MSG){ c->esp += 4u; return; }    /* the game's apply and the like: nothing here */
    g_calls++; g_fn = addr;
    uint32_t buf = MR32(c->esp + 4u); g_len = MR32(c->esp + 8u);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_len && i < sizeof g_bytes; i++) g_bytes[i] = MR8(buf + i);
    c->esp += 4u;                                        /* its ret */
}

/* a network race on a joiner: a world with a friend's car and ours */
#define W      0x10000000u
#define CAR_A  0x10010000u
#define CAR_ME 0x10020000u
#define PL     0x10030000u
#define RC     0x10040000u
#define STACK  0x00130000u
static CPU g_c;
static void race_setup(void){
    uint32_t g[] = { G_FLOW, G_GAMEMODE, G_NET_HOST, G_WORLD, G_PLAYER1, G_WORLDDT, G_RACE, G_WORLDTIMER, G_NETPLAYERS,
                     G_MYSLOT, G_HOSTSLOT, G_SLOTBITS, G_SLOTMIN };
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof g / sizeof g[0]; i++) commit(g[i], 32);
    commit(W, 0x100); commit(CAR_A, 0xa00); commit(CAR_ME, 0xa00); commit(PL, 16); commit(RC, 0xc00);
    commit(STACK - 0x4000u, 0x8000u);
    MR32(G_FLOW) = 6; MR32(G_GAMEMODE) = 8; MR32(G_NET_HOST) = 0;
    MR32(G_WORLD) = W; MR32(W) = CAR_A; MR32(CAR_A) = CAR_ME; MR32(CAR_ME) = W;
    MR32(G_PLAYER1) = PL; MR32(PL + 4u) = CAR_ME;
    MR32(G_RACE) = RC; MR32(RC) = RC_RACING; MR32(RC + 0x24u) = 0;
    MRF32(G_WORLDDT) = 0.02f;
    MR32(G_SLOTBITS) = 3; MR32(G_SLOTMIN) = 0; MR32(G_MYSLOT) = 1; MR32(G_HOSTSLOT) = 0;
    MR16(CAR_A + 0xau) = 0xffffu; MR16(CAR_ME + 0xau) = 0xffffu;
    g_c.esp = STACK;
}
static void frame(void){ racenet_frame(&g_c); g_fake_ns += 20000000u; MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) += 80u; }
/* a car state message: kind 2, then at bit 40 the slot in 3 bits */
static int carspam(uint8_t *m, uint32_t slot, int len){
    memset(m, 0, CS_HDR + (size_t)len);
    memcpy(m, "N2CS", 4); m[4] = 1; m[6] = (uint8_t)len; m[7] = (uint8_t)(len >> 8);
    m[CS_HDR] = MSG_CARSPAM;
    m[CS_HDR + 5] = (uint8_t)(slot << 5);
    for (int i = 6; i < len; i++) m[CS_HDR + i] = (uint8_t)(0x40 + i);
    return (int)CS_HDR + len;
}
/* the creator's list: the given addresses (an older creator's: no slots) */
static int list(uint8_t *m, const uint32_t *ip, int k){
    memcpy(m, "N2PL", 4); m[4] = 1; m[5] = 0; m[6] = (uint8_t)k; m[7] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) for (int b = 0; b < 4; b++) m[8 + 4 * i + b] = (uint8_t)(ip[i] >> (8 * b));
    return 8 + 4 * k;
}
/* and with the slot each drives, then the creator's own (flag 1) */
static int list_slots(uint8_t *m, const uint32_t *ip, const uint8_t *slot, int k, uint8_t own){
    int n = list(m, ip, k);
    m[5] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) m[n++] = slot[i];
    m[n++] = own;
    return n;
}
/* the creator's race connections as the game keeps them (0x8691D0: +0 state 3, +4 its id, +0xC its link, whose +0 is
 * its CommUDP port, +0x7C the peer's sockaddr), and its joiners (0x8693C8: +0 the slot, +4 the connection's id) */
#define T_CONNS 0x008691d0u
#define T_SEATS 0x008693c8u
#define T_LINKS 0x100a0000u
static void seats_free(void){
    commit(T_CONNS, 0x300);
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 5; k++){ MR32(T_SEATS + 0x20u * k) = 0xffffffffu; MR32(T_SEATS + 0x20u * k + 4u) = 0xffffffffu; }
}
/* connection i to ip (its id), the joiner in seat s with that slot */
static void conn_put(int i, int s, uint32_t ip, uint32_t id, int slot){
    uint32_t e = T_CONNS + 0x14u * (uint32_t)i, link = T_LINKS + 0x1000u * (uint32_t)i, port = link + 0x100u;
    commit(T_CONNS, 0x300); commit(link, 0x200);
    MR32(e) = 3; MR32(e + 4u) = id; MR32(e + 0xcu) = link; MR32(link) = port;
    MR16(port + 0x7cu) = 2; MR16(port + 0x7eu) = (uint16_t)(3658u >> 8 | (3658u & 255u) << 8);
    MR32(port + 0x80u) = __builtin_bswap32(ip);                /* (network order) */
    MR32(T_SEATS + 0x20u * (uint32_t)s) = (uint32_t)slot; MR32(T_SEATS + 0x20u * (uint32_t)s + 4u) = id;
}

/* ---- the rates, the race clock, the cars where their owners have them ---- */
static uint32_t g_lcg = 12345u;
static float rnd01(void){ g_lcg = g_lcg * 1664525u + 1013904223u; return (float)(g_lcg >> 8) / 16777216.f; }
/* a creator's answer as the joiner's handler gets it: a bit stream, read
 * position at bit 8, our real-time clock echoed, its race clock */
#define BSTREAM 0x10050000u
static void answer(float f1, float f2){
    union { float f; uint32_t u; } a = { f1 }, b = { f2 };
    memset(g_mem + BSTREAM, 0, 0x410);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 32; i++){
        uint32_t pa = 8 + i, pb = 40 + i;
        if (a.u >> (31 - i) & 1u) g_mem[BSTREAM + (pa >> 3)] |= (uint8_t)(0x80u >> (pa & 7));
        if (b.u >> (31 - i) & 1u) g_mem[BSTREAM + (pb >> 3)] |= (uint8_t)(0x80u >> (pb & 7));
    }
    MR32(BSTREAM + BS_READ) = 8;
    g_c.esp = STACK - 0x100u; MR32(g_c.esp + 4u) = BSTREAM;
    sub_005891b0(&g_c);
}
/* the wall clock (racenet.c's now_us: the fake clock) */
static void setwall(double r){ g_fake_ns = (uint64_t)(r * 1e9 + 0.5); }
/* a car state of ours to the creator (0x585D50's: 8 bits the message, 32 the
 * race clock, the slot's bits, 32 our real-time stamp, 8 the flags) */
#define BSOUT 0x10090000u
static void sent_state(float stamp){
    union { float f; uint32_t u; } a = { stamp };
    uint32_t nb = MR32(G_SLOTBITS), pos = 40u + nb;
    memset(g_mem + BSOUT, 0, 0x410);
    g_mem[BSOUT] = MSG_CARSPAM;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 32; i++, pos++) if (a.u >> (31 - i) & 1u) g_mem[BSOUT + (pos >> 3)] |= (uint8_t)(0x80u >> (pos & 7));
    MR32(BSOUT + BS_BYTES) = 80u + nb;
    g_c.esp = STACK - 0x100u; MR32(g_c.esp + 4u) = MSG_CARSPAM; MR32(g_c.esp + 8u) = BSOUT; MR32(g_c.esp + 12u) = 0;
    sub_00585d50(&g_c);
}
#define CTL    0x10060000u
#define INPUT  0x10070000u
#define STATE  0x10080000u
static void put_state(float t, const float *p, const float *v, const float *w, const float *q, float brake){
    memset(g_mem + STATE, 0, 0x100);
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 3; k++){ MRF32(STATE + ST_POS + 4 * k) = p[k]; MRF32(STATE + ST_VEL + 4 * k) = v[k]; MRF32(STATE + ST_SPIN + 4 * k) = w[k]; }
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 4; k++) MRF32(STATE + ST_QUAT + 4 * k) = q[k];
    MRF32(STATE + ST_TIME) = t; MRF32(STATE + ST_BRAKE) = brake; MRF32(STATE + ST_GAS) = 0.9f;
    g_c.esp = STACK - 0x100u; MR32(g_c.esp + 4u) = STATE; g_c.ecx = CTL;
    sub_005f8900(&g_c);
}
static void blend(void){ g_c.esp = STACK - 0x100u; g_c.ecx = CTL; MRF32(INPUT + 0x214u) = 0.7f; sub_005f8af0(&g_c); }
static float dist3(const float *a, const float *b){ float d = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) d += (a[i] - b[i]) * (a[i] - b[i]); return sqrtf(d); }
static void fidelity(void){
    uint32_t g[] = { G_RATES, G_CLK_TARGET, G_CLK_FLAG, G_CLK_ECHO, G_REALTIMER, G_WORLDTIME_S };
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof g / sizeof g[0]; i++) commit(g[i], 32);
    commit(BSTREAM, 0x410); commit(BSOUT, 0x410); commit(CTL, 0x200); commit(INPUT, 0x220); commit(STATE, 0x100);
    MR32(G_NET_HOST) = 0; MR32(G_GAMEMODE) = 8;

    /* rates: every field group at RATE_HZ in a network race, the game's back after */
    MR32(G_GAMEMODE) = 1; frame(); MR32(G_GAMEMODE) = 8;   /* (the earlier cases raced with this page: its values back) */
    MR32(G_RATES) = 20; MR32(G_RATES + 4) = 10; MR32(G_RATES + 8) = 5; MR32(G_RATES + 12) = 5;
    frame();
    int on = MR32(G_RATES) == RATE_HZ && MR32(G_RATES + 4) == RATE_HZ && MR32(G_RATES + 12) == RATE_HZ;
    MR32(G_GAMEMODE) = 1; frame();
    int back = MR32(G_RATES) == 20 && MR32(G_RATES + 4) == 10 && MR32(G_RATES + 8) == 5 && MR32(G_RATES + 12) == 5;
    CHECK(on && back, "rates: %u a second for every field in a race (%d), the game's 20/10/5/5 after it (%d)", RATE_HZ, on, back);
    MR32(G_GAMEMODE) = 8;

    /* the race clock: answers whose round trips wait 0-80 ms on the way back
     * (a queue, the creator's frame) say the clock is up to 40 ms earlier;
     * the estimate takes the least waited ones.  Times on the wall clock;
     * our states' real-time stamps anything (the game's clock stands through
     * long frames): the round trip is from when the state went */
    const double theta = 7.25;                           /* the creator's clock minus our wall clock */
    double r = 100.0, worst_game = 0;
    float stamp = 1000.f;
    for (int i = 0; i < 90; i++){                        /* 3 s at 30 answers a second */
        double extra = rnd01() < 0.2 ? 0.0 : 0.08 * rnd01();
        double send = r - 0.1 - extra;                   /* our state left then: 50 ms up, 50 + extra down */
        stamp += 0.5f; MRF32(G_CLK_ECHO) = stamp - 0.25f;
        setwall(send); sent_state(stamp);
        setwall(r); answer(stamp, (float)(r - 0.05 - extra + theta));
        double one = (r - 0.05 - extra + theta) + 0.5 * (r - send) - r - theta;
        if (fabs(one) > worst_game) worst_game = fabs(one);
        r += 1.0 / 30.0;
    }
    CHECK(K.have && fabs(K.th - theta) < 0.004 && K.samples == 90,
          "clock: the estimate %.1f ms off (one sample, as the game took it: up to %.1f ms off)", (K.th - theta) * 1e3, worst_game * 1e3);
    /* an answer to a state we never sent (an older game's echo): taken by nobody */
    uint32_t ns = K.samples; MRF32(G_CLK_ECHO) = 1.f; setwall(r); answer(3.5f, (float)(r + theta));
    CHECK(K.samples == ns, "clock: an answer echoing no state of ours left out");
    /* restored: the game's own target and flag stay as they were */
    MR32(G_CLK_TARGET) = 1234u; MR8(G_CLK_FLAG) = 0;
    stamp += 0.5f; MRF32(G_CLK_ECHO) = stamp - 0.25f; setwall(r - 0.1); sent_state(stamp); setwall(r); answer(stamp, (float)(r - 0.05 + theta));
    CHECK(MR32(G_CLK_TARGET) == 1234u && MR8(G_CLK_FLAG) == 0, "clock: the game's target and flag untouched (%u %u)", MR32(G_CLK_TARGET), MR8(G_CLK_FLAG));
    /* the creator's clock loses 150 ms (its stall): followed within 10 answers */
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++){
        r += 1.0 / 30.0;
        stamp += 0.5f; MRF32(G_CLK_ECHO) = stamp - 0.25f; setwall(r - 0.1); sent_state(stamp);
        setwall(r); answer(stamp, (float)(r - 0.05 + theta - 0.15));
    }
    CHECK(fabs(K.th - (theta - 0.15)) < 0.004, "clock: a 150 ms step of the creator's clock followed (%.1f ms off)", (K.th - theta + 0.15) * 1e3);
    /* a creator (an older game) whose clock runs 7 % slow: it drifts */
    double th2 = theta - 0.15, worst = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 90; i++){
        r += 1.0 / 30.0; th2 -= 0.07 / 30.0;
        double extra = rnd01() < 0.2 ? 0.0 : 0.08 * rnd01();
        stamp += 0.5f; MRF32(G_CLK_ECHO) = stamp - 0.25f; setwall(r - 0.1 - extra); sent_state(stamp);
        setwall(r); answer(stamp, (float)(r - 0.05 - extra + th2));
        if (i >= 45 && fabs(K.th - th2) > worst) worst = fabs(K.th - th2);
    }
    CHECK(worst < 0.005 && fabs(K.drift + 0.07) < 0.02, "clock: a creator 7 %% slow followed (at most %.1f ms off, drift %.3f)", worst * 1e3, K.drift);
    K.drift = 0;
    /* WorldTimer to it: 50 ms off, frames of 8.3 ms: never over a fifth of a frame a frame, the world's step untouched */
    K.th = theta; K.at = r; K.frac = 0; K.irate = 0; K.wok = 0;
    double rr = r;
    setwall(rr);
    MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) = (uint32_t)((rr + theta - 0.05) * 4000.0 + 0.5);
    MRF32(G_WORLDDT) = 0.0083f;
    clock_frame();
    int steady = 1; double left = 0; uint32_t prev = MR32(G_WORLDTIMER);
    for (int f = 0; f < 240; f++){                       /* 2 s */
        rr += 0.0083; setwall(rr);
        uint32_t adv = 33u;                              /* the world's step: the frame's time */
        MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) += adv; prev += adv;
        K.at = rr;
        clock_frame();
        int32_t d = (int32_t)(MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) - prev);
        if (d > 7 || d < -7) steady = 0;
        prev = MR32(G_WORLDTIMER);
        left = rr + theta - (double)MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) * 0.00025;
    }
    CHECK(steady && fabs(left) < 0.001 && fabsf(MRF32(G_WORLDDT) - 0.0083f) < 1e-6f,
          "clock: WorldTimer to the estimate (%.2f ms left after 2 s, at most a fifth of a frame a frame %d), the step untouched", left * 1e3, steady);
    /* the game's catch-up: frames of 22 ms, each 0, 1 or 2 world steps of 16.7 ms
     * one right after the other (main-loop passes), the world 1 % slower than the wall
     * clock: WorldTimer around the wall clock, not run off (the per-pass top-up of
     * the time missing ran it 6 % fast) */
    {
        double acc = 0, h1 = 0, h2 = 0, mx = 0;
        for (int f = 0; f < 900; f++){                   /* 20 s */
            rr += 0.022; acc += 0.022 * 0.99;
            int steps = 0;
            while (acc >= 1.0 / 60 && steps < 3){ acc -= 1.0 / 60; steps++; }
            for (int k = 0; k < (steps ? steps : 1); k++){
                setwall(rr + 0.0001 * k);
                if (steps) MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) += 67u;      /* 16.75 ms */
                K.at = rr; clock_frame();
            }
            double l = rr + theta - (double)MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) * 0.00025;
            if (f >= 300 && f < 600) h1 += l / 300; else if (f >= 600) h2 += l / 300;
            if (f >= 300 && fabs(l) > mx) mx = fabs(l);
        }
        CHECK(fabs(h2 - h1) < 0.002 && fabs(h2) < 0.012 && mx < 0.03,
              "clock: through the game's catch-up steps, 1 %% slow: %.2f then %.2f ms off on average (a step's sawtooth), at most %.1f ms",
              h1 * 1e3, h2 * 1e3, mx * 1e3);
    }
    double lag = 0;
    for (int f = 0; f < 480; f++){
        rr += 0.0083; setwall(rr);
        MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) += 31u;                        /* 7.75 ms of the frame's 8.3: 7 % short */
        K.at = rr; clock_frame();
        if (f > 240){ double l = fabs(rr + theta - (double)MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) * 0.00025); if (l > lag) lag = l; }
    }
    CHECK(lag < 0.003, "clock: our own world 7 %% short of the wall clock, WorldTimer kept to it (at most %.2f ms off after 2 s)", lag * 1e3);
    MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) = (uint32_t)((rr + theta - 0.4) * 4000.0 + 0.5); K.at = rr;
    uint32_t hard = K.hard; clock_frame();
    CHECK(K.hard == hard + 1 && fabs(rr + theta - (double)MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) * 0.00025) < 0.001, "clock: 400 ms off set at once");
    /* the creator: its own clock on the wall clock from the race's start (its clock is everyone's) */
    MR32(G_NET_HOST) = 1; MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) = 4000u; K.wok = 0; K.frac = 0; clock_frame();
    {
        double hr0 = rr, hw0 = (double)MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) * 0.00025, acc = 0, h1 = 0, h2 = 0, mx = 0;
        for (int f = 0; f < 900; f++){
            rr += 0.022; acc += 0.022 * 0.97;            /* its world 3 % slow, catch-up steps */
            int steps = 0;
            while (acc >= 1.0 / 60 && steps < 3){ acc -= 1.0 / 60; steps++; }
            for (int k = 0; k < (steps ? steps : 1); k++){ setwall(rr + 0.0001 * k); if (steps) MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) += 67u; clock_frame(); }
            double o = ((double)MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) * 0.00025 - hw0) - (rr - hr0);
            if (f >= 300 && f < 600) h1 += o / 300; else if (f >= 600) h2 += o / 300;
            if (f >= 300 && fabs(o) > mx) mx = fabs(o);
        }
        CHECK(fabs(h2 - h1) < 0.002 && fabs(h2) < 0.012 && mx < 0.03,
              "clock: the creator's clock on the wall clock, its world 3 %% slow: %.2f then %.2f ms off on average, at most %.1f ms",
              h1 * 1e3, h2 * 1e3, mx * 1e3);
    }
    MR32(RC) = 0; uint32_t w1 = MR32(G_WORLDTIMER); rr += 0.08; setwall(rr); clock_frame();
    CHECK(MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) == w1, "clock: out of the race the game's own (untouched)");
    MR32(RC) = RC_RACING; MR32(G_NET_HOST) = 0; K.wok = 0;

    /* carried on along its curve: a car on a 100 m circle at 40 m/s, states
     * 33 ms apart, shown 200 ms past the newest */
    MR32(CTL + CTL_CAR) = CAR_A; MR32(CAR_A + CAR_INPUT) = INPUT; MR32(CAR_A + 0x28u) = 0;
    const float R0 = 100.f, V0 = 40.f, om = V0 / R0;
    float t0 = 50.f, q0[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 1 }, wz[3] = { 0, 0, om };
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++){
        float t = t0 + (float)i / 30.f, ang = om * t;
        float p[3] = { R0 * sinf(ang), R0 * (1.f - cosf(ang)), 0 }, v[3] = { V0 * cosf(ang), V0 * sinf(ang), 0 };
        float q[4] = { 0, 0, sinf(ang / 2), cosf(ang / 2) };
        put_state(t, p, v, wz, q, 0.25f);
        (void)q0;
    }
    Pred *pp = pred_of(CAR_A, 0);
    float tn = t0 + 1.f / 30.f + 0.2f, ang = om * tn, truth[3] = { R0 * sinf(ang), R0 * (1.f - cosf(ang)), 0 };
    float op[3], ov[3], oq[4];
    pred_at(pp, tn, op, ov, oq);
    const PState *s = &pp->s[1];
    float line[3] = { s->p[0] + s->v[0] * 0.2f, s->p[1] + s->v[1] * 0.2f, 0 };
    float yaw = remainderf(2.f * atan2f(oq[2], oq[3]) - ang, 2.f * (float)M_PI) + ang;
    CHECK(pp && pp->n == 2 && dist3(op, truth) < 0.02f && fabsf(yaw - ang) < 0.01f,
          "predict: 200 ms on along the curve %.3f m off (a straight line %.3f m), heading %.4f rad off",
          dist3(op, truth), dist3(line, truth), yaw - ang);

    /* an older game's state repeats the last velocity and spin: taken from the places and orientations */
    {
        Pred *po = pp; PState keep[2] = { po->s[0], po->s[1] }; int kn = po->n;
        float t1 = po->s[1].t + 0.05f, a1 = om * t1;
        float p1[3] = { R0 * sinf(a1), R0 * (1.f - cosf(a1)), 0 }, q1[4] = { 0, 0, sinf(a1 / 2), cosf(a1 / 2) };
        float vold[3] = { po->s[1].v[0], po->s[1].v[1], po->s[1].v[2] }, wold[3] = { po->s[1].w[0], po->s[1].w[1], po->s[1].w[2] };
        float vtrue[3] = { V0 * cosf(a1 - om * 0.025f), V0 * sinf(a1 - om * 0.025f), 0 };   /* (the mean over the 50 ms) */
        put_state(t1, p1, vold, wold, q1, 0.25f);
        float ev = dist3(po->s[1].v, vtrue), ew = fabsf(po->s[1].w[2] - om);
        CHECK(po->old_states == 1 && ev < 0.05f && ew < 0.01f, "older game: a repeated velocity from the places (%.3f m/s off), spin from the orientations (%.4f rad/s off)", ev, ew);
        po->s[0] = keep[0]; po->s[1] = keep[1]; po->n = kn; po->old_states = 0;
    }
    /* the blend: put through the game's apply, the owner's controls kept */
    MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) = (uint32_t)((t0 + 1.f / 30.f + 0.1f) * 4000.f); MRF32(G_WORLDDT) = 0.0083f;
    MR32(CTL + CTL_NPRED) = 3; MR32(CTL + CTL_HIT) = 0;
    blend();
    float bp[3]; rd3(CTL + CTL_BLEND + 0x10u, bp);
    float tw = (float)MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) * 0.00025f, a2 = om * tw, tr2[3] = { R0 * sinf(a2), R0 * (1.f - cosf(a2)), 0 };
    CHECK(pp->steps == 1 && dist3(bp, tr2) < 0.02f && MRF32(INPUT + 0x214u) == 0.25f && MRF32(INPUT + 0x20cu) == 0.9f,
          "blend: the car where its owner has it at the step's start (%.3f m), its brake %.2f (not the game's 0.7)", dist3(bp, tr2), MRF32(INPUT + 0x214u));
    /* a stall: no state for STALL_S, none of the game's predictions: on its own, then a glide back */
    MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) += (uint32_t)(4000.f * (STALL_S + 0.1f)); MR32(CTL + CTL_NPRED) = 0;
    float mark[3] = { 1.f, 2.f, 3.f };
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 3; k++) MRF32(CTL + CTL_BLEND + 0x10u + 4 * k) = mark[k];
    blend();
    rd3(CTL + CTL_BLEND + 0x10u, bp);
    CHECK(pp->own == 1 && dist3(bp, mark) < 1e-6f && MRF32(INPUT + 0x214u) == 0.25f, "stall: on its own physics, its brake %.2f", MRF32(INPUT + 0x214u));
    float tnew = (float)MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) * 0.00025f - 0.05f, an = om * tnew;
    float pn[3] = { R0 * sinf(an), R0 * (1.f - cosf(an)), 0 }, vn[3] = { V0 * cosf(an), V0 * sinf(an), 0 }, qn[4] = { 0, 0, sinf(an / 2), cosf(an / 2) };
    put_state(tnew, pn, vn, wz, qn, 0.f);
    float tg[3], tgv[3], tgq[4];
    pred_at(pp, (float)MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) * 0.00025f, tg, tgv, tgq);
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 3; k++) MRF32(CTL + CTL_BLEND + 0x10u + 4 * k) = tg[k] + (k == 0 ? 6.f : 0.f);   /* it ran 6 m off */
    MR32(CTL + CTL_NPRED) = 1;
    blend();
    float e0 = len3(pp->ep);
    for (int f = 0; f < 60; f++){ MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) += 33u; blend(); }
    float e1 = len3(pp->ep);
    for (int f = 0; f < 120; f++){ MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) += 33u; blend(); }
    CHECK(pp->glides == 1 && e0 > 5.5f && e0 < 6.f && e1 < 1.f && len3(pp->ep) < 0.02f && pp->snaps == 0,
          "stall: back from 6 m off gliding (%.2f m after the first step, %.2f m after 0.5 s, %.3f m after 1.5 s)", e0, e1, len3(pp->ep));
    /* a hit of this game after its newest state: on its own until a newer state */
    MR32(CTL + CTL_HIT) = MR32(G_WORLDTIMER); uint32_t own0 = pp->own_steps;
    MR32(G_WORLDTIMER) += 33u; blend();
    CHECK(pp->own_steps == own0 + 1, "hit: on its own after a hit here (%u)", pp->own_steps - own0);
    MR32(CTL + CTL_HIT) = 0;
}

int main(void){
    setenv("NFSU2_INPUT_SCRIPT", "racenet_unit", 1);   /* (the test knobs would be read; none set) */
    g_mem = mmap(0, 1ull << 32, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_ANON | MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_NORESERVE, -1, 0);
    if (g_mem == MAP_FAILED){ printf("no 4 GB reservation\n"); return 1; }
    const uint32_t creator = 0x0a4d0101u, j2 = 0x0a4d0303u, j3 = 0x0a4d0404u, stranger = 0x0a4d0909u;
    race_setup();
    frame();                                             /* the race begins */

    uint8_t pl[8 + 4 * NPL], m[CS_HDR + 64];
    const uint32_t joiners[2] = { j2, j3 }, mine[1] = { stranger };
    int n = list(pl, joiners, 2);
    g_peer[0] = creator; g_peer[1] = stranger; g_npeer = 2;   /* a datagram to our UDP 3658 makes anyone a race peer */
    g_sentto[0] = creator; g_nsentto = 1;                     /* the game's race link sends only to its creator */
    racenet_list(pl, n, stranger);
    CHECK(g_pl.n == 0 && R.pl_refused == 1, "stranger: a list from a race peer the game does not send to: refused (%u, %u)", g_pl.n, R.pl_refused);

    racenet_list(pl, n, creator);
    CHECK(g_pl.n == 2 && g_pl.ip[0] == j2 && g_pl.ip[1] == j3 && g_pl.from == creator, "creator: its list taken (%u)", g_pl.n);

    g_sentto[1] = stranger; g_nsentto = 2;
    n = list(pl, mine, 1);
    racenet_list(pl, n, stranger);
    CHECK(g_pl.n == 2 && g_pl.from == creator && g_pl.ip[0] == j2 && R.pl_refused == 2,
          "second: a list from another address the race link sends to: refused, the creator's kept (%u)", R.pl_refused);
    g_nsentto = 1;

    n = carspam(m, 3, 20);
    racenet_carspam(&g_c, m, n, j2);
    CHECK(g_calls == 1 && g_fn == FN_JOIN_MSG && g_len == 20 && !memcmp(g_bytes, m + CS_HDR, 20) && R.cs_came == 1,
          "direct: j2's state for slot 3 to the game's handler (%d calls)", g_calls);
    racenet_carspam(&g_c, m, n, j2);
    CHECK(g_calls == 2, "direct: j2's next state for slot 3 too (%d calls)", g_calls);

    n = carspam(m, 2, 20); racenet_carspam(&g_c, m, n, j2);
    CHECK(g_calls == 2 && R.cs_refused == 1, "own-slot: j2 naming slot 2 after slot 3: refused (%u)", R.cs_refused);

    n = carspam(m, 3, 20); racenet_carspam(&g_c, m, n, j3);
    CHECK(g_calls == 2 && R.cs_refused == 2, "taken-slot: j3 naming j2's slot 3: refused (%u)", R.cs_refused);
    n = carspam(m, 2, 20); racenet_carspam(&g_c, m, n, j3);
    CHECK(g_calls == 3 && R.cs_came == 3, "taken-slot: j3 naming slot 2, its first: taken (%d calls)", g_calls);
    n = carspam(m, 3, 20); racenet_carspam(&g_c, m, n, j3);
    CHECK(g_calls == 3 && R.cs_refused == 3, "taken-slot: j3 then naming slot 3: refused (%u)", R.cs_refused);

    n = carspam(m, 1, 20); racenet_carspam(&g_c, m, n, j2);
    int ok1 = g_calls == 3 && R.cs_refused == 4;
    n = carspam(m, 0, 20); racenet_carspam(&g_c, m, n, j2);
    int ok0 = g_calls == 3 && R.cs_refused == 5;
    n = carspam(m, 7, 20); racenet_carspam(&g_c, m, n, j2);
    int ok7 = g_calls == 3 && R.cs_refused == 6;
    n = carspam(m, 4, 20); racenet_carspam(&g_c, m, n, stranger);
    int oks = g_calls == 3 && R.cs_refused == 7;
    CHECK(ok1 && ok0 && ok7 && oks, "rules: our slot %d, the creator's %d, past 5 %d, not on the list %d: refused", ok1, ok0, ok7, oks);

    MR32(RC) = 0; frame();                               /* the race over */
    CHECK(g_pl.n == 0 && g_pl.from == 0 && g_nbind == 0, "reset: the race over: no list, no slots (%u %d)", g_pl.n, g_nbind);
    n = carspam(m, 3, 20); racenet_carspam(&g_c, m, n, j2);
    int out = g_calls == 3;
    MR32(RC) = RC_RACING; frame();                       /* the next race: j3 now has slot 3 */
    n = list(pl, joiners, 2); racenet_list(pl, n, creator);
    n = carspam(m, 3, 20); racenet_carspam(&g_c, m, n, j3);
    CHECK(out && g_calls == 4 && g_nbind == 1 && g_bind[0].ip == j3 && g_bind[0].slot == 3,
          "reset: out of the race nothing taken; in the next one j3 may name slot 3 (%d calls)", g_calls);

    /* list-slots: the creator's list says j2 drives slot 2, j3 slot 3 (itself 0); j3 names j2's slot from the race's
     * start, 30 times (the 2026-11-05 security audit: it spoke for j2's car all race): refused every time; then each
     * joiner's own taken, and j2's after j3's tries */
    {
        MR32(RC) = 0; frame(); MR32(RC) = RC_RACING; frame();        /* a new race */
        const uint8_t js[2] = { 2, 3 };
        n = list_slots(pl, joiners, js, 2, 0); racenet_list(pl, n, creator);
        int c0 = g_calls; uint32_t r0 = R.cs_refused;
        for (int k = 0; k < 30; k++){ n = carspam(m, 2, 20); racenet_carspam(&g_c, m, n, j3); }
        uint32_t tries = R.cs_refused - r0;
        int claimed = g_calls == c0 && tries == 30;
        n = carspam(m, 2, 20); racenet_carspam(&g_c, m, n, j2);
        int j2_own = g_calls == c0 + 1 && g_bytes[5] >> 5 == 2;
        n = carspam(m, 3, 20); racenet_carspam(&g_c, m, n, j3);
        int j3_own = g_calls == c0 + 2 && g_bytes[5] >> 5 == 3;
        n = carspam(m, 3, 20); racenet_carspam(&g_c, m, n, j2);
        int j2_other = g_calls == c0 + 2 && R.cs_refused == r0 + 31;
        CHECK(claimed && j2_own && j3_own && j2_other, "list-slots: j3 naming j2's slot 2 from the start refused %u of 30, "
              "j2's own taken %d, j3's own taken %d, j2 naming j3's refused %d", tries, j2_own, j3_own, j2_other);
    }
    /* old-creator: a list without the slots (a creator of an older version): the first slot named, as before (not every
     * state refused) */
    {
        MR32(RC) = 0; frame(); MR32(RC) = RC_RACING; frame();
        n = list(pl, joiners, 2); racenet_list(pl, n, creator);
        int c0 = g_calls; uint32_t r0 = R.cs_refused;
        n = carspam(m, 2, 20); racenet_carspam(&g_c, m, n, j3);
        int first = g_calls == c0 + 1;
        n = carspam(m, 2, 20); racenet_carspam(&g_c, m, n, j2);
        int second = g_calls == c0 + 1 && R.cs_refused == r0 + 1;
        n = carspam(m, 3, 20); racenet_carspam(&g_c, m, n, j2);
        int other = g_calls == c0 + 2;
        CHECK(first && second && other, "old-creator: no slots listed: j3 naming slot 2 first taken %d, j2 naming it then refused %d, "
              "j2 naming slot 3 taken %d", first, second, other);
    }

    /* the creator: a stranger who sent a datagram to its UDP 3658 is a race
     * peer too, but its race link sends only to its joiners */
    MR32(G_NET_HOST) = 1;
    g_peer[0] = j2; g_peer[1] = stranger; g_peer[2] = j3; g_npeer = 3;
    g_sentto[0] = j2; g_sentto[1] = j3; g_nsentto = 2;
    g_npl_out = 0; frame();
    int to_s = 0, named_s = 0, each_other = g_npl_out == 2;
    for (int k = 0; k < g_npl_out; k++){
        to_s |= g_pl_to[k] == stranger;
        for (int i = 0; i < g_pl_k[k] && i < NPL_MAX_TEST; i++) named_s |= g_pl_named[k][i] == stranger;
        each_other &= g_pl_k[k] == 1 && g_pl_named[k][0] == (g_pl_to[k] == j2 ? j3 : j2);
    }
    CHECK(each_other && !to_s && !named_s, "host-list: the list only to the joiners the race link sends to, naming only them "
          "(%d lists, to the stranger %d, naming it %d)", g_npl_out, to_s, named_s);

    /* host-slots: j2's connection is the joiner in slot 2, j3's in slot 3 (the seats in another order than the
     * connections), j4 has none; our own car slot 4: each list names the others' slots (0xFF for j4) and ours */
    {
        const uint32_t j4 = 0x0a4d0505u;
        seats_free();
        conn_put(0, 1, j2, 0x11u, 2); conn_put(1, 0, j3, 0x22u, 3);
        MR16(CAR_ME + 0xau) = 4;
        g_peer[3] = j4; g_npeer = 4; g_sentto[2] = j4; g_nsentto = 3;
        g_npl_out = 0; g_fake_ns += 1000000000u; frame();
        int good = g_npl_out == 3;
        for (int k = 0; k < g_npl_out; k++){
            const uint8_t *q = g_pl_raw[k];
            int kk = q[6], len = 8 + 5 * kk + 1;
            good &= g_pl_len[k] == len && (q[5] & 1) && q[len - 1] == 4;
            for (int i = 0; i < kk; i++){
                uint32_t a = g_pl_named[k][i];
                good &= q[8 + 4 * kk + i] == (a == j2 ? 2 : a == j3 ? 3 : 0xff) && a != g_pl_to[k];
            }
        }
        CHECK(good, "host-slots: %d lists, each with the other joiners' slots from the race connections (none for j4) and ours", g_npl_out);
        /* what racecars.c's N2RS goes by on the creator: each joiner's connection's slot, none for an address without
         * one; a connection not up (state 2) none */
        int s2 = racenet_slot_of(j2), s3 = racenet_slot_of(j3), s4 = racenet_slot_of(j4), sx = racenet_slot_of(stranger);
        MR32(T_CONNS) = 2; int down = racenet_slot_of(j2); MR32(T_CONNS) = 3;
        CHECK(s2 == 2 && s3 == 3 && s4 == -1 && sx == -1 && down == -1, "host-slots: the creator's racenet_slot_of: j2 %d, j3 %d, j4 %d, "
              "the stranger %d, j2's connection not up %d", s2, s3, s4, sx, down);
        MR16(CAR_ME + 0xau) = 0xffffu; g_nsentto = 2; g_npeer = 3;
    }

    /* the race's report of each car's largest jump (racenet_jump): a car that moves 1 m a frame (20 ms) with a state
     * every frame, then 280 m at once: 280; a stall of 1.5 s and a jump of 120 m as its state ends it: left out (a
     * car drives 150 m meanwhile), a jump of 200 m 0.6 s later counted; a stall of 1.5 s and 600 m (a player who held
     * its states back, then teleported): 450 m; a name no car has: 0 */
    {
        const uint32_t NP = 0x10050000u, ST = 0x10070000u;   /* (CTL: the one above) */
        commit(NP, 0x40); commit(CTL, 0x20); commit(ST, 0x80);
        MR32(G_NET_HOST) = 0; g_npeer = 0; g_nsentto = 0;
        MR32(G_NETPLAYERS) = NP; memcpy(&g_mem[NP + NP_NAME], "Inv", 4);
        MR16(CAR_A + 0xau) = 0; MR32(CTL + CTL_CAR) = CAR_A;
        float x = 0.f;
        #define STEP(dx, state) do{ x += (dx); MRF32(CAR_A + CAR_POS) = x; \
            if (state){ g_c.ecx = CTL; MR32(g_c.esp + 4u) = ST; sub_005f8900(&g_c); } frame(); }while(0)
        MR32(RC) = 0; frame(); MR32(RC) = RC_RACING; frame();        /* a new race */
        for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) STEP(1.f, 1);
        float before = racenet_jump("Inv");
        STEP(281.f, 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) STEP(1.f, 1);
        float j = racenet_jump("inv");
        CHECK(before == 0.f && j > 279.f && j < 281.f && racenet_jump("Nobody") == 0.f,
              "jump: 280 m at once is the car's largest (%.1f m; before it %.1f m)", (double)j, (double)before);
        char who[16]; float far = racenet_farthest(who);
        CHECK(!strcmp(who, "Inv") && far > 279.f && far < 281.f, "jump: the farthest: %s, %.1f m", who, (double)far);
        MR32(RC) = 0; frame(); MR32(RC) = RC_RACING; frame();        /* the next race */
        for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) STEP(1.f, 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < 75; i++) STEP(1.f, 0);                  /* 1.5 s without its states */
        STEP(121.f, 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) STEP(1.f, 1);
        float stalled = racenet_jump("Inv");
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) STEP(1.f, 1);
        STEP(201.f, 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) STEP(1.f, 1);
        float later = racenet_jump("Inv");
        CHECK(stalled < 1.f && later > 199.f && later < 201.f, "jump: 120 m after a 1.5 s stall left out (%.1f m), 200 m 0.6 s "
              "on counted (%.1f m)", (double)stalled, (double)later);
        for (int i = 0; i < 75; i++) STEP(1.f, 0);
        STEP(601.f, 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) STEP(1.f, 1);
        float held = racenet_jump("Inv");
        CHECK(held > 440.f && held < 460.f, "jump: 600 m after a 1.5 s stall counts the 450 m no car drives (%.1f m)", (double)held);
        #undef STEP
    }

    fidelity();

    printf(g_fail ? "racenet unit tests: FAILED\n" : "racenet unit tests: all passed\n");
    return g_fail;
}

/* radio_mixer_stub.h -- the game's mixer, its song calls and the page, stubbed for the scenarios of radio_unit.c.
 * Songs: the game's song (sample 1.0), race sounds (2.0), a folder song N (N/64 on the page's rings).
 * An ear hears an input when the input's gain for that side is above 0. */
#define INPUTS      0x300000u
#define READERS     0x310000u
#define OWNER       0x400000u
#define STREAM      0x420000u
#define VOICES      0x430000u
#define FLOW        0x410000u

#define READERS_APPEAR_AFTER 4
#define MENUS_AND_DRIVING 3u
#define MENUS_ONLY 1u
#define DRIVING_ONLY 2u
#define PAGE_RING_FRAMES (1u << 17)
#define NO_VOICE    0xffffffffu        /* a stream without a voice */
#define READER_ENDS 0xffffffffu        /* a reader's "end of stream": the game's mixer frees that input (0x7292ac) */

typedef struct { int game_song, race_sounds, folder_song; } Ear;

    int readers, pending, restart, in_step, paused, muted, plaques, plaque_folder_song, last_index, stops;
    int song_slot[2], reuse_addresses, song_on_both_sides, voices;

    int page_writes_between, ends_of_stream;       /* the page writes only after the song's first reader of a step (from the first one fed); readers that said end of stream */
    int song_ends;                                 /* the game's song readers say end of stream */
} g;

static CPU cpu;

static void call(void (*fn)(CPU *), uint32_t a1, uint32_t a2, uint32_t a3, uint32_t a4){
    cpu.esp = CALL_ESP;
    MR32(cpu.esp + 4u) = a1; MR32(cpu.esp + 8u) = a2; MR32(cpu.esp + 12u) = a3; MR32(cpu.esp + 16u) = a4;
    fn(&cpu);
}

static void publish_tags(void){
    for (unsigned place = 0; place < RADIO_PLACES; place++){
        snprintf(g_page.offer_text[place][0], RADIO_TAG, "artist");
        snprintf(g_page.offer_text[place][1], RADIO_TAG, "folder song %d", pg.next_id);
        snprintf(g_page.offer_text[place][2], RADIO_TAG, "album");
    }
    g_page.offer.tag_seq += 2;
}

static void page_serves_track(uint32_t seq){
    float *ring = g_radio.ring;
    for (uint32_t k = 0; ring && k < 2u * PAGE_RING_FRAMES; k++) ring[k] = pg.next_id / 64.0f;
    g_page.reply.total = pg.track_steps * STEP_FRAMES;
    g_page.reply.written = 0;
    g_page.reply.ready_seq = pg.served_seq = (int)seq;
    pg.next_id++;
    publish_tags();
}

static void page_writes(void){
    if (g_page.reply.written < g_page.reply.total && g_page.reply.written - g_page.rings.read < PAGE_RING_FRAMES) g_page.reply.written += pg.frames_per_step ? pg.frames_per_step : STEP_FRAMES;
}

static void page_step(void){
    uint32_t seq = g_page.request.req_seq;
    if (pg.silent || !seq) return;
    if ((int)seq != pg.served_seq) page_serves_track(seq);
    if (!g.page_writes_between) page_writes();
}

static unsigned add_input(float marker, float left, float right){
    unsigned i = 0, count = MR8(MIXER_INPUT_COUNT);
    while (i < count && MR8(INPUTS + INPUT_SIZE * i) == 2u) i++;
    if (i == count) MR8(MIXER_INPUT_COUNT) = (uint8_t)(count + 1u);
    uint32_t input = INPUTS + INPUT_SIZE * i, reader = READERS + 16u * (g.reuse_addresses ? i : (unsigned)++g.readers);
    MR8(input + INPUT_KIND) = 2u;
    MR32(input + INPUT_READER) = reader;
    MR32(input + INPUT_READER_TAIL) = 0u;
    MRF32(input + INPUT_GAINS) = left;
    MRF32(input + INPUT_GAINS + 4u) = right;
    MR32(reader) = READER_FN;
    MR32(reader + READER_SPEED) = g.paused ? 0u : 0x10000u;
    MRF32(reader + 4u) = marker;
    return i;
}

static int remove_song_readers(void){
    int had = g.song_slot[0] || g.song_slot[1];
    MR32(STREAM + STREAM_VOICE) = NO_VOICE;
    MR8(VOICES + VOICE_SIZE + VOICE_ALIVE) = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) if (g.song_slot[k]) MR8(INPUTS + INPUT_SIZE * (unsigned)(g.song_slot[k] - 1)) = 0;
    g.song_slot[0] = g.song_slot[1] = 0;
    return had;
}

static void remove_race_sounds(void){
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < MR8(MIXER_INPUT_COUNT); i++){
        uint32_t input = INPUTS + INPUT_SIZE * i;
        if (MRF32(MR32(input + INPUT_READER) + 4u) == 2.0f) MR8(input + INPUT_KIND) = 0;
    }
}

void sub_0072d18d_orig(CPU *c){
    MRF32(MR32(c->esp + 16u)) = MRF32(MR32(c->esp + 4u) + 4u);
    c->eax = g.song_ends && MRF32(MR32(c->esp + 4u) + 4u) == 1.0f ? READER_ENDS : MR32(c->esp + 8u);
}
void guest_noyield(int d){ g.noyield += d; }
void sub_00739320_orig(CPU *c){
    (void)c;
    g.stops++;
    g.stop_noyield = g.noyield;
    if (remove_song_readers() && g.in_step) g.restart = 1;
}

static void pull_inputs(void){
    int song_readers = 0;
    memset(ear, 0, sizeof ear);
    if (g.muted || g.paused) return;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < MR8(MIXER_INPUT_COUNT); i++){
        uint32_t input = INPUTS + INPUT_SIZE * i;
        if (MR8(input + INPUT_KIND) != 2u) continue;
        call(sub_0072d18d, MR32(input + INPUT_READER), STEP_FRAMES, 0, OUT);
        if (cpu.eax == READER_ENDS){
            MR8(input + INPUT_KIND) = 0;
            g.ends_of_stream++;
            continue;
        }
        if (g.page_writes_between && g_music.count && ((int)i + 1 == g.song_slot[0] || (int)i + 1 == g.song_slot[1]) && ++song_readers == 1) page_writes();
        float s = MRF32(OUT);
        for (int e = 0; e < 2; e++){
            if (!(MRF32(input + INPUT_GAINS + 4u * (unsigned)e) > 0.0f) || s == 0.0f) continue;
            if (s == 1.0f) ear[e].game_song = 1;
            else if (s == 2.0f) ear[e].race_sounds = 1;
            else ear[e].folder_song = (int)(s / PIPELINE_SCALE * 64.0f + 0.5f);
        }
    }
}

static void game_song_starts(unsigned index);
static void step(void){
    CPU c = { .esp = CALL_ESP };
    g.in_step = 1;
    page_step();
    sub_007292bc(&c);
    g.in_step = 0;
    if (g.restart){
        g.restart = 0;
        game_song_starts((unsigned)(g.last_index + 1) % RADIO_TRACKS);
    }
    pull_inputs();
}

static void unit_checks(void){
    static const unsigned long numbers[] = { 0, 26, 27, 0x8000, 0xffffffffUL };
    CPU c = { .esp = 0x00200000u };
    g_page.on = 1;
    g_page.offer.tag_seq = 2;
    g_page.offer.places = 3;
    memset(g_page.offer_text, 'A', sizeof g_page.offer_text);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof numbers / sizeof numbers[0]; i++){
        int lent = 0;
        for (unsigned e = 0; e < RADIO_TRACKS; e++) MR32(TABLE + 16u * e) = 0x1111u + e;
        g_orig_calls = 0;
        MR32(c.esp + 8u) = (uint32_t)numbers[i];
        sub_004580e0(&c);
        for (unsigned e = 0; e < RADIO_TRACKS; e++) lent += MR32(TABLE + 16u * e) != 0x1111u + e;
        CHECK(g_orig_calls == 1, "the game's own start runs once", numbers[i]);
        CHECK(lent == (numbers[i] < RADIO_TRACKS), "only a song of the table is lent", numbers[i]);
    }
    uint32_t ring = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 100; i++){
        g_page.on = 2 * i + 1;
        sub_007292bc(&c);
        if (!ring) ring = g_page.rings.ring;
        CHECK(ring && g_page.rings.ring == ring, "the rings are made once", i);
        MR32(c.esp + 8u) = 3u;
        sub_004580e0(&c);
        g_page.on++;
        sub_007292bc(&c);
        for (unsigned e = 0; e < RADIO_TRACKS; e++) CHECK(MR32(TABLE + 16u * e) == 0x1111u + e, "the table is put back", i);
    }
    for (unsigned line = 1; line <= 3; line++) CHECK(g_mem[TEXT + line * RADIO_TAG - 1u] == 0, "a tag ends with NUL", line);
}

/* The mixer's rate decides how fast the rings are read: the reader hands the mixer frames at that rate (the game's
 * own song is converted to it), and the rings hold the track at RADIO_RATE.  Ramp: ring frame k holds k / 1e6. */
static void mixer_runs_at(unsigned rate){ MR16(MIXER_RATE) = (uint16_t)rate; pg.frames_per_step = 4u * STEP_FRAMES; }
static void rings_hold_a_ramp(void){ for (uint32_t k = 0; k < RING_FRAMES; k++) g_radio.ring[k] = g_radio.ring[RING_FRAMES + k] = (float)k * 1e-6f; }
static float heard_at(unsigned k){ return MRF32(OUT + 4u * k) / PIPELINE_SCALE * 1e6f; }
static void expect_ring_read_in_10_steps(uint32_t frames){
    uint32_t before = g_page.rings.read;
    steps(10);
    expect(g_page.rings.read - before + 1u >= frames && g_page.rings.read - before <= frames + 1u, "the rings are read at the track's speed");
}

TEST(mixer_at_44100__track_is_read_frame_for_frame){
    mixer_runs_at(44100);
    folder_song_plays_in_main_menu();
    expect_folder_song(1);
    expect_ring_read_in_10_steps(10u * STEP_FRAMES);
}
TEST(mixer_at_22050__track_is_read_two_frames_for_one){
    mixer_runs_at(22050);
    folder_song_plays_in_main_menu();
    expect_folder_song(1);
    expect_ring_read_in_10_steps(20u * STEP_FRAMES);
}
TEST(mixer_at_22050__a_frame_is_the_mean_of_two){
    mixer_runs_at(22050);
    folder_song_plays_in_main_menu();
    rings_hold_a_ramp();
    uint32_t before = g_song.read[1];
    steps(1);
    float want = (float)(before + 2u * 100u) + 0.5f, got = heard_at(100);
    expect(got > want - 0.1f && got < want + 0.1f, "frame 100 is the mean of ring frames 2*100 and 2*100+1");
}
TEST(mixer_at_48000__track_is_read_slower_than_frame_for_frame){
    mixer_runs_at(48000);
    folder_song_plays_in_main_menu();
    expect_ring_read_in_10_steps(10u * STEP_FRAMES * 44100u / 48000u);
}
TEST(mixer_rate_not_known__track_is_read_frame_for_frame){
    mixer_runs_at(0);
    folder_song_plays_in_main_menu();
    expect_ring_read_in_10_steps(10u * STEP_FRAMES);
}
TEST(mixer_at_22050__track_lasts_half_as_many_steps){
    mixer_runs_at(22050);
    folder_song_lasts(100);
    folder_song_plays_in_main_menu();
    expect_folder_song(1);
    steps(40);
    expect_folder_song(2);
}

/* The song playing, for the page's scrobbles (song_heard_*): told only while the page listens. */
static void page_listens(void){ g_page.listen = 1; }
static void game_song_has_tags(unsigned index){
    strcpy((char *)g_mem + NAMES + 0x100u, "Riders on the Storm");
    strcpy((char *)g_mem + NAMES + 0x200u, "Snoop Dogg");
    strcpy((char *)g_mem + NAMES + 0x300u, "Need for Speed Underground 2");
    MR32(TABLE + 16u * index) = NAMES + 0x100u;
    MR32(TABLE + 16u * index + 4u) = NAMES + 0x200u;
    MR32(TABLE + 16u * index + 8u) = NAMES + 0x300u;
}
static int heard_ms_near(uint32_t ms){ return g_page.song_ms + 50u >= ms && g_page.song_ms <= ms + 50u; }
static int song_text_is(const char *artist, const char *title, const char *album){
    return !strcmp(g_page.song_text[0], artist) && !strcmp(g_page.song_text[1], title) && !strcmp(g_page.song_text[2], album);
}

int main(void){
    g_mem = calloc(1, 0x28000000u);
    if (!g_mem) return 1;
    unit_checks();
    for (int i = 0; i < scenarios; i++){
        reset();
        t_failed = 0;
        list[i].fn();
        scenarios_failed += t_failed;
        printf("%s %s%s%s\n", t_failed ? "FAIL" : "ok  ", list[i].name, t_failed ? ": " : "", t_failed ? t_note : "");
    }
    printf("radio_unit: %d failed; scenarios: %d of %d failed\n", g_fail, scenarios_failed, scenarios);
    return g_fail != 0 || scenarios_failed != 0;
}

/* roam_crowd.c -- one simulated free-roam player for load tests
 * (web/tools/roam-crowd.mjs): the real core (runtime/roam_core.c) in hub
 * mode, built for wasm without a C library and driven from JavaScript.  The
 * script moves it along a track and hands it what arrives; it sends through
 * the import crowd.send, and tells its joins and leaves through crowd.event.
 * Its car is a car of the type the script names, stock or with the parts it
 * names. */
#include "roam_core.h"

__attribute__((import_module("crowd"), import_name("send"))) void js_send(uint32_t ip, uint32_t port, const uint8_t *b, int n);
__attribute__((import_module("crowd"), import_name("event"))) void js_event(int ev, const char *t, int n);

/* the C library this needs: roam_core.c calls memcmp, its name filter (names.h)
 * strcmp, strncmp, strchr, strstr, strlen, strcpy, strcat and memcpy, the compiler may call the others */
void *memcpy(void *d, const void *s, unsigned long n){ unsigned char *o = d; const unsigned char *i = s; while (n--) *o++ = *i++; return d; }
void *memmove(void *d, const void *s, unsigned long n){
    unsigned char *o = d; const unsigned char *i = s;
    if (o < i) while (n--) *o++ = *i++; else { o += n; i += n; while (n--) *--o = *--i; }
    return d;
}
void *memset(void *d, int c, unsigned long n){ unsigned char *o = d; while (n--) *o++ = (unsigned char)c; return d; }
int memcmp(const void *a, const void *b, unsigned long n){
    const unsigned char *x = a, *y = b;
    for (; n; n--, x++, y++) if (*x != *y) return *x < *y ? -1 : 1;
    return 0;
}
unsigned long strlen(const char *s){ unsigned long n = 0; while (s[n]) n++; return n; }
char *strcpy(char *d, const char *s){ char *o = d; while ((*o++ = *s++)) {} return d; }
char *strcat(char *d, const char *s){ strcpy(d + strlen(d), s); return d; }
int strcmp(const char *a, const char *b){
    while (*a && *a == *b){ a++; b++; }
    return (unsigned char)*a - (unsigned char)*b;
}
int strncmp(const char *a, const char *b, unsigned long n){
    for (; n && *a && *a == *b; n--){ a++; b++; }
    return n ? (unsigned char)*a - (unsigned char)*b : 0;
}
char *strchr(const char *s, int c){
    for (; ; s++){
        if (*s == (char)c) return (char *)s;
        if (!*s) return 0;
    }
}
char *strstr(const char *h, const char *n){
    for (; ; h++){
        unsigned long i = 0;
        while (n[i] && h[i] == n[i]) i++;
        if (!n[i]) return (char *)h;
        if (!*h) return 0;
    }
}

static rc_session S;
static uint8_t IO[4096];                     /* a datagram, or the name, car type, parts, flag and license plate */
static void io_send(void *u, uint32_t ip, uint16_t port, const uint8_t *b, int n){ (void)u; js_send(ip, port, b, n); }
static void io_event(void *u, int ev, int peer, const char *t){ (void)u; (void)peer; js_event(ev, t, (int)strlen(t)); }

/* the links the players ask the hub for (--links; 0: they say nothing, and get 32), before crowd_init */
static int LINKS;
__attribute__((export_name("crowd_links"))) void crowd_links(uint32_t n){ LINKS = (int)n; }
/* the car's open parts (roam-crowd --open, RC_OPEN_*): sent in every state's extension (the wheels' heights out of the
 * receiver's range: at rest) */
static uint8_t OPEN;
__attribute__((export_name("crowd_open"))) void crowd_open(uint32_t m){ OPEN = (uint8_t)(m & RC_OPEN_ALL); }
/* the car's crash damage (roam-crowd --dents, RC_MSG_DENTS to the games that show it), RC_DMG_MAX dents: mode 1 once;
 * 2 a new set, a new epoch (a repair and a crash), every `ms`; 3 as 2 with bytes at random; before crowd_init */
static int DMG_MODE, DMG_MS = 1000; static uint32_t DMG_SEED = 1, DMG_EPOCH; static int64_t DMG_NEXT;
static uint8_t DMG_D[RC_DMG_MAX * RC_DMG_BYTES];
__attribute__((export_name("crowd_dents"))) void crowd_dents(uint32_t mode, uint32_t ms, uint32_t seed){
    DMG_MODE = (int)mode; DMG_MS = (int)ms; DMG_SEED = seed | 1u; }
static uint32_t dmg_rand(void){ DMG_SEED ^= DMG_SEED << 13; DMG_SEED ^= DMG_SEED >> 17; DMG_SEED ^= DMG_SEED << 5; return DMG_SEED; }
static void dmg_publish(int64_t now){
    DMG_EPOCH++;
    for (int i = 0; i < RC_DMG_MAX; i++){
        uint8_t *b = DMG_D + i * RC_DMG_BYTES;
        if (DMG_MODE == 3){ for (int k = 0; k < RC_DMG_BYTES; k++) b[k] = (uint8_t)dmg_rand(); continue; }
        /* a point on a side of the body's box (x +-2.1 m, y +-0.85 m, z 0.2..1.2 m), pushed in, 5 to 25 cm deep */
        int side = (int)(dmg_rand() % 4u);
        int16_t p[3];
        p[0] = (int16_t)((int)(dmg_rand() % 4200u) - 2100); p[1] = (int16_t)((int)(dmg_rand() % 1700u) - 850);
        p[2] = (int16_t)(200 + (int)(dmg_rand() % 1000u));
        int8_t d[3] = { 0, 0, (int8_t)-20 };
        if (side == 0){ p[0] = 2100; d[0] = -120; } else if (side == 1){ p[0] = -2100; d[0] = 120; }
        else if (side == 2){ p[1] = 850; d[1] = -120; } else { p[1] = -850; d[1] = 120; }
        memcpy(b, p, 6); b[6] = (uint8_t)d[0]; b[7] = (uint8_t)d[1]; b[8] = (uint8_t)d[2];
        b[9] = (uint8_t)(50 + dmg_rand() % 206u); b[10] = (uint8_t)(60 + dmg_rand() % 190u);
    }
    rc_set_dents(&S, (uint8_t)DMG_EPOCH, 0, RC_DMG_MAX, DMG_D, now);
    DMG_NEXT = now + (int64_t)DMG_MS * 1000;
}

/* the buffer the script writes a name or a received datagram into */
__attribute__((export_name("crowd_io"))) uint8_t *crowd_io(void){ return IO; }

/* name, car type, parts, flag and license plate (in IO, each 0-terminated), id, room hash, a crew's hash (0: none), the hub's address, our port, the car type's
 * name hash, states per SNAP */
__attribute__((export_name("crowd_init"))) void crowd_init(uint32_t id, uint32_t room, uint32_t crew, uint32_t hub_ip, uint32_t port,
                                                           uint32_t type_hash, uint32_t states, double now_us){
    rc_config cf; memset(&cf, 0, sizeof cf);
    cf.self_id = id; cf.port = (uint16_t)port; cf.room = room; cf.platform = RC_PLAT_TOOL;
    if (crew){ cf.crews[0] = crew; cf.n_crews = 1; }
    cf.max_players = RC_MAX_PLAYERS; cf.rate_hz = 20; cf.snap_states = (int)states; cf.hub_ip = hub_ip; cf.hub_port = (uint16_t)port;
    cf.links = LINKS;
    rc_name_clean(cf.name, (const char *)IO, RC_NAME_MAX);
    { /* the flag before the name (--flags), after the parts */
      const char *t = (const char *)IO + strlen((const char *)IO) + 1, *pa = t + strlen(t) + 1, *f = pa + strlen(pa) + 1;
      for (int i = 0; i < RC_FLAG_MAX && f[i]; i++) cf.flag[i] = f[i];
      /* the license plate (--plates), after the flag: one rc_plate_ok refuses, none */
      const char *pl = f + strlen(f) + 1;
      size_t n = strlen(pl);
      if (n <= RC_PLATE_MAX && rc_plate_ok(pl, (uint32_t)n)) memcpy(cf.plate, pl, n); }
    rc_io io = { 0, io_send, 0, io_event };
    rc_session_init(&S, &cf, &io);
    rc_carcfg cc; memset(&cc, 0, sizeof cc);
    cc.type_hash = type_hash; cc.ride_b[3] = 1;
    { const char *n = (const char *)IO + strlen((const char *)IO) + 1; for (int i = 0; i < RC_CFG_TYPE_NAME && n[i]; i++) cc.type_name[i] = n[i];
      /* then parts, "slot:key:owner" in hex, comma-separated (--parts) */
      const char *p = n + strlen(n) + 1;
      while (*p && cc.n_parts < RC_PART_SLOTS){
          uint32_t v[3] = { 0, 0, 0 };
          for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++){
              for (; (*p >= '0' && *p <= '9') || ((*p | 0x20) >= 'a' && (*p | 0x20) <= 'f'); p++)
                  v[k] = v[k] << 4 | (uint32_t)(*p <= '9' ? *p - '0' : (*p | 0x20) - 'a' + 10);
              if (*p == ':') p++;
          }

/* where the car is now (heading in radians, 0 = +x), and the session's timers */
__attribute__((export_name("crowd_tick"))) void crowd_tick(double now_us, float x, float y, float z, float vx, float vy, float vz, float heading){
    rc_state st; memset(&st, 0, sizeof st);
    st.t_us = (uint32_t)(int64_t)now_us;
    st.p[0] = x; st.p[1] = y; st.p[2] = z; st.v[0] = vx; st.v[1] = vy; st.v[2] = vz;
    /* the heading as a rotation about z: q = (0, 0, sin h/2, cos h/2), by
     * the series (no libm; |h| <= pi) */
    float a = heading / 2.f, a2 = a * a;
    st.q[2] = a - a * a2 / 6.f + a * a2 * a2 / 120.f - a * a2 * a2 * a2 / 5040.f;
    st.q[3] = 1.f - a2 / 2.f + a2 * a2 / 24.f - a2 * a2 * a2 / 720.f + a2 * a2 * a2 * a2 / 40320.f;
    st.speed = rc_sqrtf(vx * vx + vy * vy); st.rpm = 2500.f; st.gear = 3; st.throttle = 0.5f;
    if (OPEN){ st.ext = 1; st.open = OPEN; for (int w = 0; w < 4; w++) st.wz[w] = 5.f; }
    rc_push_state(&S, &st, (int64_t)now_us);
    if (DMG_MODE >= 2 && (int64_t)now_us >= DMG_NEXT) dmg_publish((int64_t)now_us);
    rc_tick(&S, (int64_t)now_us);
}

/* this player hosts a race lobby (roam-crowd --lobbies): its advert to the
 * hub, as a host's game sends one every second (roam_game.c mp_*); a host
 * takes LOBBY messages, so its HELLOs say so from now on */
__attribute__((export_name("crowd_lobby"))) int crowd_lobby(uint32_t lobby, uint32_t race, int x, int y, int n, int max){

    l.x = (int16_t)x; l.y = (int16_t)y; l.n = (uint8_t)n; l.ids[0] = S.conf.self_id;
    return rc_send_lobby(&S, &l);
}

static int load_track(const char *path, double start){
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "r");
    if (!f){ fprintf(stderr, "fakepeer: cannot read %s\n", path); return 0; }
    char line[512]; int cap = 0; double t0 = -1;
    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, f)){
        if (line[0] != 'L') continue;
        long long host; double sync; char id[16]; float x, y, z, sp;
        if (sscanf(line, "L,%lld,%lf,%15[^,],%f,%f,%f,%f", &host, &sync, id, &x, &y, &z, &sp) != 7) continue;

        if (t0 < 0) t0 = t;
        if (t - t0 < start) continue;

        if (g_ntr && t <= g_tr[g_ntr - 1].t) continue;
        g_tr[g_ntr].t = t; g_tr[g_ntr].p[0] = x; g_tr[g_ntr].p[1] = y; g_tr[g_ntr].p[2] = z; g_ntr++;
    }
    fclose(f);

    fprintf(stderr, "fakepeer: track %d frames, %.1f s\n", g_ntr, g_tr[g_ntr - 1].t);

/* position at t (looped), velocity by central difference */
static void track_at(double t, float *p, float *v){
    double span = g_tr[g_ntr - 1].t;
    t = fmod(t, span); if (t < 0) t += span;
    int lo = 0, hi = g_ntr - 1;
    while (hi - lo > 1){ int m = (lo + hi) / 2; if (g_tr[m].t <= t) lo = m; else hi = m; }
    double u = (t - g_tr[lo].t) / (g_tr[hi].t - g_tr[lo].t);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) p[i] = (float)(g_tr[lo].p[i] + u * (g_tr[hi].p[i] - g_tr[lo].p[i]));
    int a = lo > 3 ? lo - 4 : 0, b = hi + 4 < g_ntr ? hi + 4 : g_ntr - 1;
    double dt = g_tr[b].t - g_tr[a].t;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) v[i] = dt > 0 ? (float)((g_tr[b].p[i] - g_tr[a].p[i]) / dt) : 0.f;
}

/* roam_pe_selftest.c -- the free-roam core's cross-platform check on the
 * Windows build: out/win/roam_selftest.dll (tests/roam_selftest.c on the very
 * roam_core.o and roam_libc.o linked into NFSU2FreeRoam.asi, built by
 * i686-w64-mingw32-gcc with the plugin's flags) is loaded by tests/asi_vm.c's
 * PE loader at a base it was not linked for, run under Unicorn (x87 at the
 * 24-bit precision the game's Direct3D device sets), and its byte stream is
 * compared with the arm64 build of the same test.
 *   out/roam_pe_selftest out/win/roam_selftest.dll
 */
#include "asi_vm.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

int roam_selftest(uint8_t *out, int cap);
static uint8_t *g_m; static uint8_t g_bits[1u << 15];
static int committed(void *u, uint32_t a){ (void)u; return (g_bits[a >> 17] >> ((a >> 14) & 7)) & 1; }
static void commit(void *u, uint32_t a, uint32_t n){
    (void)u;
    for (uint32_t b = a >> 14; b <= (a + n - 1) >> 14; b++)
        if (!((g_bits[b >> 3] >> (b & 7)) & 1)){ mprotect(g_m + ((uint64_t)b << 14), 0x4000, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE); g_bits[b >> 3] |= (uint8_t)(1u << (b & 7)); }
}
static int imp(void *u, xvm *vm, int idx, const char *dll, const char *name, uint32_t esp, uint32_t *eax){
    (void)u; (void)vm; (void)idx; (void)esp; (void)eax; fprintf(stderr, "unexpected import %s!%s\n", dll, name); return -1; }
int main(int argc, char **argv){
    if (argc < 2){ fprintf(stderr, "usage: roam_pe_selftest roam_selftest.dll\n"); return 2; }
    g_m = mmap(0, 1ull << 32, PROT_NONE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANON | MAP_NORESERVE, -1, 0);
    const uint32_t BASE = 0x00500000u, STACK = 0x00800000u, OUT = 0x00a00000u, OUTSZ = 0x00100000u;
    commit(0, STACK, 0x100000); commit(0, OUT, OUTSZ);
    xvm_cfg c = { 0, g_m, committed, 0, 0x007F, imp, 0, 0, 0, 0 };    /* FPCW 0x7F: 24-bit x87, as under D3D9 */
    xvm *vm = xvm_new(&c);
    xpe pe;
    if (xpe_load(&pe, vm, argv[1], 0, BASE, commit)){ fprintf(stderr, "cannot load %s\n", argv[1]); return 2; }
    xvm_bind_pe(vm, &pe);
    uint32_t fn = xpe_export(&pe, "roam_selftest_run");
    if (!fn){ fprintf(stderr, "no roam_selftest_run export\n"); return 2; }
    uint32_t r[XR__N] = {0}; r[XR_ESP] = STACK + 0x100000u - 64u;
    uint32_t args[3] = { 0, OUT, OUTSZ }; xvm_write(vm, r[XR_ESP], args, sizeof args);
    if (!xvm_call(vm, fn, r)){ fprintf(stderr, "x86 run stopped: %s\n", xvm_why(vm)); return 1; }
    int nx = (int)r[XR_EAX];
    uint8_t *no = malloc(OUTSZ);
    int nn = roam_selftest(no, (int)OUTSZ);
    printf("roam_pe_selftest: %s loaded at 0x%08x (linked for 0x%08x, %d relocations, %d imports); "
           "x86 (Unicorn) produced %d bytes, arm64 %d bytes\n", argv[1], BASE, pe.pref_base, pe.nreloc, pe.nimp, nx, nn);
    if (nx != nn){ printf("FAIL: lengths differ\n"); return 1; }
    for (int i = 0; i < nn; i++) if (g_m[OUT + i] != no[i]){ printf("FAIL: first difference at byte %d (x86 %02x, arm64 %02x)\n", i, g_m[OUT + i], no[i]); return 1; }
    uint32_t h = 0x811C9DC5u; for (int i = 0; i < nn; i++){ h ^= no[i]; h *= 0x01000193u; }
    printf("PASS: identical, %d bytes, FNV-1a %08x\n", nn, h);
    return 0;
}

 * does) and prints, every second, how the shown car behaved: interpolated /
 * extrapolated / held frames, re-syncs (the sender's clock epoch changed),
 * corrections over 5 m, the distance shown against speed x time, and the
 * largest step.  From the free-roam adversarial review:
 * a sender whose world runs slower than real time.
 *
 *   out/roam_recv <own port> <game's port> <seconds>     (inside tests/net/loopback-only.sb)
 */
#include "roam_core.h"
#include "roam_plat.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <math.h>

void roam_game_event(int ev, int peer, const char *text){ fprintf(stderr, "[recv] event %d peer %d: %s\n", ev, peer, text); }
static rc_session g_s;
int main(int argc, char **argv){
    int port = atoi(argv[1]), peer = atoi(argv[2]); double secs = atof(argv[3]);
    rc_config cf; memset(&cf, 0, sizeof cf);
    cf.self_id = roam_plat_random(); cf.port = (uint16_t)port; snprintf(cf.name, sizeof cf.name, "Viewer");
    cf.platform = RC_PLAT_TOOL; cf.test_mode = 1; cf.max_players = 8; cf.rate_hz = 20;
    rc_io io = { 0, 0, 0, 0 };
    rc_session_init(&g_s, &cf, &io);
    roam_plat_cfg pc = { (uint16_t)port, 1, 0, 0 };
    if (roam_plat_start(&pc, &g_s) != 0) return 1;
    uint8_t rec[64]; rc_carcfg cc; memset(&cc, 0, sizeof cc); cc.type_hash = 1; memcpy(cc.type_name, "PEUGOT", 6); cc.ride_b[3] = 1;
    int rn = rc_carcfg_encode(&cc, rec, sizeof rec);
    roam_plat_lock(); rc_add_peer(&g_s, 0x7F000001u, (uint16_t)peer, 1, roam_plat_now_us()); rc_set_cfg(&g_s, rec, rn, roam_plat_now_us()); roam_plat_unlock();
    int64_t t0 = roam_plat_now_us(), last_rep = t0, prev = t0;
    uint64_t pi = 0, pe = 0, ph = 0, pep = 0, psn = 0; float lastp[3] = {0}; int have_last = 0;
    double dist_shown = 0, dist_snap_speed = 0; double maxstep = 0;
    for (;;){
        int64_t now = roam_plat_now_us();
        if (now - t0 > (int64_t)(secs * 1e6)) break;
        rc_state st; memset(&st, 0, sizeof st); st.t_us = (uint32_t)now; st.q[3] = 1; st.p[0] = 2000; st.p[1] = -900; st.p[2] = 24;   /* far away, standing */
        roam_plat_lock();
        rc_set_status(&g_s, RC_ST_ROAM); rc_push_state(&g_s, &st, now);
        for (int i = 0; i < RC_TABLE; i++){
            rc_peer *p = &g_s.peer[i];
            if (p->state != RC_PS_EST || !p->mo.n || p->status != RC_ST_ROAM) continue;
            rc_pose P;
            if (rc_interp_eval(&p->mo, now, now - prev, 100000, 250000, &P)){
                if (have_last){
                    double d = sqrt((P.p[0]-lastp[0])*(P.p[0]-lastp[0]) + (P.p[1]-lastp[1])*(P.p[1]-lastp[1]));
                    dist_shown += d; if (d > maxstep) maxstep = d;
                    dist_snap_speed += fabs(P.speed) * (now - prev) / 1e6;
                }
                memcpy(lastp, P.p, sizeof lastp); have_last = 1;
            }
            if (now - last_rep >= 1000000){
                rc_interp *m = &p->mo;
                printf("t=%5.1f s  interp %3llu extrap %3llu hold %3llu  re-syncs +%llu  snaps>5m +%llu  shown %.1f m vs speed x time %.1f m  largest step %.2f m\n",
                       (now - t0) / 1e6, (unsigned long long)(m->n_interp - pi), (unsigned long long)(m->n_extrap - pe), (unsigned long long)(m->n_hold - ph),
                       (unsigned long long)(m->n_epoch - pep), (unsigned long long)(m->n_snap - psn), dist_shown, dist_snap_speed, maxstep);
                fflush(stdout);
                pi = m->n_interp; pe = m->n_extrap; ph = m->n_hold; pep = m->n_epoch; psn = m->n_snap;
                dist_shown = dist_snap_speed = maxstep = 0; last_rep = now;
            }
        }
        roam_plat_unlock();
        prev = now;
        usleep(8333);
    }
    roam_plat_stop(0);
    return 0;
}

/* roam_selftest.c -- a deterministic byte stream from the free-roam core, for
 * the cross-platform check (tests/roam_x86_oracle.c): the same source built
 * for arm64 (linked into the oracle) and for 32-bit x86 (an ELF object run
 * under Unicorn) must produce the same bytes.  Covers every message
 * encoding, the CRC, the car-look record, matrix <-> quaternion, exp, sqrt,
 * the interpolator over a jittered stream, decoding of corrupted datagrams,
 * a two-session exchange (handshake, gossip, snapshots, car record) and the
 * encoder on NaN, infinite and out-of-range values.
 * No libm, no OS: built with -ffreestanding for x86.  tools/build_roam_asi.sh
 * also builds it as a Windows DLL (out/win/roam_selftest.dll) from the
 * plugin's own core object, for the same comparison through a PE loader.
 */
#ifdef ROAM_SELFTEST_EXTERN_CORE
/* the Windows build (tools/build_roam_asi.sh): linked with the very
 * roam_core.o and roam_libc.o of NFSU2FreeRoam.asi */

void *memcpy(void *d, const void *s, size_t n);
void *memset(void *d, int c, size_t n);
#else
#include "../runtime/roam_core.c"
#endif

#if defined(ROAM_SELFTEST_FREESTANDING) && !defined(ROAM_SELFTEST_EXTERN_CORE)
/* the x86 object is linked by nobody: it brings its own */
#undef memcpy
#undef memset
#undef memmove
#undef memcmp
#undef strlen
void *memcpy(void *d, const void *s, size_t n){ uint8_t *a = d; const uint8_t *b = s; while (n--) *a++ = *b++; return d; }
void *memmove(void *d, const void *s, size_t n){
    uint8_t *a = d; const uint8_t *b = s;
    if (a < b) while (n--) *a++ = *b++; else { a += n; b += n; while (n--) *--a = *--b; }
    return d;
}
void *memset(void *d, int c, size_t n){ uint8_t *a = d; while (n--) *a++ = (uint8_t)c; return d; }
int memcmp(const void *x, const void *y, size_t n){ const uint8_t *a = x, *b = y; for (; n; n--, a++, b++) if (*a != *b) return *a - *b; return 0; }
size_t strlen(const char *s){ size_t n = 0; while (s[n]) n++; return n; }
